CFDLean.Assembly.constant_state_closed.name: CFDLean.Assembly.constant_state_closed
CFDLean.Assembly.constant_state_closed.raw_type:
∀ {N : Type u_1} {E : Type u_2} {B : Type u_3} [inst : DecidableEq N] [inst_1 : Fintype E] [inst_2 : Fintype B]
  (m : CFDLean.Assembly.Interfaces N E B) (γ : Real) (U : CFDLean.Conservative (OfNat.ofNat 3))
  (S : E → CFDLean.Vector (OfNat.ofNat 3)) (T : B → CFDLean.Vector (OfNat.ofNat 3)) (i : N),
  Eq (CFDLean.Assembly.metricDefect m S T i) (OfNat.ofNat 0) →
    Eq
      (CFDLean.Assembly.residual m (CFDLean.Assembly.roeTransfer m γ (fun x => U) S)
        (fun b => DFunLike.coe (CFDLean.Assembly.physicalTransfer γ U) (T b)) i)
      (OfNat.ofNat 0)
CFDLean.Assembly.constant_state_closed.type:
∀ {N : Type u_1} {E : Type u_2} {B : Type u_3} [inst : DecidableEq N] [inst_1 : Fintype E] [inst_2 : Fintype B]
  (m : CFDLean.Assembly.Interfaces N E B) (γ : ℝ) (U : CFDLean.Conservative 3) (S : E → CFDLean.Vector 3)
  (T : B → CFDLean.Vector 3) (i : N),
  CFDLean.Assembly.metricDefect m S T i = 0 →
    CFDLean.Assembly.residual m (CFDLean.Assembly.roeTransfer m γ (fun x => U) S)
        (fun b => (CFDLean.Assembly.physicalTransfer γ U) (T b)) i =
      0

  (m : CFDLean.Assembly.Interfaces N E B) (γ : Real) (U : CFDLean.Conservative (OfNat.ofNat 3))
  (S : E → CFDLean.Vector (OfNat.ofNat 3)) (T : B → CFDLean.Vector (OfNat.ofNat 3)) (i : N),
  Eq
    (CFDLean.Assembly.residual m (CFDLean.Assembly.roeTransfer m γ (fun x => U) S)
      (fun b => DFunLike.coe (CFDLean.Assembly.physicalTransfer γ U) (T b)) i)
    (CFDLean.Coordinates.encode (CFDLean.physicalFlux γ U (CFDLean.Assembly.metricDefect m S T i)))
CFDLean.Assembly.constant_state_residual.type:
∀ {N : Type u_1} {E : Type u_2} {B : Type u_3} [inst : DecidableEq N] [inst_1 : Fintype E] [inst_2 : Fintype B]
  (m : CFDLean.Assembly.Interfaces N E B) (γ : ℝ) (U : CFDLean.Conservative 3) (S : E → CFDLean.Vector 3)
  (T : B → CFDLean.Vector 3) (i : N),
  CFDLean.Assembly.residual m (CFDLean.Assembly.roeTransfer m γ (fun x => U) S)
      (fun b => (CFDLean.Assembly.physicalTransfer γ U) (T b)) i =
    CFDLean.Coordinates.encode (CFDLean.physicalFlux γ U (CFDLean.Assembly.metricDefect m S T i))

∀ {N : Type u_1} {E : Type u_2} {B : Type u_3} [inst : DecidableEq N] (m : CFDLean.Assembly.Interfaces N E B) (e : E),
  Eq (CFDLean.Assembly.incidence m (m.head e) e) (Neg.neg (OfNat.ofNat 1))
CFDLean.Assembly.incidence_head.type:
∀ {N : Type u_1} {E : Type u_2} {B : Type u_3} [inst : DecidableEq N] (m : CFDLean.Assembly.Interfaces N E B) (e : E),
  CFDLean.Assembly.incidence m (m.head e) e = -1

CFDLean.Assembly.incidence_other.name: CFDLean.Assembly.incidence_other
CFDLean.Assembly.incidence_other.raw_type:
∀ {N : Type u_1} {E : Type u_2} {B : Type u_3} [inst : DecidableEq N] (m : CFDLean.Assembly.Interfaces N E B) (i : N)
  (e : E), Ne (m.tail e) i → Ne (m.head e) i → Eq (CFDLean.Assembly.incidence m i e) (OfNat.ofNat 0)
CFDLean.Assembly.incidence_other.type:
∀ {N : Type u_1} {E : Type u_2} {B : Type u_3} [inst : DecidableEq N] (m : CFDLean.Assembly.Interfaces N E B) (i : N)
  (e : E), m.tail e ≠ i → m.head e ≠ i → CFDLean.Assembly.incidence m i e = 0

CFDLean.Assembly.incidence_reverse.name: CFDLean.Assembly.incidence_reverse
CFDLean.Assembly.incidence_reverse.raw_type:
∀ {N : Type u_1} {E : Type u_2} {B : Type u_3} [inst : DecidableEq N] (m : CFDLean.Assembly.Interfaces N E B)
  (rev : E → Prop) [inst_1 : DecidablePred rev] (i : N) (e : E),
  Eq (CFDLean.Assembly.incidence (m.reverse rev) i e)
    (ite (rev e) (Neg.neg (CFDLean.Assembly.incidence m i e)) (CFDLean.Assembly.incidence m i e))
CFDLean.Assembly.incidence_reverse.type:
∀ {N : Type u_1} {E : Type u_2} {B : Type u_3} [inst : DecidableEq N] (m : CFDLean.Assembly.Interfaces N E B)
  (rev : E → Prop) [inst_1 : DecidablePred rev] (i : N) (e : E),
  CFDLean.Assembly.incidence (m.reverse rev) i e =
    if rev e then -CFDLean.Assembly.incidence m i e else CFDLean.Assembly.incidence m i e

CFDLean.Assembly.incidence_smul.name: CFDLean.Assembly.incidence_smul
CFDLean.Assembly.incidence_smul.raw_type:
∀ {N : Type u_1} {E : Type u_2} {B : Type u_3} [inst : DecidableEq N] {d : Nat} (m : CFDLean.Assembly.Interfaces N E B)
  (i : N) (e : E) (v : CFDLean.Vector d),
  Eq (HSMul.hSMul (CFDLean.Assembly.incidence m i e) v)
    (HSub.hSub (ite (Eq (m.tail e) i) v (OfNat.ofNat 0)) (ite (Eq (m.head e) i) v (OfNat.ofNat 0)))
CFDLean.Assembly.incidence_smul.type:
∀ {N : Type u_1} {E : Type u_2} {B : Type u_3} [inst : DecidableEq N] {d : ℕ} (m : CFDLean.Assembly.Interfaces N E B)
  (i : N) (e : E) (v : CFDLean.Vector d),
  CFDLean.Assembly.incidence m i e • v = (if m.tail e = i then v else 0) - if m.head e = i then v else 0

CFDLean.Assembly.incidence_sum.name: CFDLean.Assembly.incidence_sum
CFDLean.Assembly.incidence_sum.raw_type:
∀ {N : Type u_1} {E : Type u_2} {B : Type u_3} [inst : DecidableEq N] [inst_1 : Fintype N]
  (m : CFDLean.Assembly.Interfaces N E B) (e : E),
  Eq (Finset.univ.sum fun i => CFDLean.Assembly.incidence m i e) (OfNat.ofNat 0)
CFDLean.Assembly.incidence_sum.type:
∀ {N : Type u_1} {E : Type u_2} {B : Type u_3} [inst : DecidableEq N] [inst_1 : Fintype N]
  (m : CFDLean.Assembly.Interfaces N E B) (e : E), ∑ i, CFDLean.Assembly.incidence m i e = 0

CFDLean.Assembly.incidence_tail.name: CFDLean.Assembly.incidence_tail
CFDLean.Assembly.incidence_tail.raw_type:
∀ {N : Type u_1} {E : Type u_2} {B : Type u_3} [inst : DecidableEq N] (m : CFDLean.Assembly.Interfaces N E B) (e : E),
  Eq (CFDLean.Assembly.incidence m (m.tail e) e) (OfNat.ofNat 1)
CFDLean.Assembly.incidence_tail.type:
∀ {N : Type u_1} {E : Type u_2} {B : Type u_3} [inst : DecidableEq N] (m : CFDLean.Assembly.Interfaces N E B) (e : E),
  CFDLean.Assembly.incidence m (m.tail e) e = 1

CFDLean.Assembly.metricDefect.name: CFDLean.Assembly.metricDefect
CFDLean.Assembly.metricDefect.type:
{N : Type u_1} →
  {E : Type u_2} →
    {B : Type u_3} →
      [DecidableEq N] →
        [Fintype E] →
          [Fintype B] →
            CFDLean.Assembly.Interfaces N E B → (E → CFDLean.Vector 3) → (B → CFDLean.Vector 3) → N → CFDLean.Vector 3

CFDLean.Assembly.outwardTransfer.name: CFDLean.Assembly.outwardTransfer
CFDLean.Assembly.outwardTransfer.type:
{N : Type u_1} →
  {E : Type u_2} →
    {B : Type u_3} →
      [DecidableEq N] →
        CFDLean.Assembly.Interfaces N E B →
          ℝ → (N → CFDLean.Conservative 3) → (E → CFDLean.Vector 3) → N → E → CFDLean.Coordinates.StateCoordinates

CFDLean.Assembly.outwardTransfer.eq_1.name: CFDLean.Assembly.outwardTransfer.eq_1
CFDLean.Assembly.outwardTransfer.eq_1.raw_type:
∀ {N : Type u_1} {E : Type u_2} {B : Type u_3} [inst : DecidableEq N] (m : CFDLean.Assembly.Interfaces N E B) (γ : Real)
  (U : N → CFDLean.Conservative (OfNat.ofNat 3)) (S : E → CFDLean.Vector (OfNat.ofNat 3)) (i : N) (e : E),
  Eq (CFDLean.Assembly.outwardTransfer m γ U S i e)
    (ite (Eq (m.tail e) i)
      (CFDLean.Coordinates.encode (CFDLean.Roe.numericalFlux γ (U (m.tail e)) (U (m.head e)) (S e)))
      (ite (Eq (m.head e) i)
        (CFDLean.Coordinates.encode (CFDLean.Roe.numericalFlux γ (U (m.head e)) (U (m.tail e)) (Neg.neg (S e))))
        (OfNat.ofNat 0)))
CFDLean.Assembly.outwardTransfer.eq_1.type:
∀ {N : Type u_1} {E : Type u_2} {B : Type u_3} [inst : DecidableEq N] (m : CFDLean.Assembly.Interfaces N E B) (γ : ℝ)
  (U : N → CFDLean.Conservative 3) (S : E → CFDLean.Vector 3) (i : N) (e : E),
  CFDLean.Assembly.outwardTransfer m γ U S i e =
    if m.tail e = i then CFDLean.Coordinates.encode (CFDLean.Roe.numericalFlux γ (U (m.tail e)) (U (m.head e)) (S e))
    else
      if m.head e = i then CFDLean.Coordinates.encode (CFDLean.Roe.numericalFlux γ (U (m.head e)) (U (m.tail e)) (-S e))
      else 0

CFDLean.Assembly.outwardTransfer_eq.name: CFDLean.Assembly.outwardTransfer_eq
CFDLean.Assembly.outwardTransfer_eq.raw_type:
∀ {N : Type u_1} {E : Type u_2} {B : Type u_3} [inst : DecidableEq N] (m : CFDLean.Assembly.Interfaces N E B) (γ : Real)
  (U : N → CFDLean.Conservative (OfNat.ofNat 3)) (S : E → CFDLean.Vector (OfNat.ofNat 3)) (i : N) (e : E),
  Eq (CFDLean.Assembly.outwardTransfer m γ U S i e)
    (HSMul.hSMul (CFDLean.Assembly.incidence m i e) (CFDLean.Assembly.roeTransfer m γ U S e))
CFDLean.Assembly.outwardTransfer_eq.type:
∀ {N : Type u_1} {E : Type u_2} {B : Type u_3} [inst : DecidableEq N] (m : CFDLean.Assembly.Interfaces N E B) (γ : ℝ)
  (U : N → CFDLean.Conservative 3) (S : E → CFDLean.Vector 3) (i : N) (e : E),
  CFDLean.Assembly.outwardTransfer m γ U S i e =
    CFDLean.Assembly.incidence m i e • CFDLean.Assembly.roeTransfer m γ U S e

CFDLean.Assembly.physicalTransfer._proof.name: CFDLean.Assembly.physicalTransfer._proof_1
CFDLean.Assembly.physicalTransfer._proof.raw_type:
∀ (γ : Real) (U : CFDLean.Conservative (OfNat.ofNat 3)) (S T : CFDLean.Vector (OfNat.ofNat 3)),
  Eq (CFDLean.Coordinates.encode (CFDLean.physicalFlux γ U (HAdd.hAdd S T)))
    (HAdd.hAdd (CFDLean.Coordinates.encode (CFDLean.physicalFlux γ U S))
      (CFDLean.Coordinates.encode (CFDLean.physicalFlux γ U T)))
CFDLean.Assembly.physicalTransfer._proof.type:
∀ (γ : ℝ) (U : CFDLean.Conservative 3) (S T : CFDLean.Vector 3),
  CFDLean.Coordinates.encode (CFDLean.physicalFlux γ U (S + T)) =
    CFDLean.Coordinates.encode (CFDLean.physicalFlux γ U S) + CFDLean.Coordinates.encode (CFDLean.physicalFlux γ U T)

CFDLean.Assembly.physicalTransfer._proof.name: CFDLean.Assembly.physicalTransfer._proof_2
CFDLean.Assembly.physicalTransfer._proof.raw_type:
∀ (γ : Real) (U : CFDLean.Conservative (OfNat.ofNat 3)) (a : Real) (S : CFDLean.Vector (OfNat.ofNat 3)),
  Eq (CFDLean.Coordinates.encode (CFDLean.physicalFlux γ U (HSMul.hSMul a S)))
    (HSMul.hSMul (DFunLike.coe (RingHom.id Real) a) (CFDLean.Coordinates.encode (CFDLean.physicalFlux γ U S)))
CFDLean.Assembly.physicalTransfer._proof.type:
∀ (γ : ℝ) (U : CFDLean.Conservative 3) (a : ℝ) (S : CFDLean.Vector 3),
  CFDLean.Coordinates.encode (CFDLean.physicalFlux γ U (a • S)) =
    (RingHom.id ℝ) a • CFDLean.Coordinates.encode (CFDLean.physicalFlux γ U S)

CFDLean.Assembly.physicalTransfer.eq_1.name: CFDLean.Assembly.physicalTransfer.eq_1

CFDLean.Assembly.residual.name: CFDLean.Assembly.residual
CFDLean.Assembly.residual.type:
{N : Type u_1} →
  {E : Type u_2} →
    {B : Type u_3} →
      [DecidableEq N] →
        [Fintype E] →
          [Fintype B] →
            {d : ℕ} →
              CFDLean.Assembly.Interfaces N E B → (E → CFDLean.Vector d) → (B → CFDLean.Vector d) → N → CFDLean.Vector d

CFDLean.Assembly.residual.congr_simp.name: CFDLean.Assembly.residual.congr_simp
CFDLean.Assembly.residual.congr_simp.raw_type:
∀ {N : Type u_1} {E : Type u_2} {B : Type u_3} {inst : DecidableEq N} [inst_1 : DecidableEq N] [inst_2 : Fintype E]
  [inst_3 : Fintype B] {d : Nat} (m m_1 : CFDLean.Assembly.Interfaces N E B),
  Eq m m_1 →
    ∀ (f f_1 : E → CFDLean.Vector d),
      Eq f f_1 →
        ∀ (g g_1 : B → CFDLean.Vector d),
          Eq g g_1 →
            ∀ (i i_1 : N),
              Eq i i_1 →
                ∀ (a a_1 : Fin d),
                  Eq a a_1 → Eq (CFDLean.Assembly.residual m f g i a) (CFDLean.Assembly.residual m_1 f_1 g_1 i_1 a_1)
CFDLean.Assembly.residual.congr_simp.type:
∀ {N : Type u_1} {E : Type u_2} {B : Type u_3} {inst : DecidableEq N} [inst_1 : DecidableEq N] [inst_2 : Fintype E]
  [inst_3 : Fintype B] {d : ℕ} (m m_1 : CFDLean.Assembly.Interfaces N E B),
  m = m_1 →
    ∀ (f f_1 : E → CFDLean.Vector d),
      f = f_1 →
        ∀ (g g_1 : B → CFDLean.Vector d),
          g = g_1 →
            ∀ (i i_1 : N),
              i = i_1 →
                ∀ (a a_1 : Fin d),
                  a = a_1 → CFDLean.Assembly.residual m f g i a = CFDLean.Assembly.residual m_1 f_1 g_1 i_1 a_1

CFDLean.Assembly.residual.eq_1.name: CFDLean.Assembly.residual.eq_1
CFDLean.Assembly.residual.eq_1.raw_type:
∀ {N : Type u_1} {E : Type u_2} {B : Type u_3} [inst : DecidableEq N] [inst_1 : Fintype E] [inst_2 : Fintype B]
  {d : Nat} (m : CFDLean.Assembly.Interfaces N E B) (f : E → CFDLean.Vector d) (g : B → CFDLean.Vector d) (i : N),
  Eq (CFDLean.Assembly.residual m f g i)
    (HAdd.hAdd (Finset.univ.sum fun e => HSMul.hSMul (CFDLean.Assembly.incidence m i e) (f e))
      (Finset.univ.sum fun b => ite (Eq (m.owner b) i) (g b) (OfNat.ofNat 0)))
CFDLean.Assembly.residual.eq_1.type:
∀ {N : Type u_1} {E : Type u_2} {B : Type u_3} [inst : DecidableEq N] [inst_1 : Fintype E] [inst_2 : Fintype B] {d : ℕ}
  (m : CFDLean.Assembly.Interfaces N E B) (f : E → CFDLean.Vector d) (g : B → CFDLean.Vector d) (i : N),
  CFDLean.Assembly.residual m f g i =
    ∑ e, CFDLean.Assembly.incidence m i e • f e + ∑ b, if m.owner b = i then g b else 0

CFDLean.Assembly.residual_map.name: CFDLean.Assembly.residual_map
CFDLean.Assembly.residual_map.raw_type:
∀ {N : Type u_1} {E : Type u_2} {B : Type u_3} [inst : DecidableEq N] [inst_1 : Fintype E] [inst_2 : Fintype B]
  {d k : Nat} (m : CFDLean.Assembly.Interfaces N E B)
  (L : LinearMap (RingHom.id Real) (CFDLean.Vector d) (CFDLean.Vector k)) (f : E → CFDLean.Vector d)
  (g : B → CFDLean.Vector d) (i : N),
  Eq (CFDLean.Assembly.residual m (fun e => DFunLike.coe L (f e)) (fun b => DFunLike.coe L (g b)) i)
    (DFunLike.coe L (CFDLean.Assembly.residual m f g i))
CFDLean.Assembly.residual_map.type:
∀ {N : Type u_1} {E : Type u_2} {B : Type u_3} [inst : DecidableEq N] [inst_1 : Fintype E] [inst_2 : Fintype B]
  {d k : ℕ} (m : CFDLean.Assembly.Interfaces N E B) (L : CFDLean.Vector d →ₗ[ℝ] CFDLean.Vector k)
  (f : E → CFDLean.Vector d) (g : B → CFDLean.Vector d) (i : N),
  CFDLean.Assembly.residual m (fun e => L (f e)) (fun b => L (g b)) i = L (CFDLean.Assembly.residual m f g i)

CFDLean.Assembly.residual_outgoing.name: CFDLean.Assembly.residual_outgoing
CFDLean.Assembly.residual_outgoing.raw_type:
∀ {N : Type u_1} {E : Type u_2} {B : Type u_3} [inst : DecidableEq N] [inst_1 : Fintype E] [inst_2 : Fintype B]
  {d : Nat} (m : CFDLean.Assembly.Interfaces N E B) (f : E → CFDLean.Vector d) (g : B → CFDLean.Vector d) (i : N),
  Eq (CFDLean.Assembly.residual m f g i)
    (HAdd.hAdd
      (HSub.hSub ((Finset.filter (fun e => Eq (m.tail e) i) Finset.univ).sum fun e => f e)
        ((Finset.filter (fun e => Eq (m.head e) i) Finset.univ).sum fun e => f e))
      ((Finset.filter (fun b => Eq (m.owner b) i) Finset.univ).sum fun b => g b))
CFDLean.Assembly.residual_outgoing.type:
∀ {N : Type u_1} {E : Type u_2} {B : Type u_3} [inst : DecidableEq N] [inst_1 : Fintype E] [inst_2 : Fintype B] {d : ℕ}
  (m : CFDLean.Assembly.Interfaces N E B) (f : E → CFDLean.Vector d) (g : B → CFDLean.Vector d) (i : N),
  CFDLean.Assembly.residual m f g i =
    ∑ e with m.tail e = i, f e - ∑ e with m.head e = i, f e + ∑ b with m.owner b = i, g b

CFDLean.Assembly.residual_reindex.name: CFDLean.Assembly.residual_reindex
CFDLean.Assembly.residual_reindex.raw_type:
∀ {N : Type u_1} {E : Type u_2} {B : Type u_3} [inst : DecidableEq N] [inst_1 : Fintype E] [inst_2 : Fintype B]
  {d : Nat} {N' : Type u_4} {E' : Type u_5} {B' : Type u_6} [inst_3 : DecidableEq N'] [inst_4 : Fintype E']
  [inst_5 : Fintype B'] (m : CFDLean.Assembly.Interfaces N E B) (n : Equiv N N') (e : Equiv E E') (b : Equiv B B')
  (f : E → CFDLean.Vector d) (g : B → CFDLean.Vector d) (i : N),
  Eq
    (CFDLean.Assembly.residual (m.reindex n e b) (fun j => f (DFunLike.coe e.symm j))
      (fun j => g (DFunLike.coe b.symm j)) (DFunLike.coe n i))
    (CFDLean.Assembly.residual m f g i)
CFDLean.Assembly.residual_reindex.type:
∀ {N : Type u_1} {E : Type u_2} {B : Type u_3} [inst : DecidableEq N] [inst_1 : Fintype E] [inst_2 : Fintype B] {d : ℕ}
  {N' : Type u_4} {E' : Type u_5} {B' : Type u_6} [inst_3 : DecidableEq N'] [inst_4 : Fintype E'] [inst_5 : Fintype B']
  (m : CFDLean.Assembly.Interfaces N E B) (n : N ≃ N') (e : E ≃ E') (b : B ≃ B') (f : E → CFDLean.Vector d)
  (g : B → CFDLean.Vector d) (i : N),
  CFDLean.Assembly.residual (m.reindex n e b) (fun j => f (e.symm j)) (fun j => g (b.symm j)) (n i) =
    CFDLean.Assembly.residual m f g i

CFDLean.Assembly.residual_reverse.name: CFDLean.Assembly.residual_reverse
CFDLean.Assembly.residual_reverse.raw_type:
∀ {N : Type u_1} {E : Type u_2} {B : Type u_3} [inst : DecidableEq N] [inst_1 : Fintype E] [inst_2 : Fintype B]
  {d : Nat} (m : CFDLean.Assembly.Interfaces N E B) (rev : E → Prop) [inst_3 : DecidablePred rev]
  (f : E → CFDLean.Vector d) (g : B → CFDLean.Vector d) (i : N),
  Eq (CFDLean.Assembly.residual (m.reverse rev) (fun e => ite (rev e) (Neg.neg (f e)) (f e)) g i)
    (CFDLean.Assembly.residual m f g i)
CFDLean.Assembly.residual_reverse.type:
∀ {N : Type u_1} {E : Type u_2} {B : Type u_3} [inst : DecidableEq N] [inst_1 : Fintype E] [inst_2 : Fintype B] {d : ℕ}
  (m : CFDLean.Assembly.Interfaces N E B) (rev : E → Prop) [inst_3 : DecidablePred rev] (f : E → CFDLean.Vector d)
  (g : B → CFDLean.Vector d) (i : N),
  CFDLean.Assembly.residual (m.reverse rev) (fun e => if rev e then -f e else f e) g i =
    CFDLean.Assembly.residual m f g i

CFDLean.Assembly.roeTransfer.name: CFDLean.Assembly.roeTransfer
CFDLean.Assembly.roeTransfer.type:
{N : Type u_1} →
  {E : Type u_2} →
    {B : Type u_3} →
      CFDLean.Assembly.Interfaces N E B →
        ℝ → (N → CFDLean.Conservative 3) → (E → CFDLean.Vector 3) → E → CFDLean.Coordinates.StateCoordinates

CFDLean.Assembly.roeTransfer.eq_1.name: CFDLean.Assembly.roeTransfer.eq_1
CFDLean.Assembly.roeTransfer.eq_1.raw_type:
∀ {N : Type u_1} {E : Type u_2} {B : Type u_3} (m : CFDLean.Assembly.Interfaces N E B) (γ : Real)
  (U : N → CFDLean.Conservative (OfNat.ofNat 3)) (S : E → CFDLean.Vector (OfNat.ofNat 3)) (e : E),
  Eq (CFDLean.Assembly.roeTransfer m γ U S e)
    (CFDLean.Coordinates.encode (CFDLean.Roe.numericalFlux γ (U (m.tail e)) (U (m.head e)) (S e)))
CFDLean.Assembly.roeTransfer.eq_1.type:
∀ {N : Type u_1} {E : Type u_2} {B : Type u_3} (m : CFDLean.Assembly.Interfaces N E B) (γ : ℝ)
  (U : N → CFDLean.Conservative 3) (S : E → CFDLean.Vector 3) (e : E),
  CFDLean.Assembly.roeTransfer m γ U S e =
    CFDLean.Coordinates.encode (CFDLean.Roe.numericalFlux γ (U (m.tail e)) (U (m.head e)) (S e))

CFDLean.Assembly.roeTransfer_consistency.name: CFDLean.Assembly.roeTransfer_consistency
CFDLean.Assembly.roeTransfer_consistency.raw_type:
∀ {N : Type u_1} {E : Type u_2} {B : Type u_3} (m : CFDLean.Assembly.Interfaces N E B) (γ : Real)
  (U : CFDLean.Conservative (OfNat.ofNat 3)) (S : E → CFDLean.Vector (OfNat.ofNat 3)) (e : E),
  Eq (CFDLean.Assembly.roeTransfer m γ (fun x => U) S e) (DFunLike.coe (CFDLean.Assembly.physicalTransfer γ U) (S e))
CFDLean.Assembly.roeTransfer_consistency.type:
∀ {N : Type u_1} {E : Type u_2} {B : Type u_3} (m : CFDLean.Assembly.Interfaces N E B) (γ : ℝ)
  (U : CFDLean.Conservative 3) (S : E → CFDLean.Vector 3) (e : E),
  CFDLean.Assembly.roeTransfer m γ (fun x => U) S e = (CFDLean.Assembly.physicalTransfer γ U) (S e)

CFDLean.Assembly.roeTransfer_zero.name: CFDLean.Assembly.roeTransfer_zero
CFDLean.Assembly.roeTransfer_zero.raw_type:
∀ {N : Type u_1} {E : Type u_2} {B : Type u_3} (m : CFDLean.Assembly.Interfaces N E B) (γ : Real)
  (U : N → CFDLean.Conservative (OfNat.ofNat 3)) (S : E → CFDLean.Vector (OfNat.ofNat 3)) (e : E),
  Eq (S e) (OfNat.ofNat 0) → Eq (CFDLean.Assembly.roeTransfer m γ U S e) (OfNat.ofNat 0)
CFDLean.Assembly.roeTransfer_zero.type:
∀ {N : Type u_1} {E : Type u_2} {B : Type u_3} (m : CFDLean.Assembly.Interfaces N E B) (γ : ℝ)
  (U : N → CFDLean.Conservative 3) (S : E → CFDLean.Vector 3) (e : E),
  S e = 0 → CFDLean.Assembly.roeTransfer m γ U S e = 0

CFDLean.Assembly.roe_global_balance.name: CFDLean.Assembly.roe_global_balance
CFDLean.Assembly.roe_global_balance.raw_type:
∀ {N : Type u_1} {E : Type u_2} {B : Type u_3} [inst : DecidableEq N] [inst_1 : Fintype E] [inst_2 : Fintype B]
  [inst_3 : Fintype N] (m : CFDLean.Assembly.Interfaces N E B) (γ : Real) (U : N → CFDLean.Conservative (OfNat.ofNat 3))
  (S : E → CFDLean.Vector (OfNat.ofNat 3)) (g : B → CFDLean.Coordinates.StateCoordinates),
  Eq (Finset.univ.sum fun i => CFDLean.Assembly.residual m (CFDLean.Assembly.roeTransfer m γ U S) g i)
    (Finset.univ.sum fun b => g b)
CFDLean.Assembly.roe_global_balance.type:
∀ {N : Type u_1} {E : Type u_2} {B : Type u_3} [inst : DecidableEq N] [inst_1 : Fintype E] [inst_2 : Fintype B]
  [inst_3 : Fintype N] (m : CFDLean.Assembly.Interfaces N E B) (γ : ℝ) (U : N → CFDLean.Conservative 3)
  (S : E → CFDLean.Vector 3) (g : B → CFDLean.Coordinates.StateCoordinates),
  ∑ i, CFDLean.Assembly.residual m (CFDLean.Assembly.roeTransfer m γ U S) g i = ∑ b, g b

CFDLean.Assembly.roe_residual_reindex.name: CFDLean.Assembly.roe_residual_reindex

    (CFDLean.Boundary.constructedTransfer m γ k V U T (DFunLike.coe b.symm j))

CFDLean.Boundary.meshResidual_eq.raw_type:
∀ {n m : Nat} (M : CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData n m) (γ : Real) (k : Finset (Fin n) → CFDLean.Boundary.Kind)
  (V : Finset (Fin n) → CFDLean.Conservative (OfNat.ofNat 3)) (U : Fin n → CFDLean.Conservative (OfNat.ofNat 3))
  (i : Fin n),
  Eq (CFDLean.Boundary.meshResidual M γ k V U i)
    (CFDLean.Assembly.residual M.interfaces (CFDLean.Assembly.roeTransfer M.interfaces γ U M.edgeArea)
      (CFDLean.Boundary.patchTransfer M γ k V U) i)
CFDLean.Boundary.meshResidual_eq.type:
∀ {n m : ℕ} (M : CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData n m) (γ : ℝ) (k : Finset (Fin n) → CFDLean.Boundary.Kind)

CFDLean.Boundary.mesh_common_correction.name: CFDLean.Boundary.mesh_common_correction
CFDLean.Boundary.mesh_common_correction.raw_type:
∀ {n m : Nat} (M : CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData n m),
  M.Conforming →
    ∀ (γ : Real) (k : Finset (Fin n) → CFDLean.Boundary.Kind)
      (V : Finset (Fin n) → CFDLean.Conservative (OfNat.ofNat 3)) (U : CFDLean.Conservative (OfNat.ofNat 3))
      (i : Fin n),
      Eq (CFDLean.Boundary.meshResidual M γ k V (fun x => U) i)
        (Finset.univ.sum fun b =>
          ite (Eq (M.interfaces.owner b) i)
            (HSub.hSub (CFDLean.Boundary.patchTransfer M γ k V (fun x => U) b)
              (DFunLike.coe (CFDLean.Assembly.physicalTransfer γ U) (M.boundaryArea b)))
            (OfNat.ofNat 0))
CFDLean.Boundary.mesh_common_correction.type:
∀ {n m : ℕ} (M : CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData n m),
  M.Conforming →
    ∀ (γ : ℝ) (k : Finset (Fin n) → CFDLean.Boundary.Kind) (V : Finset (Fin n) → CFDLean.Conservative 3)
      (U : CFDLean.Conservative 3) (i : Fin n),
      CFDLean.Boundary.meshResidual M γ k V (fun x => U) i =
        ∑ b,
          if M.interfaces.owner b = i then
            CFDLean.Boundary.patchTransfer M γ k V (fun x => U) b -
              (CFDLean.Assembly.physicalTransfer γ U) (M.boundaryArea b)
          else 0

CFDLean.Boundary.mesh_constant_state.name: CFDLean.Boundary.mesh_constant_state
CFDLean.Boundary.mesh_constant_state.raw_type:
∀ {n m : Nat} (M : CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData n m),
  M.Conforming →
    ∀ (γ : Real),
      LT.lt (OfNat.ofNat 1) γ →
        ∀ (U : CFDLean.Conservative (OfNat.ofNat 3)),
          CFDLean.Conservative.Admissible γ U →
            ∀ (k : Finset (Fin n) → CFDLean.Boundary.Kind) (V : Finset (Fin n) → CFDLean.Conservative (OfNat.ofNat 3))
              (i : Fin n),
              (∀ (b : M.Boundary),
                  Ne (CFDLean.Boundary.patchKind M k b) CFDLean.Boundary.Kind.prescribedExteriorRoe →
                    Eq (CFDLean.dot U.momentum (M.boundaryArea b)) (OfNat.ofNat 0)) →
                (∀ (b : M.Boundary),
                    Eq (CFDLean.Boundary.patchKind M k b) CFDLean.Boundary.Kind.prescribedExteriorRoe →
                      Eq (CFDLean.Boundary.patchExterior M V b) U) →
                  Eq (CFDLean.Boundary.meshResidual M γ k V (fun x => U) i) (OfNat.ofNat 0)
CFDLean.Boundary.mesh_constant_state.type:
∀ {n m : ℕ} (M : CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData n m),
  M.Conforming →
    ∀ (γ : ℝ),
      1 < γ →
        ∀ (U : CFDLean.Conservative 3),
          CFDLean.Conservative.Admissible γ U →
            ∀ (k : Finset (Fin n) → CFDLean.Boundary.Kind) (V : Finset (Fin n) → CFDLean.Conservative 3) (i : Fin n),
              (∀ (b : M.Boundary),
                  CFDLean.Boundary.patchKind M k b ≠ CFDLean.Boundary.Kind.prescribedExteriorRoe →
                    CFDLean.dot U.momentum (M.boundaryArea b) = 0) →
                (∀ (b : M.Boundary),
                    CFDLean.Boundary.patchKind M k b = CFDLean.Boundary.Kind.prescribedExteriorRoe →
                      CFDLean.Boundary.patchExterior M V b = U) →
                  CFDLean.Boundary.meshResidual M γ k V (fun x => U) i = 0

CFDLean.Boundary.mesh_global_balance.name: CFDLean.Boundary.mesh_global_balance
CFDLean.Boundary.mesh_global_balance.raw_type:
∀ {n m : Nat} (M : CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData n m) (γ : Real) (k : Finset (Fin n) → CFDLean.Boundary.Kind)
  (V : Finset (Fin n) → CFDLean.Conservative (OfNat.ofNat 3)) (U : Fin n → CFDLean.Conservative (OfNat.ofNat 3)),
  Eq (Finset.univ.sum fun i => CFDLean.Boundary.meshResidual M γ k V U i)
    (Finset.univ.sum fun b => CFDLean.Boundary.patchTransfer M γ k V U b)
CFDLean.Boundary.mesh_global_balance.type:
∀ {n m : ℕ} (M : CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData n m) (γ : ℝ) (k : Finset (Fin n) → CFDLean.Boundary.Kind)
  (V : Finset (Fin n) → CFDLean.Conservative 3) (U : Fin n → CFDLean.Conservative 3),
  ∑ i, CFDLean.Boundary.meshResidual M γ k V U i = ∑ b, CFDLean.Boundary.patchTransfer M γ k V U b

CFDLean.Boundary.mesh_residual_reindex.name: CFDLean.Boundary.mesh_residual_reindex
CFDLean.Boundary.mesh_residual_reindex.raw_type:
∀ {n m : Nat} {N' : Type u_4} {E' : Type u_5} {B' : Type u_6} [inst : DecidableEq N'] [inst_1 : Fintype E']
  [inst_2 : Fintype B'] (M : CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData n m) (nodeEq : Equiv (Fin n) N') (e : Equiv M.Edge E')
  (b : Equiv M.Boundary B') (γ : Real) (k : Finset (Fin n) → CFDLean.Boundary.Kind)
  (V : Finset (Fin n) → CFDLean.Conservative (OfNat.ofNat 3)) (U : Fin n → CFDLean.Conservative (OfNat.ofNat 3))
  (i : Fin n),
  Eq
    (CFDLean.Boundary.stationaryResidual (M.interfaces.reindex nodeEq e b) γ
      (fun x => CFDLean.Boundary.patchKind M k (DFunLike.coe b.symm x))
      (fun x => CFDLean.Boundary.patchExterior M V (DFunLike.coe b.symm x)) (fun x => U (DFunLike.coe nodeEq.symm x))
      (fun x => M.edgeArea (DFunLike.coe e.symm x)) (fun x => M.boundaryArea (DFunLike.coe b.symm x))
      (DFunLike.coe nodeEq i))
    (CFDLean.Boundary.meshResidual M γ k V U i)
CFDLean.Boundary.mesh_residual_reindex.type:
∀ {n m : ℕ} {N' : Type u_4} {E' : Type u_5} {B' : Type u_6} [inst : DecidableEq N'] [inst_1 : Fintype E']
  [inst_2 : Fintype B'] (M : CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData n m) (nodeEq : Fin n ≃ N') (e : M.Edge ≃ E')
  (b : M.Boundary ≃ B') (γ : ℝ) (k : Finset (Fin n) → CFDLean.Boundary.Kind)
  (V : Finset (Fin n) → CFDLean.Conservative 3) (U : Fin n → CFDLean.Conservative 3) (i : Fin n),
  CFDLean.Boundary.stationaryResidual (M.interfaces.reindex nodeEq e b) γ
      (fun x => CFDLean.Boundary.patchKind M k (b.symm x)) (fun x => CFDLean.Boundary.patchExterior M V (b.symm x))
      (fun x => U (nodeEq.symm x)) (fun x => M.edgeArea (e.symm x)) (fun x => M.boundaryArea (b.symm x)) (nodeEq i) =
    CFDLean.Boundary.meshResidual M γ k V U i

                (CFDLean.Coordinates.unitNormal T))

CFDLean.Boundary.residual_boundary_diffe.raw_type:

  (g h : B → CFDLean.Coordinates.StateCoordinates) (i : N),
  Eq (CFDLean.Assembly.residual m f g i)
    (HAdd.hAdd (CFDLean.Assembly.residual m f h i)
      (Finset.univ.sum fun b => ite (Eq (m.owner b) i) (HSub.hSub (g b) (h b)) (OfNat.ofNat 0)))
CFDLean.Boundary.residual_boundary_diffe.type:
∀ {N : Type u_1} {E : Type u_2} {B : Type u_3} [inst : DecidableEq N] [inst_1 : Fintype E] [inst_2 : Fintype B]

  (g h : B → CFDLean.Coordinates.StateCoordinates) (i : N),
  CFDLean.Assembly.residual m f g i = CFDLean.Assembly.residual m f h i + ∑ b, if m.owner b = i then g b - h b else 0

  (S : E → CFDLean.Vector (OfNat.ofNat 3)) (T : B → CFDLean.Vector (OfNat.ofNat 3)) (i : N),
  (∀ (b : B),
      Ne (k b) CFDLean.Boundary.Kind.prescribedExteriorRoe → Eq (CFDLean.dot U.momentum (T b)) (OfNat.ofNat 0)) →
    (∀ (b : B), Eq (k b) CFDLean.Boundary.Kind.prescribedExteriorRoe → Eq (V b) U) →
      Eq (CFDLean.Assembly.metricDefect m S T i) (OfNat.ofNat 0) →
        Eq (CFDLean.Boundary.stationaryResidual m γ k V (fun x => U) S T i) (OfNat.ofNat 0)
CFDLean.Boundary.stationary_common_close.type:

  (U : CFDLean.Conservative 3) (S : E → CFDLean.Vector 3) (T : B → CFDLean.Vector 3) (i : N),
  (∀ (b : B), k b ≠ CFDLean.Boundary.Kind.prescribedExteriorRoe → CFDLean.dot U.momentum (T b) = 0) →
    (∀ (b : B), k b = CFDLean.Boundary.Kind.prescribedExteriorRoe → V b = U) →
      CFDLean.Assembly.metricDefect m S T i = 0 → CFDLean.Boundary.stationaryResidual m γ k V (fun x => U) S T i = 0

CFDLean.Boundary.stationary_common_corre.name: CFDLean.Boundary.stationary_common_correction
CFDLean.Boundary.stationary_common_corre.raw_type:
∀ {N : Type u_1} {E : Type u_2} {B : Type u_3} [inst : DecidableEq N] [inst_1 : Fintype E] [inst_2 : Fintype B]
  (m : CFDLean.Assembly.Interfaces N E B) (γ : Real) (k : B → CFDLean.Boundary.Kind)
  (V : B → CFDLean.Conservative (OfNat.ofNat 3)) (U : CFDLean.Conservative (OfNat.ofNat 3))
  (S : E → CFDLean.Vector (OfNat.ofNat 3)) (T : B → CFDLean.Vector (OfNat.ofNat 3)) (i : N),
  Eq (CFDLean.Boundary.stationaryResidual m γ k V (fun x => U) S T i)
    (HAdd.hAdd (CFDLean.Coordinates.encode (CFDLean.physicalFlux γ U (CFDLean.Assembly.metricDefect m S T i)))
      (Finset.univ.sum fun b =>
        ite (Eq (m.owner b) i)
          (HSub.hSub (CFDLean.Boundary.constructedTransfer m γ k V (fun x => U) T b)
            (DFunLike.coe (CFDLean.Assembly.physicalTransfer γ U) (T b)))
          (OfNat.ofNat 0)))
CFDLean.Boundary.stationary_common_corre.type:
∀ {N : Type u_1} {E : Type u_2} {B : Type u_3} [inst : DecidableEq N] [inst_1 : Fintype E] [inst_2 : Fintype B]
  (m : CFDLean.Assembly.Interfaces N E B) (γ : ℝ) (k : B → CFDLean.Boundary.Kind) (V : B → CFDLean.Conservative 3)
  (U : CFDLean.Conservative 3) (S : E → CFDLean.Vector 3) (T : B → CFDLean.Vector 3) (i : N),
  CFDLean.Boundary.stationaryResidual m γ k V (fun x => U) S T i =
    CFDLean.Coordinates.encode (CFDLean.physicalFlux γ U (CFDLean.Assembly.metricDefect m S T i)) +
      ∑ b,
        if m.owner b = i then
          CFDLean.Boundary.constructedTransfer m γ k V (fun x => U) T b - (CFDLean.Assembly.physicalTransfer γ U) (T b)
        else 0

∀ {N : Type u_1} {E : Type u_2} {B : Type u_3} [inst : DecidableEq N] [inst_1 : Fintype E] [inst_2 : Fintype B]
  [inst_3 : Fintype N] (m : CFDLean.Assembly.Interfaces N E B) (γ : Real) (k : B → CFDLean.Boundary.Kind)
  (V : B → CFDLean.Conservative (OfNat.ofNat 3)) (U : N → CFDLean.Conservative (OfNat.ofNat 3))
  (S : E → CFDLean.Vector (OfNat.ofNat 3)) (T : B → CFDLean.Vector (OfNat.ofNat 3)),
  Eq (Finset.univ.sum fun i => CFDLean.Boundary.stationaryResidual m γ k V U S T i)
    (HAdd.hAdd
      (Finset.univ.sum fun b =>
        ite (Eq (k b) CFDLean.Boundary.Kind.prescribedExteriorRoe)
          (CFDLean.Boundary.prescribedExteriorRoeTransfer γ (U (m.owner b)) (V b) (T b)) (OfNat.ofNat 0))
      (Finset.univ.sum fun b =>
        ite (Eq (k b) CFDLean.Boundary.Kind.prescribedExteriorRoe) (OfNat.ofNat 0)
          (CFDLean.Boundary.wallTransfer γ (U (m.owner b)) (T b))))
CFDLean.Boundary.stationary_mixed_balanc.type:
∀ {N : Type u_1} {E : Type u_2} {B : Type u_3} [inst : DecidableEq N] [inst_1 : Fintype E] [inst_2 : Fintype B]
  [inst_3 : Fintype N] (m : CFDLean.Assembly.Interfaces N E B) (γ : ℝ) (k : B → CFDLean.Boundary.Kind)
  (V : B → CFDLean.Conservative 3) (U : N → CFDLean.Conservative 3) (S : E → CFDLean.Vector 3)
  (T : B → CFDLean.Vector 3),
  ∑ i, CFDLean.Boundary.stationaryResidual m γ k V U S T i =
    (∑ b,
        if k b = CFDLean.Boundary.Kind.prescribedExteriorRoe then
          CFDLean.Boundary.prescribedExteriorRoeTransfer γ (U (m.owner b)) (V b) (T b)
        else 0) +
      ∑ b,
        if k b = CFDLean.Boundary.Kind.prescribedExteriorRoe then 0
        else CFDLean.Boundary.wallTransfer γ (U (m.owner b)) (T b)

CFDLean.Boundary.stationary_momentum_bal.name: CFDLean.Boundary.stationary_momentum_balance
CFDLean.Boundary.stationary_momentum_bal.raw_type:
∀ {N : Type u_1} {E : Type u_2} {B : Type u_3} [inst : DecidableEq N] [inst_1 : Fintype E] [inst_2 : Fintype B]
  [inst_3 : Fintype N] (m : CFDLean.Assembly.Interfaces N E B) (γ : Real) (k : B → CFDLean.Boundary.Kind)
  (V : B → CFDLean.Conservative (OfNat.ofNat 3)) (U : N → CFDLean.Conservative (OfNat.ofNat 3))
  (S : E → CFDLean.Vector (OfNat.ofNat 3)) (T : B → CFDLean.Vector (OfNat.ofNat 3)) (j : Fin (OfNat.ofNat 3)),
  Eq
    (Finset.univ.sum fun i =>
      (CFDLean.Coordinates.decode (CFDLean.Boundary.stationaryResidual m γ k V U S T i)).momentum j)
    (Finset.univ.sum fun b =>
      ite (Eq (k b) CFDLean.Boundary.Kind.prescribedExteriorRoe)
        ((CFDLean.Coordinates.decode
              (CFDLean.Boundary.prescribedExteriorRoeTransfer γ (U (m.owner b)) (V b) (T b))).momentum
          j)
        (HMul.hMul (CFDLean.Conservative.pressure γ (U (m.owner b))) (T b j)))
CFDLean.Boundary.stationary_momentum_bal.type:
∀ {N : Type u_1} {E : Type u_2} {B : Type u_3} [inst : DecidableEq N] [inst_1 : Fintype E] [inst_2 : Fintype B]
  [inst_3 : Fintype N] (m : CFDLean.Assembly.Interfaces N E B) (γ : ℝ) (k : B → CFDLean.Boundary.Kind)
  (V : B → CFDLean.Conservative 3) (U : N → CFDLean.Conservative 3) (S : E → CFDLean.Vector 3)
  (T : B → CFDLean.Vector 3) (j : Fin 3),
  ∑ i, (CFDLean.Coordinates.decode (CFDLean.Boundary.stationaryResidual m γ k V U S T i)).momentum j =
    ∑ b,
      if k b = CFDLean.Boundary.Kind.prescribedExteriorRoe then
        (CFDLean.Coordinates.decode
              (CFDLean.Boundary.prescribedExteriorRoeTransfer γ (U (m.owner b)) (V b) (T b))).momentum
          j
      else CFDLean.Conservative.pressure γ (U (m.owner b)) * T b j

∀ (γ : Real) (U : CFDLean.Conservative (OfNat.ofNat 3)) (T : CFDLean.Vector (OfNat.ofNat 3)) (i : Fin (OfNat.ofNat 3)),
  Eq ((CFDLean.Coordinates.decode (CFDLean.Boundary.wallTransfer γ U T)).momentum i)
    (HMul.hMul (CFDLean.Conservative.pressure γ U) (T i))
CFDLean.Boundary.wall_momentum.type:
∀ (γ : ℝ) (U : CFDLean.Conservative 3) (T : CFDLean.Vector 3) (i : Fin 3),
  (CFDLean.Coordinates.decode (CFDLean.Boundary.wallTransfer γ U T)).momentum i =
    CFDLean.Conservative.pressure γ U * T i

CFDLean.Burgers.Rusanov.eval.eq_1.name: CFDLean.Burgers.Rusanov.eval.eq_1
CFDLean.Burgers.Rusanov.eval.eq_1.raw_type:
∀ (uL uR : Real),
  Eq (CFDLean.Burgers.Rusanov.eval uL uR)
    (HSub.hSub
      (HDiv.hDiv (HAdd.hAdd (CFDLean.Burgers.physicalFlux uL) (CFDLean.Burgers.physicalFlux uR)) (OfNat.ofNat 2))
      (HMul.hMul (HDiv.hDiv (CFDLean.Burgers.Rusanov.waveSpeed uL uR) (OfNat.ofNat 2)) (HSub.hSub uR uL)))
CFDLean.Burgers.Rusanov.eval.eq_1.type:
∀ (uL uR : ℝ),
  CFDLean.Burgers.Rusanov.eval uL uR =
    (CFDLean.Burgers.physicalFlux uL + CFDLean.Burgers.physicalFlux uR) / 2 -
      CFDLean.Burgers.Rusanov.waveSpeed uL uR / 2 * (uR - uL)

CFDLean.Burgers.Rusanov.waveSpeed.eq_1.name: CFDLean.Burgers.Rusanov.waveSpeed.eq_1
CFDLean.Burgers.Rusanov.waveSpeed.eq_1.raw_type: ∀ (uL uR : Real), Eq (CFDLean.Burgers.Rusanov.waveSpeed uL uR) (max (abs uL) (abs uR))
CFDLean.Burgers.Rusanov.waveSpeed.eq_1.type: ∀ (uL uR : ℝ), CFDLean.Burgers.Rusanov.waveSpeed uL uR = max |uL| |uR|

CFDLean.Burgers.Schemes.RusanovForwardEu.raw_type:
∀ {N : Nat} [inst : NeZero N] (dx dt : Real),

CFDLean.Burgers.Schemes.RusanovForwardEu.type:
∀ {N : ℕ} [inst : NeZero N] (dx dt : ℝ),

CFDLean.Burgers.Schemes.RusanovForwardEu.name: CFDLean.Burgers.Schemes.RusanovForwardEuler.step_preserves_sum

CFDLean.Conservative.mk.injEq.name: CFDLean.Conservative.mk.injEq
CFDLean.Conservative.mk.injEq.raw_type:
∀ {d : Nat} (density : Real) (momentum : CFDLean.Vector d) (energy density_1 : Real) (momentum_1 : CFDLean.Vector d)
  (energy_1 : Real),
  Eq
    (Eq { density := density, momentum := momentum, energy := energy }
      { density := density_1, momentum := momentum_1, energy := energy_1 })
    (And (Eq density density_1) (And (Eq momentum momentum_1) (Eq energy energy_1)))
CFDLean.Conservative.mk.injEq.type:
∀ {d : ℕ} (density : ℝ) (momentum : CFDLean.Vector d) (energy density_1 : ℝ) (momentum_1 : CFDLean.Vector d)
  (energy_1 : ℝ),
  ({ density := density, momentum := momentum, energy := energy } =
      { density := density_1, momentum := momentum_1, energy := energy_1 }) =
    (density = density_1 ∧ momentum = momentum_1 ∧ energy = energy_1)

CFDLean.Conservative.mk.sizeOf_spec.name: CFDLean.Conservative.mk.sizeOf_spec
CFDLean.Conservative.mk.sizeOf_spec.raw_type:

    (HAdd.hAdd (HAdd.hAdd (OfNat.ofNat 1) (sizeOf density)) (sizeOf energy))

∀ {d : ℕ} (density : ℝ) (momentum : CFDLean.Vector d) (energy : ℝ),
  sizeOf { density := density, momentum := momentum, energy := energy } = 1 + sizeOf density + sizeOf energy

CFDLean.Conservative.noConfusionType.type: Sort u → {d : ℕ} → CFDLean.Conservative d → {d' : ℕ} → CFDLean.Conservative d' → Sort u

CFDLean.Conservative.pressure.eq_1.name: CFDLean.Conservative.pressure.eq_1
CFDLean.Conservative.pressure.eq_1.raw_type:
∀ {d : Nat} (γ : Real) (U : CFDLean.Conservative d),
  Eq (CFDLean.Conservative.pressure γ U)
    (HMul.hMul (HSub.hSub γ (OfNat.ofNat 1))
      (HSub.hSub U.energy (HDiv.hDiv (CFDLean.squareSum U.momentum) (HMul.hMul (OfNat.ofNat 2) U.density))))
CFDLean.Conservative.pressure.eq_1.type:
∀ {d : ℕ} (γ : ℝ) (U : CFDLean.Conservative d),
  CFDLean.Conservative.pressure γ U = (γ - 1) * (U.energy - CFDLean.squareSum U.momentum / (2 * U.density))

CFDLean.Coordinates.decode.eq_1.name: CFDLean.Coordinates.decode.eq_1

  Eq (CFDLean.Coordinates.decode x)
    { density := x ⟨0, Fin.instOfNat⟩,
      momentum :=
        Matrix.vecCons (x ⟨1, Fin.instOfNat⟩)
          (Matrix.vecCons (x ⟨2, Fin.instOfNat⟩) (Matrix.vecCons (x ⟨3, Fin.instOfNat⟩) Matrix.vecEmpty)),
      energy := x ⟨4, Fin.instOfNat⟩ }
CFDLean.Coordinates.decode.eq_1.type:
∀ (x : CFDLean.Coordinates.StateCoordinates),
  CFDLean.Coordinates.decode x = { density := x 0, momentum := ![x 1, x 2, x 3], energy := x 4 }

CFDLean.Coordinates.dot_three.name: CFDLean.Coordinates.dot_three
CFDLean.Coordinates.dot_three.raw_type:
∀ (v w : CFDLean.Vector (OfNat.ofNat 3)),
  Eq (CFDLean.dot v w)
    (HAdd.hAdd
      (HAdd.hAdd (HMul.hMul (v ⟨0, Fin.instOfNat⟩) (w ⟨0, Fin.instOfNat⟩))
        (HMul.hMul (v ⟨1, Fin.instOfNat⟩) (w ⟨1, Fin.instOfNat⟩)))
      (HMul.hMul (v ⟨2, Fin.instOfNat⟩) (w ⟨2, Fin.instOfNat⟩)))
CFDLean.Coordinates.dot_three.type: ∀ (v w : CFDLean.Vector 3), CFDLean.dot v w = v 0 * w 0 + v 1 * w 1 + v 2 * w 2

  Eq (CFDLean.Coordinates.encode U)
    (Matrix.vecCons U.density
      (Matrix.vecCons (U.momentum ⟨0, Fin.instOfNat⟩)
        (Matrix.vecCons (U.momentum ⟨1, Fin.instOfNat⟩)
          (Matrix.vecCons (U.momentum ⟨2, Fin.instOfNat⟩) (Matrix.vecCons U.energy Matrix.vecEmpty)))))
CFDLean.Coordinates.encode.eq_1.type:
∀ (U : CFDLean.Conservative 3),
  CFDLean.Coordinates.encode U = ![U.density, U.momentum 0, U.momentum 1, U.momentum 2, U.energy]

CFDLean.Coordinates.squareSum_three.name: CFDLean.Coordinates.squareSum_three

    (HAdd.hAdd
      (HAdd.hAdd (HPow.hPow (v ⟨0, Fin.instOfNat⟩) (OfNat.ofNat 2)) (HPow.hPow (v ⟨1, Fin.instOfNat⟩) (OfNat.ofNat 2)))
      (HPow.hPow (v ⟨2, Fin.instOfNat⟩) (OfNat.ofNat 2)))
CFDLean.Coordinates.squareSum_three.type: ∀ (v : CFDLean.Vector 3), CFDLean.squareSum v = v 0 ^ 2 + v 1 ^ 2 + v 2 ^ 2

CFDLean.Coordinates.unitNormal.eq_1.name: CFDLean.Coordinates.unitNormal.eq_1

CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Ad2W.sharp_core.name: CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Ad2W.sharp_core
CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Ad2W.sharp_core.raw_type:
∀ {κ : Type} [inst : Fintype κ] {d : Nat} (T : CFDLean.Num.Simplex d)
  (K : Matrix κ (Fin d) Real → Matrix κ (Fin d) Real),
  IsLinearMap Real K →
    ∀ (P : Matrix κ κ Real) (gw : κ → Real) (o : Fin (HAdd.hAdd d (OfNat.ofNat 1))) (c : Real) (e b : κ → Real),
      LE.le (OfNat.ofNat 1) d →
        T.Nondeg →
          Eq (P.mulVec (HSub.hSub (HAdd.hAdd b e) gw)) e →
            Eq
              (HSub.hSub (CFDLean.JST1.Wall.Dgal T K (CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Ad2W.wit T o e b))
                (CFDLean.JST1.Wall.PiW T K P gw (singleton o) c (CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Ad2W.wit T o e b)))
              (HMul.hMul (HSub.hSub c (OfNat.ofNat 1))
                (HDiv.hDiv
                  (HMul.hMul (HPow.hPow (CFDLean.JST1.Wall.area T o) (OfNat.ofNat 2))
                    (CFDLean.Num.frob (CFDLean.JST1.Wall.outerK e (CFDLean.JST1.Wall.normal T o))
                      (K (CFDLean.JST1.Wall.outerK e (CFDLean.JST1.Wall.normal T o)))))
                  T.vol))
CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Ad2W.sharp_core.type:
∀ {κ : Type} [inst : Fintype κ] {d : ℕ} (T : CFDLean.Num.Simplex d) (K : Matrix κ (Fin d) ℝ → Matrix κ (Fin d) ℝ),
  IsLinearMap ℝ K →
    ∀ (P : Matrix κ κ ℝ) (gw : κ → ℝ) (o : Fin (d + 1)) (c : ℝ) (e b : κ → ℝ),
      1 ≤ d →
        T.Nondeg →
          P.mulVec (b + e - gw) = e →
            CFDLean.JST1.Wall.Dgal T K (CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Ad2W.wit T o e b) -
                CFDLean.JST1.Wall.PiW T K P gw {o} c (CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Ad2W.wit T o e b) =
              (c - 1) *
                (CFDLean.JST1.Wall.area T o ^ 2 *
                    CFDLean.Num.frob (CFDLean.JST1.Wall.outerK e (CFDLean.JST1.Wall.normal T o))
                      (K (CFDLean.JST1.Wall.outerK e (CFDLean.JST1.Wall.normal T o))) /
                  T.vol)

                          (CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Asm11.sF k f (CFDLean.JST1.Mixed.oppV t f (CFDLean.JST1.Spec.kz k)))

                        (OfNat.ofNat 0)))).and
              ((CFDLean.JST1.Spec.onCellFace k.cell f).not.or
                (decide
                  (LT.lt (OfNat.ofNat 0)
                    (HMul.hMul (CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Asm11.sF k f (CFDLean.JST1.Mixed.oppV t f (CFDLean.JST1.Spec.kz k)))
                      (CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Asm11.cF k f)))))))

                        CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Asm11.sF k f (CFDLean.JST1.Mixed.oppV t' f (CFDLean.JST1.Spec.kz k)) <

        Ne i0 i2 →

                (HSMul.hSMul

                    (CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Asm11.sg
                      (CFDLean.JST1.Mixed.sideOf (W.pos i0) (W.pos i1) (W.pos i2)
                        (W.pos (DFunLike.coe (W.vert p.1) p.2)))))

  (∀ (i : ι), CFDLean.JST1.Admissible S.g (u i)) →
    (∀ (q : Q), CFDLean.JST1.Admissible S.g (S.ut q)) →
      (∀ (q : Q), Eq (Finset.univ.sum fun k => S.φ q k) (OfNat.ofNat 1)) →
        (∀ (q : Q),
            Eq (CFDLean.JST1.entropyVars S.g (S.ut q))
              (Finset.univ.sum fun k => HSMul.hSMul (S.φ q k) (CFDLean.JST1.entropyVars S.g (u k)))) →
          Eq
            (Neg.neg
              (Finset.univ.sum fun i =>
                CFDLean.Num.pairF (CFDLean.JST1.Scheme.w S u i) (CFDLean.JST1.Scheme.closure S u i)))
            (HSub.hSub (CFDLean.JST1.Scheme.Bterm S)
              (Finset.univ.sum fun i =>
                CFDLean.Num.dot (CFDLean.JST1.fluxPot (u i)) (Finset.univ.sum fun q => HSMul.hSMul (S.φ q i) (S.N q))))

        (∀ (q : Q), CFDLean.JST1.entropyVars S.g (S.ut q) = ∑ k, S.φ q k • CFDLean.JST1.entropyVars S.g (u k)) →
          -∑ i, CFDLean.Num.pairF (CFDLean.JST1.Scheme.w S u i) (CFDLean.JST1.Scheme.closure S u i) =

  M.Valid →
    LE.le (OfNat.ofNat 1) d →
      M.FacetBalanced bd →
        (∀ (q : Q), Eq (bd (fq q)) true) →
          (∀ (q : Q) (k : ι), Not (Membership.mem (M.facetNodes (fq q)) k) → Eq (φ q k) (OfNat.ofNat 0)) →
            (∀ (p : Prod C (Fin (HAdd.hAdd d (OfNat.ofNat 1)))),
                Eq (bd p) true →
                  ∀ (i : ι),
                    Membership.mem (M.facetNodes p) i →
                      Eq (Finset.univ.sum fun q => ite (Eq (fq q) p) (HMul.hMul (aq q) (φ q i)) (OfNat.ofNat 0))
                        (HDiv.hDiv (OfNat.ofNat 1) d.cast)) →
              (∀ (q : Q), Eq (N q) (HSMul.hSMul (aq q) (M.areaVec (fq q)))) →
                ∀ (i : ι), Eq (Finset.univ.sum fun q => HSMul.hSMul (φ q i) (N q)) (M.beta i)

  (φ : Q → ι → ℝ) (N : Q → CFDLean.Num.Vec d),
  M.Valid →
    1 ≤ d →
      M.FacetBalanced bd →
        (∀ (q : Q), bd (fq q) = true) →
          (∀ (q : Q), ∀ k ∉ M.facetNodes (fq q), φ q k = 0) →
            (∀ (p : C × Fin (d + 1)),
                bd p = true → ∀ i ∈ M.facetNodes p, (∑ q, if fq q = p then aq q * φ q i else 0) = 1 / ↑d) →
              (∀ (q : Q), N q = aq q • M.areaVec (fq q)) → ∀ (i : ι), ∑ q, φ q i • N q = M.beta i

CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Def13.slope_prod.raw_type:
∀ {ι : Type} [inst : Fintype ι] (f h : ι → Real → Real) (f' h' : ι → Real),
  (∀ (i : ι), HasDerivAt (f i) (f' i) (OfNat.ofNat 0)) →
    (∀ (i : ι), HasDerivAt (h i) (h' i) (OfNat.ofNat 0)) →
      Filter.Tendsto
        (fun t =>
          HDiv.hDiv
            (Finset.univ.sum fun i =>
              HMul.hMul (HSub.hSub (f i t) (f i (OfNat.ofNat 0))) (HSub.hSub (h i t) (h i (OfNat.ofNat 0))))
            (HPow.hPow t (OfNat.ofNat 2)))
        (nhdsWithin (OfNat.ofNat 0) (compl (singleton (OfNat.ofNat 0))))
        (nhds (Finset.univ.sum fun i => HMul.hMul (f' i) (h' i)))

  (∀ (i : ι), HasDerivAt (f i) (f' i) 0) →
    (∀ (i : ι), HasDerivAt (h i) (h' i) 0) →
      Filter.Tendsto (fun t => (∑ i, (f i t - f i 0) * (h i t - h i 0)) / t ^ 2) (nhdsWithin 0 {0}ᶜ)
        (nhds (∑ i, f' i * h' i))

CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Geo3.facet_cross.raw_type:

  T.Nondeg →
    (List.cons o (List.cons a (List.cons b (List.cons c List.nil)))).Nodup →
      Eq (T.facet o)

          (ite
            (LT.lt (OfNat.ofNat 0)
              (CFDLean.Num.dot (CFDLean.Num.cross3 (HSub.hSub (T.x b) (T.x a)) (HSub.hSub (T.x c) (T.x a)))
                (HSub.hSub (T.x o) (T.x a))))
            (Neg.neg (HDiv.hDiv (OfNat.ofNat 1) (OfNat.ofNat 2))) (HDiv.hDiv (OfNat.ofNat 1) (OfNat.ofNat 2)))

      T.facet o =
        (if 0 < CFDLean.Num.dot (CFDLean.Num.cross3 (T.x b - T.x a) (T.x c - T.x a)) (T.x o - T.x a) then -(1 / 2)
          else 1 / 2) •

CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Geo3.triple_perm.raw_type:

  (List.cons o (List.cons a (List.cons b (List.cons c List.nil)))).Nodup →
    Or
      (Eq (CFDLean.Num.dot (CFDLean.Num.cross3 (HSub.hSub (p b) (p a)) (HSub.hSub (p c) (p a))) (HSub.hSub (p o) (p a)))
        (CFDLean.Num.dot
          (CFDLean.Num.cross3 (HSub.hSub (p ⟨1, Fin.instOfNat⟩) (p ⟨0, Fin.instOfNat⟩))
            (HSub.hSub (p ⟨2, Fin.instOfNat⟩) (p ⟨0, Fin.instOfNat⟩)))
          (HSub.hSub (p ⟨3, Fin.instOfNat⟩) (p ⟨0, Fin.instOfNat⟩))))
      (Eq (CFDLean.Num.dot (CFDLean.Num.cross3 (HSub.hSub (p b) (p a)) (HSub.hSub (p c) (p a))) (HSub.hSub (p o) (p a)))
        (Neg.neg
          (CFDLean.Num.dot
            (CFDLean.Num.cross3 (HSub.hSub (p ⟨1, Fin.instOfNat⟩) (p ⟨0, Fin.instOfNat⟩))
              (HSub.hSub (p ⟨2, Fin.instOfNat⟩) (p ⟨0, Fin.instOfNat⟩)))
            (HSub.hSub (p ⟨3, Fin.instOfNat⟩) (p ⟨0, Fin.instOfNat⟩)))))
CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Geo3.triple_perm.type:

    CFDLean.Num.dot (CFDLean.Num.cross3 (p b - p a) (p c - p a)) (p o - p a) =
        CFDLean.Num.dot (CFDLean.Num.cross3 (p 1 - p 0) (p 2 - p 0)) (p 3 - p 0) ∨
      CFDLean.Num.dot (CFDLean.Num.cross3 (p b - p a) (p c - p a)) (p o - p a) =
        -CFDLean.Num.dot (CFDLean.Num.cross3 (p 1 - p 0) (p 2 - p 0)) (p 3 - p 0)

CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Sst10.Gv_tau.name: CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Sst10.Gv_tau
CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Sst10.Gv_tau.raw_type:
∀ {d : Nat} (D : CFDLean.JST1.SSTPoint.Data d),
  Eq (Finset.univ.sum fun α => Finset.univ.sum fun β => HMul.hMul (D.Gv α β) (CFDLean.JST1.SSTPoint.tau D α β))
    (HMul.hMul (HAdd.hAdd D.μ D.μt) (CFDLean.JST1.SSTPoint.Q D))

CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Sst10.Pi_form.name: CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Sst10.Pi_form
CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Sst10.Pi_form.raw_type:
∀ {d : Nat} (D : CFDLean.JST1.SSTPoint.Data d),
  Ne D.R (OfNat.ofNat 0) →
    Ne D.T (OfNat.ofNat 0) →
      Eq (CFDLean.JST1.SSTPoint.Pi D)
        (HAdd.hAdd
          (HSub.hSub
            (HMul.hMul (Neg.neg (CFDLean.JST1.SSTPoint.theta D))
              (HAdd.hAdd
                (HAdd.hAdd (HMul.hMul D.μ (CFDLean.JST1.SSTPoint.Q D))
                  (HSub.hSub (HMul.hMul D.μt (CFDLean.JST1.SSTPoint.Q D)) D.Pk))
                D.ε))
            (HDiv.hDiv (HMul.hMul D.κ (CFDLean.Num.dot D.GT D.GT)) (HMul.hMul D.R (HPow.hPow D.T (OfNat.ofNat 2)))))
          (ite (Eq D.withDk true) (OfNat.ofNat 0)
            (Neg.neg (HMul.hMul D.Dk (CFDLean.Num.dot D.Gk (CFDLean.JST1.SSTPoint.Gtheta D))))))
CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Sst10.Pi_form.type:
∀ {d : ℕ} (D : CFDLean.JST1.SSTPoint.Data d),
  D.R ≠ 0 →
    D.T ≠ 0 →
      CFDLean.JST1.SSTPoint.Pi D =
        -CFDLean.JST1.SSTPoint.theta D *
              (D.μ * CFDLean.JST1.SSTPoint.Q D + (D.μt * CFDLean.JST1.SSTPoint.Q D - D.Pk) + D.ε) -
            D.κ * CFDLean.Num.dot D.GT D.GT / (D.R * D.T ^ 2) +
          if D.withDk = true then 0 else -(D.Dk * CFDLean.Num.dot D.Gk (CFDLean.JST1.SSTPoint.Gtheta D))

CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Sst10.Q_form.name: CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Sst10.Q_form
CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Sst10.Q_form.raw_type:
∀ {d : Nat} (D : CFDLean.JST1.SSTPoint.Data d),
  Eq (CFDLean.JST1.SSTPoint.Q D)
    (HSub.hSub
      (Finset.univ.sum fun α => Finset.univ.sum fun β => HMul.hMul (D.Gv α β) (HAdd.hAdd (D.Gv α β) (D.Gv β α)))
      (HMul.hMul (HDiv.hDiv (OfNat.ofNat 2) (OfNat.ofNat 3))
        (HPow.hPow (Finset.univ.sum fun γ => D.Gv γ γ) (OfNat.ofNat 2))))
CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Sst10.Q_form.type:
∀ {d : ℕ} (D : CFDLean.JST1.SSTPoint.Data d),
  CFDLean.JST1.SSTPoint.Q D = ∑ α, ∑ β, D.Gv α β * (D.Gv α β + D.Gv β α) - 2 / 3 * (∑ γ, D.Gv γ γ) ^ 2

  LE.le (OfNat.ofNat 0) a →
    LE.le (OfNat.ofNat 0) b →
      LT.lt (OfNat.ofNat 0) r1 →

                (HMul.hMul (HAdd.hAdd (HMul.hMul a x) (HMul.hMul b y)) (HAdd.hAdd (HMul.hMul a x) (HMul.hMul b y)))

              (HAdd.hAdd (HMul.hMul a (HDiv.hDiv (HMul.hMul x x) (HMul.hMul (OfNat.ofNat 2) r1)))

CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Sst10.schanEquiv.type: (d : ℕ) → CFDLean.JST1.SChan d ≃ CFDLean.JST1.Channel d ⊕ Unit ⊕ Unit

CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Sst10.schanEquiv._pr.name: CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Sst10.schanEquiv._proof_1
CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Sst10.schanEquiv._pr.raw_type:
∀ (d : Nat) (c : CFDLean.JST1.SChan d),
  Eq
    (CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Sst10.schanEquiv.match_3 d (fun x => CFDLean.JST1.SChan d)
      (CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Sst10.schanEquiv.match_1 d (fun x => Sum (CFDLean.JST1.Channel d) (Sum Unit Unit)) c
        (fun c => Sum.inl c) (fun _ => Sum.inr (Sum.inl Unit.unit)) fun _ => Sum.inr (Sum.inr Unit.unit))
      (fun c => CFDLean.JST1.SChan.flow c) (fun val => CFDLean.JST1.SChan.tke) fun val => CFDLean.JST1.SChan.omg)
    c
CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.Sst10.schanEquiv._pr.type:
∀ (d : ℕ) (c : CFDLean.JST1.SChan d),
  (match
      match c with
      | CFDLean.JST1.SChan.flow c => Sum.inl c
      | CFDLean.JST1.SChan.tke => Sum.inr (Sum.inl ())
      | CFDLean.JST1.SChan.omg => Sum.inr (Sum.inr ()) with
    | Sum.inl c => CFDLean.JST1.SChan.flow c
    | Sum.inr (Sum.inl val) => CFDLean.JST1.SChan.tke

CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.decomp_rest.raw_type:
∀ {d : Nat} (g : CFDLean.JST1.Gas) {r1 p1 r2 p2 : Real},
  LT.lt (OfNat.ofNat 0) r1 →
    LT.lt (OfNat.ofNat 0) p1 →
      LT.lt (OfNat.ofNat 0) r2 →
        LT.lt (OfNat.ofNat 0) p2 →
          have Ui := CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.restState g r1 p1;
          have Uk := CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.restState g r2 p2;
          And
            (Eq
              (CFDLean.Num.pairF (HSub.hSub (CFDLean.JST1.entropyVars g Uk) (CFDLean.JST1.entropyVars g Ui))
                (HSub.hSub Uk Ui))
              (CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.thQ g.γ r1 p1 r2 p2))
            (Eq
              (CFDLean.Num.pairF (HSub.hSub (CFDLean.JST1.entropyVars g Uk) (CFDLean.JST1.entropyVars g Ui))
                (HSub.hSub (CFDLean.JST1.enthalpyState g Uk) (CFDLean.JST1.enthalpyState g Ui)))
              (CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.thQt g.γ r1 p1 r2 p2))

    0 < p1 →
      0 < r2 →
        0 < p2 →
          have Ui := CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.restState g r1 p1;
          have Uk := CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.restState g r2 p2;
          CFDLean.Num.pairF (CFDLean.JST1.entropyVars g Uk - CFDLean.JST1.entropyVars g Ui) (Uk - Ui) =
              CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.thQ g.γ r1 p1 r2 p2 ∧
            CFDLean.Num.pairF (CFDLean.JST1.entropyVars g Uk - CFDLean.JST1.entropyVars g Ui)
                (CFDLean.JST1.enthalpyState g Uk - CFDLean.JST1.enthalpyState g Ui) =

CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.deriv_alg.name: CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.deriv_alg
CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.deriv_alg.raw_type:
∀ (γ μ ν ds db B R : Real),
  Ne B (OfNat.ofNat 0) →
    Ne (HSub.hSub γ (OfNat.ofNat 1)) (OfNat.ofNat 0) →
      Eq
        (HMul.hMul (HDiv.hDiv R (HSub.hSub γ (OfNat.ofNat 1)))
          (HAdd.hAdd
            (HMul.hMul μ
              (CFDLean.JST1.thermoQ γ
                (HDiv.hDiv (Neg.neg (HAdd.hAdd ds (HDiv.hDiv db B))) (HSub.hSub γ (OfNat.ofNat 1)))
                (HSub.hSub (HDiv.hDiv (Neg.neg (HAdd.hAdd ds (HDiv.hDiv db B))) (HSub.hSub γ (OfNat.ofNat 1)))
                  (HDiv.hDiv db B))))
            (HMul.hMul ν
              (CFDLean.JST1.thermoQt γ
                (HDiv.hDiv (Neg.neg (HAdd.hAdd ds (HDiv.hDiv db B))) (HSub.hSub γ (OfNat.ofNat 1)))
                (HSub.hSub (HDiv.hDiv (Neg.neg (HAdd.hAdd ds (HDiv.hDiv db B))) (HSub.hSub γ (OfNat.ofNat 1)))
                  (HDiv.hDiv db B))))))
        (HDiv.hDiv
          (Neg.neg
            (HAdd.hAdd
              (HMul.hMul (HMul.hMul (HAdd.hAdd μ ν) ds)
                (HMul.hMul R (HDiv.hDiv (Neg.neg (HAdd.hAdd ds (HDiv.hDiv db B))) (HSub.hSub γ (OfNat.ofNat 1)))))
              (HMul.hMul (HMul.hMul (HAdd.hAdd μ (HMul.hMul γ ν)) db)
                (HDiv.hDiv
                  (HSub.hSub
                    (HMul.hMul
                      (HMul.hMul R (HDiv.hDiv (Neg.neg (HAdd.hAdd ds (HDiv.hDiv db B))) (HSub.hSub γ (OfNat.ofNat 1))))
                      B)
                    (HMul.hMul R db))
                  (HPow.hPow B (OfNat.ofNat 2))))))
          (HSub.hSub γ (OfNat.ofNat 1)))
CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.deriv_alg.type:
∀ (γ μ ν ds db B R : ℝ),
  B ≠ 0 →
    γ - 1 ≠ 0 →
      R / (γ - 1) *
          (μ * CFDLean.JST1.thermoQ γ (-(ds + db / B) / (γ - 1)) (-(ds + db / B) / (γ - 1) - db / B) +
            ν * CFDLean.JST1.thermoQt γ (-(ds + db / B) / (γ - 1)) (-(ds + db / B) / (γ - 1) - db / B)) =
        -((μ + ν) * ds * (R * (-(ds + db / B) / (γ - 1))) +
              (μ + γ * ν) * db * ((R * (-(ds + db / B) / (γ - 1)) * B - R * db) / B ^ 2)) /
          (γ - 1)

CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.exists_jump.name: CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.exists_jump
CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.exists_jump.raw_type:
∀ {γ a b c ε : Real},
  LT.lt (OfNat.ofNat 1) γ →
    LT.lt (OfNat.ofNat 0) (CFDLean.JST1.thermoQ γ a b) →
      Eq (CFDLean.JST1.thermoQt γ a b) (HMul.hMul c (CFDLean.JST1.thermoQ γ a b)) →
        LT.lt (OfNat.ofNat 0) ε →
          Exists fun h =>
            And
              (LT.lt (OfNat.ofNat 0)
                (CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.thQ γ (OfNat.ofNat 1) (OfNat.ofNat 1) (Real.exp (HMul.hMul h a))
                  (Real.exp (HMul.hMul h b))))
              (And
                (LT.lt
                  (CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.thQt γ (OfNat.ofNat 1) (OfNat.ofNat 1) (Real.exp (HMul.hMul h a))
                    (Real.exp (HMul.hMul h b)))
                  (HMul.hMul (HAdd.hAdd c ε)
                    (CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.thQ γ (OfNat.ofNat 1) (OfNat.ofNat 1) (Real.exp (HMul.hMul h a))
                      (Real.exp (HMul.hMul h b)))))
                (LT.lt
                  (HMul.hMul (HSub.hSub c ε)
                    (CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.thQ γ (OfNat.ofNat 1) (OfNat.ofNat 1) (Real.exp (HMul.hMul h a))
                      (Real.exp (HMul.hMul h b))))
                  (CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.thQt γ (OfNat.ofNat 1) (OfNat.ofNat 1) (Real.exp (HMul.hMul h a))
                    (Real.exp (HMul.hMul h b)))))
CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.exists_jump.type:
∀ {γ a b c ε : ℝ},
  1 < γ →
    0 < CFDLean.JST1.thermoQ γ a b →
      CFDLean.JST1.thermoQt γ a b = c * CFDLean.JST1.thermoQ γ a b →
        0 < ε →
          ∃ h,
            0 < CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.thQ γ 1 1 (Real.exp (h * a)) (Real.exp (h * b)) ∧
              CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.thQt γ 1 1 (Real.exp (h * a)) (Real.exp (h * b)) <
                  (c + ε) * CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.thQ γ 1 1 (Real.exp (h * a)) (Real.exp (h * b)) ∧
                (c - ε) * CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.thQ γ 1 1 (Real.exp (h * a)) (Real.exp (h * b)) <
                  CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.thQt γ 1 1 (Real.exp (h * a)) (Real.exp (h * b))

CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.frob_visc.name: CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.frob_visc
CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.frob_visc.raw_type:
∀ {d : Nat} (P : CFDLean.JST1.ViscParams) (wb : CFDLean.JST1.State d)
  (G H : Matrix (CFDLean.JST1.Channel d) (Fin d) Real),
  Ne (CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.thetaF wb) (OfNat.ofNat 0) →
    Eq (CFDLean.Num.frob G (CFDLean.JST1.viscFlux P wb H))
      (HAdd.hAdd
        (HMul.hMul (CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.thetaF wb)
          (Finset.univ.sum fun α =>
            Finset.univ.sum fun β =>
              HMul.hMul (CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.DvF wb G α β) (CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.tauF P wb H α β)))
        (HMul.hMul P.κ
          (Finset.univ.sum fun β => HMul.hMul (G CFDLean.JST1.Channel.energy β) (CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.DTF P wb H β))))
CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.frob_visc.type:
∀ {d : ℕ} (P : CFDLean.JST1.ViscParams) (wb : CFDLean.JST1.State d) (G H : Matrix (CFDLean.JST1.Channel d) (Fin d) ℝ),
  CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.thetaF wb ≠ 0 →
    CFDLean.Num.frob G (CFDLean.JST1.viscFlux P wb H) =
      CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.thetaF wb * ∑ α, ∑ β, CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.DvF wb G α β * CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.tauF P wb H α β +
        P.κ * ∑ β, G CFDLean.JST1.Channel.energy β * CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.DTF P wb H β

CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.hasDerivAt_pK.name: CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.hasDerivAt_pK
CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.hasDerivAt_pK.raw_type:
∀ {γ μ ν s1 ds β1 db t : Real},
  Ne (HSub.hSub γ (OfNat.ofNat 1)) (OfNat.ofNat 0) →
    LT.lt (OfNat.ofNat 0) (CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.pβ β1 db t) →
      HasDerivAt (CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.pK γ μ ν s1 ds β1 db)
        (HMul.hMul (HDiv.hDiv (CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.pρ γ s1 ds β1 db t) (HSub.hSub γ (OfNat.ofNat 1)))
          (HAdd.hAdd
            (HMul.hMul μ
              (CFDLean.JST1.thermoQ γ
                (HDiv.hDiv (Neg.neg (HAdd.hAdd ds (HDiv.hDiv db (CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.pβ β1 db t))))
                  (HSub.hSub γ (OfNat.ofNat 1)))
                (HSub.hSub
                  (HDiv.hDiv (Neg.neg (HAdd.hAdd ds (HDiv.hDiv db (CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.pβ β1 db t))))
                    (HSub.hSub γ (OfNat.ofNat 1)))
                  (HDiv.hDiv db (CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.pβ β1 db t)))))
            (HMul.hMul ν
              (CFDLean.JST1.thermoQt γ
                (HDiv.hDiv (Neg.neg (HAdd.hAdd ds (HDiv.hDiv db (CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.pβ β1 db t))))
                  (HSub.hSub γ (OfNat.ofNat 1)))
                (HSub.hSub
                  (HDiv.hDiv (Neg.neg (HAdd.hAdd ds (HDiv.hDiv db (CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.pβ β1 db t))))
                    (HSub.hSub γ (OfNat.ofNat 1)))
                  (HDiv.hDiv db (CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.pβ β1 db t)))))))
        t
CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.hasDerivAt_pK.type:
∀ {γ μ ν s1 ds β1 db t : ℝ},
  γ - 1 ≠ 0 →
    0 < CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.pβ β1 db t →
      HasDerivAt (CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.pK γ μ ν s1 ds β1 db)
        (CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.pρ γ s1 ds β1 db t / (γ - 1) *
          (μ *
              CFDLean.JST1.thermoQ γ (-(ds + db / CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.pβ β1 db t) / (γ - 1))
                (-(ds + db / CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.pβ β1 db t) / (γ - 1) - db / CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.pβ β1 db t) +
            ν *
              CFDLean.JST1.thermoQt γ (-(ds + db / CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.pβ β1 db t) / (γ - 1))
                (-(ds + db / CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.pβ β1 db t) / (γ - 1) - db / CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.pβ β1 db t)))
        t

CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.mom_sum.name: CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.mom_sum
CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.mom_sum.raw_type:
∀ {d : Nat} (g : CFDLean.JST1.Gas) {Ui Uk : CFDLean.JST1.State d},
  Ne (CFDLean.JST1.rho Ui) (OfNat.ofNat 0) →
    Ne (CFDLean.JST1.rho Uk) (OfNat.ofNat 0) →
      Eq
        (Finset.univ.sum fun α =>
          HMul.hMul
            (HSub.hSub (CFDLean.JST1.entropyVars g Uk) (CFDLean.JST1.entropyVars g Ui)
              (CFDLean.JST1.Channel.momentum α))
            (HSub.hSub Uk Ui (CFDLean.JST1.Channel.momentum α)))
        (HAdd.hAdd
          (HSub.hSub
            (HMul.hMul (HDiv.hDiv (HMul.hMul (CFDLean.JST1.rho Uk) (CFDLean.JST1.rho Uk)) (CFDLean.JST1.pressure g Uk))
              (CFDLean.Num.dot (CFDLean.JST1.vel Uk) (CFDLean.JST1.vel Uk)))
            (HMul.hMul
              (HAdd.hAdd
                (HMul.hMul (HDiv.hDiv (CFDLean.JST1.rho Uk) (CFDLean.JST1.pressure g Uk)) (CFDLean.JST1.rho Ui))
                (HMul.hMul (HDiv.hDiv (CFDLean.JST1.rho Ui) (CFDLean.JST1.pressure g Ui)) (CFDLean.JST1.rho Uk)))
              (CFDLean.Num.dot (CFDLean.JST1.vel Uk) (CFDLean.JST1.vel Ui))))
          (HMul.hMul (HDiv.hDiv (HMul.hMul (CFDLean.JST1.rho Ui) (CFDLean.JST1.rho Ui)) (CFDLean.JST1.pressure g Ui))
            (CFDLean.Num.dot (CFDLean.JST1.vel Ui) (CFDLean.JST1.vel Ui))))
CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.mom_sum.type:
∀ {d : ℕ} (g : CFDLean.JST1.Gas) {Ui Uk : CFDLean.JST1.State d},
  CFDLean.JST1.rho Ui ≠ 0 →
    CFDLean.JST1.rho Uk ≠ 0 →
      ∑ α,
          (CFDLean.JST1.entropyVars g Uk - CFDLean.JST1.entropyVars g Ui) (CFDLean.JST1.Channel.momentum α) *
            (Uk - Ui) (CFDLean.JST1.Channel.momentum α) =
        CFDLean.JST1.rho Uk * CFDLean.JST1.rho Uk / CFDLean.JST1.pressure g Uk *
              CFDLean.Num.dot (CFDLean.JST1.vel Uk) (CFDLean.JST1.vel Uk) -
            (CFDLean.JST1.rho Uk / CFDLean.JST1.pressure g Uk * CFDLean.JST1.rho Ui +
                CFDLean.JST1.rho Ui / CFDLean.JST1.pressure g Ui * CFDLean.JST1.rho Uk) *
              CFDLean.Num.dot (CFDLean.JST1.vel Uk) (CFDLean.JST1.vel Ui) +
          CFDLean.JST1.rho Ui * CFDLean.JST1.rho Ui / CFDLean.JST1.pressure g Ui *
            CFDLean.Num.dot (CFDLean.JST1.vel Ui) (CFDLean.JST1.vel Ui)

CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.sum_ite_share.name: CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.sum_ite_share
CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.sum_ite_share.raw_type:
∀ {ι σ : Type} [inst : Fintype σ] (ω : σ → Real) (χ : σ → ι → ι → Bool) (i k : ι) (X : Real),
  Eq (Finset.univ.sum fun s => HMul.hMul (ω s) (ite (Eq (χ s i k) true) X (OfNat.ofNat 0)))
    (HMul.hMul (CFDLean.JST1.piShare ω χ i k) X)
CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.sum_ite_share.type:
∀ {ι σ : Type} [inst : Fintype σ] (ω : σ → ℝ) (χ : σ → ι → ι → Bool) (i k : ι) (X : ℝ),
  (∑ s, ω s * if χ s i k = true then X else 0) = CFDLean.JST1.piShare ω χ i k * X

CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.sum_single.name: CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.sum_single
CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.sum_single.raw_type:
∀ {ι C X : Type} [inst : Fintype ι] [inst_1 : DecidableEq ι] [inst_2 : Fintype C] [inst_3 : AddCommMonoid X] {d : Nat}
  (M : CFDLean.Num.WMesh ι C d) (f : C → Fin (HAdd.hAdd d (OfNat.ofNat 1)) → X),

CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.tauF.name: CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.tauF
CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.tauF.type: {d : ℕ} → CFDLean.JST1.ViscParams → CFDLean.JST1.State d → Matrix (CFDLean.JST1.Channel d) (Fin d) ℝ → Fin d → Fin d → ℝ

CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.tauF_add.name: CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.tauF_add
CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.tauF_add.raw_type:

CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.tauF_add.type:
∀ {d : ℕ} (P : CFDLean.JST1.ViscParams) (wb : CFDLean.JST1.State d) (G H : Matrix (CFDLean.JST1.Channel d) (Fin d) ℝ)

  CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.tauF P wb (G + H) α β = CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.tauF P wb G α β + CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.tauF P wb H α β

CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.tauF_smul.name: CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.tauF_smul
CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.tauF_smul.raw_type:
∀ {d : Nat} (P : CFDLean.JST1.ViscParams) (wb : CFDLean.JST1.State d) (c : Real)
  (G : Matrix (CFDLean.JST1.Channel d) (Fin d) Real) (α β : Fin d),
  Eq (CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.tauF P wb (HSMul.hSMul c G) α β) (HMul.hMul c (CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.tauF P wb G α β))
CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.tauF_smul.type:
∀ {d : ℕ} (P : CFDLean.JST1.ViscParams) (wb : CFDLean.JST1.State d) (c : ℝ)
  (G : Matrix (CFDLean.JST1.Channel d) (Fin d) ℝ) (α β : Fin d),
  CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.tauF P wb (c • G) α β = c * CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.tauF P wb G α β

CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.tauF_smul._simp_1_1.name: CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.tauF_smul._simp_1_1
CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.tauF_smul._simp_1_1.raw_type:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} {R : Type u_4} [inst : NonUnitalNonAssocSemiring R] (s : Finset ι) (f : ι → R) (a : R),
  Eq (s.sum fun i => HMul.hMul a (f i)) (HMul.hMul a (s.sum fun i => f i))
CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.tauF_smul._simp_1_1.type:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} {R : Type u_4} [inst : NonUnitalNonAssocSemiring R] (s : Finset ι) (f : ι → R) (a : R),
  ∑ i ∈ s, a * f i = a * ∑ i ∈ s, f i

CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.tauF_symm.name: CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.tauF_symm
CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.tauF_symm.raw_type:
∀ {d : Nat} (P : CFDLean.JST1.ViscParams) (wb : CFDLean.JST1.State d) (G : Matrix (CFDLean.JST1.Channel d) (Fin d) Real)
  (α β : Fin d), Eq (CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.tauF P wb G α β) (CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.tauF P wb G β α)
CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.tauF_symm.type:
∀ {d : ℕ} (P : CFDLean.JST1.ViscParams) (wb : CFDLean.JST1.State d) (G : Matrix (CFDLean.JST1.Channel d) (Fin d) ℝ)
  (α β : Fin d), CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.tauF P wb G α β = CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.tauF P wb G β α

CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.tau_form.name: CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.tau_form
CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.tau_form.raw_type:
∀ {d : Nat} (D : Fin d → Fin d → Real) (μ : Real),
  Eq
    (Finset.univ.sum fun α =>
      Finset.univ.sum fun β =>
        HMul.hMul (D α β)
          (HSub.hSub (HMul.hMul μ (HAdd.hAdd (D α β) (D β α)))
            (HMul.hMul
              (HMul.hMul (HMul.hMul (HDiv.hDiv (OfNat.ofNat 2) (OfNat.ofNat 3)) μ) (Finset.univ.sum fun γ => D γ γ))
              (ite (Eq α β) (OfNat.ofNat 1) (OfNat.ofNat 0)))))
    (HMul.hMul μ
      (HSub.hSub (Finset.univ.sum fun α => Finset.univ.sum fun β => HMul.hMul (D α β) (HAdd.hAdd (D α β) (D β α)))
        (HMul.hMul (HDiv.hDiv (OfNat.ofNat 2) (OfNat.ofNat 3))
          (HPow.hPow (Finset.univ.sum fun γ => D γ γ) (OfNat.ofNat 2)))))
CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.tau_form.type:
∀ {d : ℕ} (D : Fin d → Fin d → ℝ) (μ : ℝ),
  ∑ α, ∑ β, D α β * (μ * (D α β + D β α) - (2 / 3 * μ * ∑ γ, D γ γ) * if α = β then 1 else 0) =
    μ * (∑ α, ∑ β, D α β * (D α β + D β α) - 2 / 3 * (∑ γ, D γ γ) ^ 2)

CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.tau_form._simp_1_1.name: CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.tau_form._simp_1_1
CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.tau_form._simp_1_1.raw_type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype α] (x : α), Eq (Membership.mem Finset.univ x) True
CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.tau_form._simp_1_1.type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype α] (x : α), (x ∈ Finset.univ) = True

CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.tau_form._simp_1_2.name: CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.tau_form._simp_1_2
CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.tau_form._simp_1_2.raw_type:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} {R : Type u_4} [inst : NonUnitalNonAssocSemiring R] (s : Finset ι) (f : ι → R) (a : R),
  Eq (s.sum fun i => HMul.hMul (f i) a) (HMul.hMul (s.sum fun i => f i) a)
CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.tau_form._simp_1_2.type:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} {R : Type u_4} [inst : NonUnitalNonAssocSemiring R] (s : Finset ι) (f : ι → R) (a : R),
  ∑ i ∈ s, f i * a = (∑ i ∈ s, f i) * a

CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.tendsto_expSlope.name: CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.tendsto_expSlope
CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.tendsto_expSlope.raw_type:
∀ (k : Real),
  Filter.Tendsto (fun h => HDiv.hDiv (HSub.hSub (Real.exp (HMul.hMul h k)) (OfNat.ofNat 1)) h)
    (nhdsWithin (OfNat.ofNat 0) (compl (singleton (OfNat.ofNat 0)))) (nhds k)
CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.tendsto_expSlope.type: ∀ (k : ℝ), Filter.Tendsto (fun h => (Real.exp (h * k) - 1) / h) (nhdsWithin 0 {0}ᶜ) (nhds k)

CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.thQ.name: CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.thQ
CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.thQ.type: ℝ → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ

CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.thQ_scaled.name: CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.thQ_scaled
CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.thQ_scaled.raw_type:
∀ {γ a b h : Real},
  LT.lt (OfNat.ofNat 1) γ →
    Ne h (OfNat.ofNat 0) →
      And
        (Eq
          (HDiv.hDiv
            (CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.thQ γ (OfNat.ofNat 1) (OfNat.ofNat 1) (Real.exp (HMul.hMul h a))
              (Real.exp (HMul.hMul h b)))
            (HPow.hPow h (OfNat.ofNat 2)))
          (HDiv.hDiv
            (Neg.neg
              (HAdd.hAdd
                (HMul.hMul (HSub.hSub b (HMul.hMul γ a))
                  (HDiv.hDiv (HSub.hSub (Real.exp (HMul.hMul h a)) (OfNat.ofNat 1)) h))
                (HMul.hMul (HDiv.hDiv (HSub.hSub (Real.exp (HMul.hMul h (HSub.hSub a b))) (OfNat.ofNat 1)) h)
                  (HDiv.hDiv (HSub.hSub (Real.exp (HMul.hMul h b)) (OfNat.ofNat 1)) h))))
            (HSub.hSub γ (OfNat.ofNat 1))))
        (Eq
          (HDiv.hDiv
            (CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.thQt γ (OfNat.ofNat 1) (OfNat.ofNat 1) (Real.exp (HMul.hMul h a))
              (Real.exp (HMul.hMul h b)))
            (HPow.hPow h (OfNat.ofNat 2)))
          (HDiv.hDiv
            (Neg.neg
              (HAdd.hAdd
                (HMul.hMul (HSub.hSub b (HMul.hMul γ a))
                  (HDiv.hDiv (HSub.hSub (Real.exp (HMul.hMul h a)) (OfNat.ofNat 1)) h))
                (HMul.hMul
                  (HMul.hMul γ (HDiv.hDiv (HSub.hSub (Real.exp (HMul.hMul h (HSub.hSub a b))) (OfNat.ofNat 1)) h))
                  (HDiv.hDiv (HSub.hSub (Real.exp (HMul.hMul h b)) (OfNat.ofNat 1)) h))))
            (HSub.hSub γ (OfNat.ofNat 1))))
CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.thQ_scaled.type:
∀ {γ a b h : ℝ},
  1 < γ →
    h ≠ 0 →
      CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.thQ γ 1 1 (Real.exp (h * a)) (Real.exp (h * b)) / h ^ 2 =
          -((b - γ * a) * ((Real.exp (h * a) - 1) / h) +
                (Real.exp (h * (a - b)) - 1) / h * ((Real.exp (h * b) - 1) / h)) /
            (γ - 1) ∧
        CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.thQt γ 1 1 (Real.exp (h * a)) (Real.exp (h * b)) / h ^ 2 =
          -((b - γ * a) * ((Real.exp (h * a) - 1) / h) +
                γ * ((Real.exp (h * (a - b)) - 1) / h) * ((Real.exp (h * b) - 1) / h)) /
            (γ - 1)

CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.thQt.name: CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.thQt
CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.thQt.type: ℝ → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ

CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.thermoQ_eq.name: CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.thermoQ_eq
CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.thermoQ_eq.raw_type:
∀ (γ a b : Real),
  Eq (CFDLean.JST1.thermoQ γ a b)
    (HAdd.hAdd (HPow.hPow (HSub.hSub b a) (OfNat.ofNat 2))
      (HMul.hMul (HSub.hSub γ (OfNat.ofNat 1)) (HPow.hPow a (OfNat.ofNat 2))))
CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.thermoQ_eq.type: ∀ (γ a b : ℝ), CFDLean.JST1.thermoQ γ a b = (b - a) ^ 2 + (γ - 1) * a ^ 2

CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.thermoQ_nonneg.name: CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.thermoQ_nonneg
CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.thermoQ_nonneg.raw_type: ∀ {γ : Real}, LT.lt (OfNat.ofNat 1) γ → ∀ (a b : Real), LE.le (OfNat.ofNat 0) (CFDLean.JST1.thermoQ γ a b)
CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.thermoQ_nonneg.type: ∀ {γ : ℝ}, 1 < γ → ∀ (a b : ℝ), 0 ≤ CFDLean.JST1.thermoQ γ a b

CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.thermoQ_pos.name: CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.thermoQ_pos
CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.thermoQ_pos.raw_type:
∀ {γ : Real},
  LT.lt (OfNat.ofNat 1) γ →
    ∀ {a : Real}, Ne a (OfNat.ofNat 0) → ∀ (b : Real), LT.lt (OfNat.ofNat 0) (CFDLean.JST1.thermoQ γ a b)
CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.thermoQ_pos.type: ∀ {γ : ℝ}, 1 < γ → ∀ {a : ℝ}, a ≠ 0 → ∀ (b : ℝ), 0 < CFDLean.JST1.thermoQ γ a b

CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.thermo_path.name: CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.thermo_path
CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.thermo_path.raw_type:
∀ {γ μ ν : Real},
  LT.lt (OfNat.ofNat 1) γ →
    (∀ (a b : Real),
        LE.le (OfNat.ofNat 0)
          (HAdd.hAdd (HMul.hMul μ (CFDLean.JST1.thermoQ γ a b)) (HMul.hMul ν (CFDLean.JST1.thermoQt γ a b)))) →
      ∀ {r1 p1 r2 p2 : Real},
        LT.lt (OfNat.ofNat 0) r1 →
          LT.lt (OfNat.ofNat 0) p1 →
            LT.lt (OfNat.ofNat 0) r2 →
              LT.lt (OfNat.ofNat 0) p2 →
                LE.le (OfNat.ofNat 0)
                  (HAdd.hAdd (HMul.hMul μ (CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.thQ γ r1 p1 r2 p2))
                    (HMul.hMul ν (CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.thQt γ r1 p1 r2 p2)))
CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.thermo_path.type:
∀ {γ μ ν : ℝ},
  1 < γ →
    (∀ (a b : ℝ), 0 ≤ μ * CFDLean.JST1.thermoQ γ a b + ν * CFDLean.JST1.thermoQt γ a b) →
      ∀ {r1 p1 r2 p2 : ℝ},
        0 < r1 →
          0 < p1 →
            0 < r2 → 0 < p2 → 0 ≤ μ * CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.thQ γ r1 p1 r2 p2 + ν * CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.thQt γ r1 p1 r2 p2

CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.vF.name: CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.vF
CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.vF.type: {d : ℕ} → CFDLean.JST1.State d → Fin d → ℝ

CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.vec_eq_of_dots.name: CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.vec_eq_of_dots
CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.vec_eq_of_dots.raw_type:
∀ {d : Nat} (T : CFDLean.Num.Simplex d),
  T.Nondeg →
    ∀ (u v : CFDLean.Num.Vec d),
      (∀ (a : Fin (HAdd.hAdd d (OfNat.ofNat 1))),
          Eq (CFDLean.Num.dot u (HSub.hSub (T.x a) (T.x (OfNat.ofNat 0))))
            (CFDLean.Num.dot v (HSub.hSub (T.x a) (T.x (OfNat.ofNat 0))))) →
        Eq u v
CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.vec_eq_of_dots.type:
∀ {d : ℕ} (T : CFDLean.Num.Simplex d),
  T.Nondeg →
    ∀ (u v : CFDLean.Num.Vec d),
      (∀ (a : Fin (d + 1)), CFDLean.Num.dot u (T.x a - T.x 0) = CFDLean.Num.dot v (T.x a - T.x 0)) → u = v

CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.vec_expand.name: CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.vec_expand
CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.vec_expand.raw_type:
∀ {d : Nat} (T : CFDLean.Num.Simplex d),
  T.Nondeg →
    ∀ (u : CFDLean.Num.Vec d),
      Eq u
        (Finset.univ.sum fun a => HSMul.hSMul (CFDLean.Num.dot u (HSub.hSub (T.x a) (T.x (OfNat.ofNat 0)))) (T.grad a))
CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.vec_expand.type:
∀ {d : ℕ} (T : CFDLean.Num.Simplex d),
  T.Nondeg → ∀ (u : CFDLean.Num.Vec d), u = ∑ a, CFDLean.Num.dot u (T.x a - T.x 0) • T.grad a

CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.velV.name: CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.velV
CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.velV.type: {d : ℕ} → CFDLean.JST1.Gas → CFDLean.JST1.State d → CFDLean.JST1.State d → ℝ

CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.velV.eq_1.name: CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.velV.eq_1
CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.velV.eq_1.raw_type:
∀ {d : Nat} (g : CFDLean.JST1.Gas) (Ui Uk : CFDLean.JST1.State d),
  Eq (CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.velV g Ui Uk)
    (HDiv.hDiv
      (HMul.hMul
        (HAdd.hAdd (HMul.hMul (HDiv.hDiv (CFDLean.JST1.rho Uk) (CFDLean.JST1.pressure g Uk)) (CFDLean.JST1.rho Ui))
          (HMul.hMul (HDiv.hDiv (CFDLean.JST1.rho Ui) (CFDLean.JST1.pressure g Ui)) (CFDLean.JST1.rho Uk)))
        (Finset.univ.sum fun α =>
          HPow.hPow (HSub.hSub (CFDLean.JST1.vel Uk α) (CFDLean.JST1.vel Ui α)) (OfNat.ofNat 2)))
      (OfNat.ofNat 2))
CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.velV.eq_1.type:
∀ {d : ℕ} (g : CFDLean.JST1.Gas) (Ui Uk : CFDLean.JST1.State d),
  CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.velV g Ui Uk =
    ((CFDLean.JST1.rho Uk / CFDLean.JST1.pressure g Uk * CFDLean.JST1.rho Ui +
          CFDLean.JST1.rho Ui / CFDLean.JST1.pressure g Ui * CFDLean.JST1.rho Uk) *
        ∑ α, (CFDLean.JST1.vel Uk α - CFDLean.JST1.vel Ui α) ^ 2) /
      2

CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.velV_nonneg.name: CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.velV_nonneg
CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.velV_nonneg.raw_type:
∀ {d : Nat} (g : CFDLean.JST1.Gas) {Ui Uk : CFDLean.JST1.State d},
  CFDLean.JST1.Admissible g Ui → CFDLean.JST1.Admissible g Uk → LE.le (OfNat.ofNat 0) (CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.velV g Ui Uk)
CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.velV_nonneg.type:
∀ {d : ℕ} (g : CFDLean.JST1.Gas) {Ui Uk : CFDLean.JST1.State d},
  CFDLean.JST1.Admissible g Ui → CFDLean.JST1.Admissible g Uk → 0 ≤ CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.velV g Ui Uk

CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.velV_rest.name: CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.velV_rest
CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.velV_rest.raw_type:
∀ {d : Nat} (g : CFDLean.JST1.Gas) (r1 p1 r2 p2 : Real),
  Eq (CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.velV g (CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.restState g r1 p1) (CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.restState g r2 p2))
    (OfNat.ofNat 0)
CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.velV_rest.type:
∀ {d : ℕ} (g : CFDLean.JST1.Gas) (r1 p1 r2 p2 : ℝ),
  CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.velV g (CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.restState g r1 p1) (CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.restState g r2 p2) = 0

CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.vel_rest.name: CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.vel_rest
CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.vel_rest.raw_type:
∀ {d : Nat} (g : CFDLean.JST1.Gas) (r p : Real) (α : Fin d),
  Eq (CFDLean.JST1.vel (CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.restState g r p) α) (OfNat.ofNat 0)
CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.vel_rest.type: ∀ {d : ℕ} (g : CFDLean.JST1.Gas) (r p : ℝ) (α : Fin d), CFDLean.JST1.vel (CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.restState g r p) α = 0

CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.vel_sum.name: CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.vel_sum
CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.vel_sum.raw_type:
∀ {d : Nat} (Ui Uk : CFDLean.JST1.State d),
  Eq (Finset.univ.sum fun α => HPow.hPow (HSub.hSub (CFDLean.JST1.vel Uk α) (CFDLean.JST1.vel Ui α)) (OfNat.ofNat 2))
    (HAdd.hAdd
      (HSub.hSub (CFDLean.Num.dot (CFDLean.JST1.vel Uk) (CFDLean.JST1.vel Uk))
        (HMul.hMul (OfNat.ofNat 2) (CFDLean.Num.dot (CFDLean.JST1.vel Uk) (CFDLean.JST1.vel Ui))))
      (CFDLean.Num.dot (CFDLean.JST1.vel Ui) (CFDLean.JST1.vel Ui)))
CFDLean.JST1.Proofs.vel_sum.type:
∀ {d : ℕ} (Ui Uk : CFDLean.JST1.State d),
  ∑ α, (CFDLean.JST1.vel Uk α - CFDLean.JST1.vel Ui α) ^ 2 =
    CFDLean.Num.dot (CFDLean.JST1.vel Uk) (CFDLean.JST1.vel Uk) -
        2 * CFDLean.Num.dot (CFDLean.JST1.vel Uk) (CFDLean.JST1.vel Ui) +

    And (LT.lt (OfNat.ofNat 0) (HDiv.hDiv (CFDLean.JST1.rho U) (CFDLean.JST1.pressure g U)).sqrt)
      (And (LT.lt (OfNat.ofNat 0) (HMul.hMul (CFDLean.JST1.rho U) (CFDLean.JST1.pressure g U)).sqrt)

          (Eq (CFDLean.JST1.rho U)
            (HMul.hMul (HDiv.hDiv (CFDLean.JST1.rho U) (CFDLean.JST1.pressure g U)).sqrt
              (HMul.hMul (CFDLean.JST1.rho U) (CFDLean.JST1.pressure g U)).sqrt))
          (Eq (CFDLean.JST1.pressure g U)
            (HDiv.hDiv (HMul.hMul (CFDLean.JST1.rho U) (CFDLean.JST1.pressure g U)).sqrt
              (HDiv.hDiv (CFDLean.JST1.rho U) (CFDLean.JST1.pressure g U)).sqrt))))

CFDLean.JST1.Wall.PiW.eq_1.name: CFDLean.JST1.Wall.PiW.eq_1
CFDLean.JST1.Wall.PiW.eq_1.raw_type:
∀ {κ : Type} [inst : Fintype κ] {d : Nat} (T : CFDLean.Num.Simplex d)
  (K : Matrix κ (Fin d) Real → Matrix κ (Fin d) Real) (P : Matrix κ κ Real) (gw : κ → Real)
  (walls : Finset (Fin (HAdd.hAdd d (OfNat.ofNat 1)))) (c : Real) (w : Fin (HAdd.hAdd d (OfNat.ofNat 1)) → κ → Real),
  Eq (CFDLean.JST1.Wall.PiW T K P gw walls c w)
    (walls.sum fun o =>
      HSub.hSub
        (HMul.hMul (HMul.hMul (OfNat.ofNat 2) (HDiv.hDiv (CFDLean.JST1.Wall.area T o) d.cast))
          ((Finset.univ.erase o).sum fun a =>
            CFDLean.Num.pairF (CFDLean.JST1.Wall.eW P gw w a)
              ((K (CFDLean.JST1.Wall.gradT T w)).mulVec (CFDLean.JST1.Wall.normal T o))))
        (HMul.hMul (CFDLean.JST1.Wall.sigmaF T walls c o) (CFDLean.JST1.Wall.Xf T K P gw w o)))
CFDLean.JST1.Wall.PiW.eq_1.type:
∀ {κ : Type} [inst : Fintype κ] {d : ℕ} (T : CFDLean.Num.Simplex d) (K : Matrix κ (Fin d) ℝ → Matrix κ (Fin d) ℝ)
  (P : Matrix κ κ ℝ) (gw : κ → ℝ) (walls : Finset (Fin (d + 1))) (c : ℝ) (w : Fin (d + 1) → κ → ℝ),
  CFDLean.JST1.Wall.PiW T K P gw walls c w =
    ∑ o ∈ walls,
      (2 * (CFDLean.JST1.Wall.area T o / ↑d) *
          ∑ a ∈ Finset.univ.erase o,
            CFDLean.Num.pairF (CFDLean.JST1.Wall.eW P gw w a)
              ((K (CFDLean.JST1.Wall.gradT T w)).mulVec (CFDLean.JST1.Wall.normal T o)) -
        CFDLean.JST1.Wall.sigmaF T walls c o * CFDLean.JST1.Wall.Xf T K P gw w o)

      (HDiv.hDiv (HMul.hMul (CFDLean.JST1.rho U) (CFDLean.Num.dot (CFDLean.JST1.vel U) (CFDLean.JST1.vel U)))
