CFDLean.JST1.ismailRoe.eq_1.type:
∀ {d : ℕ} (g : CFDLean.JST1.Gas) (Ua Ub : CFDLean.JST1.State d) (y : CFDLean.Num.Vec d),
  CFDLean.JST1.ismailRoe g Ua Ub y = fun c =>
    match c with
    | CFDLean.JST1.Channel.mass =>
      (√(CFDLean.JST1.rho Ua / CFDLean.JST1.pressure g Ua) + √(CFDLean.JST1.rho Ub / CFDLean.JST1.pressure g Ub)) / 2 *
          CFDLean.Num.logMean √(CFDLean.JST1.rho Ua * CFDLean.JST1.pressure g Ua)
            √(CFDLean.JST1.rho Ub * CFDLean.JST1.pressure g Ub) *
        CFDLean.Num.dot
          (fun α =>
            (√(CFDLean.JST1.rho Ua / CFDLean.JST1.pressure g Ua) * CFDLean.JST1.vel Ua α +
                  √(CFDLean.JST1.rho Ub / CFDLean.JST1.pressure g Ub) * CFDLean.JST1.vel Ub α) /
                2 /
              ((√(CFDLean.JST1.rho Ua / CFDLean.JST1.pressure g Ua) +
                  √(CFDLean.JST1.rho Ub / CFDLean.JST1.pressure g Ub)) /
                2))
          y
    | CFDLean.JST1.Channel.momentum α =>
      (√(CFDLean.JST1.rho Ua / CFDLean.JST1.pressure g Ua) + √(CFDLean.JST1.rho Ub / CFDLean.JST1.pressure g Ub)) / 2 *
              CFDLean.Num.logMean √(CFDLean.JST1.rho Ua * CFDLean.JST1.pressure g Ua)
                √(CFDLean.JST1.rho Ub * CFDLean.JST1.pressure g Ub) *
            (fun α =>
                (√(CFDLean.JST1.rho Ua / CFDLean.JST1.pressure g Ua) * CFDLean.JST1.vel Ua α +
                      √(CFDLean.JST1.rho Ub / CFDLean.JST1.pressure g Ub) * CFDLean.JST1.vel Ub α) /
                    2 /
                  ((√(CFDLean.JST1.rho Ua / CFDLean.JST1.pressure g Ua) +
                      √(CFDLean.JST1.rho Ub / CFDLean.JST1.pressure g Ub)) /
                    2))
              α *
          CFDLean.Num.dot
            (fun α =>
              (√(CFDLean.JST1.rho Ua / CFDLean.JST1.pressure g Ua) * CFDLean.JST1.vel Ua α +
                    √(CFDLean.JST1.rho Ub / CFDLean.JST1.pressure g Ub) * CFDLean.JST1.vel Ub α) /
                  2 /
                ((√(CFDLean.JST1.rho Ua / CFDLean.JST1.pressure g Ua) +
                    √(CFDLean.JST1.rho Ub / CFDLean.JST1.pressure g Ub)) /
                  2))
            y +
        (√(CFDLean.JST1.rho Ua * CFDLean.JST1.pressure g Ua) + √(CFDLean.JST1.rho Ub * CFDLean.JST1.pressure g Ub)) /
              2 /
            ((√(CFDLean.JST1.rho Ua / CFDLean.JST1.pressure g Ua) +
                √(CFDLean.JST1.rho Ub / CFDLean.JST1.pressure g Ub)) /
              2) *
          y α
    | CFDLean.JST1.Channel.energy =>
      (√(CFDLean.JST1.rho Ua / CFDLean.JST1.pressure g Ua) + √(CFDLean.JST1.rho Ub / CFDLean.JST1.pressure g Ub)) / 2 *
            CFDLean.Num.logMean √(CFDLean.JST1.rho Ua * CFDLean.JST1.pressure g Ua)
              √(CFDLean.JST1.rho Ub * CFDLean.JST1.pressure g Ub) *
          (g.γ *
                ((g.γ + 1) / (2 * g.γ) *
                    (CFDLean.Num.logMean √(CFDLean.JST1.rho Ua * CFDLean.JST1.pressure g Ua)
                        √(CFDLean.JST1.rho Ub * CFDLean.JST1.pressure g Ub) /
                      CFDLean.Num.logMean √(CFDLean.JST1.rho Ua / CFDLean.JST1.pressure g Ua)
                        √(CFDLean.JST1.rho Ub / CFDLean.JST1.pressure g Ub)) +
                  (g.γ - 1) / (2 * g.γ) *
                    ((√(CFDLean.JST1.rho Ua * CFDLean.JST1.pressure g Ua) +
                          √(CFDLean.JST1.rho Ub * CFDLean.JST1.pressure g Ub)) /
                        2 /
                      ((√(CFDLean.JST1.rho Ua / CFDLean.JST1.pressure g Ua) +
                          √(CFDLean.JST1.rho Ub / CFDLean.JST1.pressure g Ub)) /
                        2))) /
              ((√(CFDLean.JST1.rho Ua / CFDLean.JST1.pressure g Ua) +
                      √(CFDLean.JST1.rho Ub / CFDLean.JST1.pressure g Ub)) /
                    2 *
                  CFDLean.Num.logMean √(CFDLean.JST1.rho Ua * CFDLean.JST1.pressure g Ua)
                    √(CFDLean.JST1.rho Ub * CFDLean.JST1.pressure g Ub) *
                (g.γ - 1)) +
            (CFDLean.Num.dot
                (fun α =>
                  (√(CFDLean.JST1.rho Ua / CFDLean.JST1.pressure g Ua) * CFDLean.JST1.vel Ua α +
                        √(CFDLean.JST1.rho Ub / CFDLean.JST1.pressure g Ub) * CFDLean.JST1.vel Ub α) /
                      2 /
                    ((√(CFDLean.JST1.rho Ua / CFDLean.JST1.pressure g Ua) +
                        √(CFDLean.JST1.rho Ub / CFDLean.JST1.pressure g Ub)) /
                      2))
                fun α =>
                (√(CFDLean.JST1.rho Ua / CFDLean.JST1.pressure g Ua) * CFDLean.JST1.vel Ua α +
                      √(CFDLean.JST1.rho Ub / CFDLean.JST1.pressure g Ub) * CFDLean.JST1.vel Ub α) /
                    2 /
                  ((√(CFDLean.JST1.rho Ua / CFDLean.JST1.pressure g Ua) +
                      √(CFDLean.JST1.rho Ub / CFDLean.JST1.pressure g Ub)) /
                    2)) /
              2) *
        CFDLean.Num.dot
          (fun α =>
            (√(CFDLean.JST1.rho Ua / CFDLean.JST1.pressure g Ua) * CFDLean.JST1.vel Ua α +
                  √(CFDLean.JST1.rho Ub / CFDLean.JST1.pressure g Ub) * CFDLean.JST1.vel Ub α) /
                2 /
              ((√(CFDLean.JST1.rho Ua / CFDLean.JST1.pressure g Ua) +
                  √(CFDLean.JST1.rho Ub / CFDLean.JST1.pressure g Ub)) /
                2))
          y

  Eq (CFDLean.JST1.physFlux g U y (CFDLean.JST1.Channel.momentum a))
    (HAdd.hAdd (HMul.hMul (CFDLean.JST1.mom U a) (CFDLean.Num.dot (CFDLean.JST1.vel U) y))
      (HMul.hMul (CFDLean.JST1.pressure g U) (y a)))
CFDLean.JST1.physFlux.eq_2.type:
∀ {d : ℕ} (g : CFDLean.JST1.Gas) (U : CFDLean.JST1.State d) (y : CFDLean.Num.Vec d) (a : Fin d),

    CFDLean.JST1.mom U a * CFDLean.Num.dot (CFDLean.JST1.vel U) y + CFDLean.JST1.pressure g U * y a

CFDLean.JST1.pressure.eq_1.name: CFDLean.JST1.pressure.eq_1
CFDLean.JST1.pressure.eq_1.raw_type:
∀ {d : Nat} (g : CFDLean.JST1.Gas) (U : CFDLean.JST1.State d),
  Eq (CFDLean.JST1.pressure g U)
    (HMul.hMul (HSub.hSub g.γ (OfNat.ofNat 1))
      (HSub.hSub (CFDLean.JST1.energy U)
        (HDiv.hDiv (CFDLean.Num.dot (CFDLean.JST1.mom U) (CFDLean.JST1.mom U))
          (HMul.hMul (OfNat.ofNat 2) (CFDLean.JST1.rho U)))))
CFDLean.JST1.pressure.eq_1.type:
∀ {d : ℕ} (g : CFDLean.JST1.Gas) (U : CFDLean.JST1.State d),
  CFDLean.JST1.pressure g U =
    (g.γ - 1) *
      (CFDLean.JST1.energy U - CFDLean.Num.dot (CFDLean.JST1.mom U) (CFDLean.JST1.mom U) / (2 * CFDLean.JST1.rho U))

CFDLean.JST1.primState.eq_2.type:

CFDLean.JST1.primState.eq_3.name: CFDLean.JST1.primState.eq_3
CFDLean.JST1.primState.eq_3.raw_type:

  Eq (CFDLean.JST1.primState g r v p CFDLean.JST1.Channel.energy)
    (HAdd.hAdd (HDiv.hDiv p (HSub.hSub g.γ (OfNat.ofNat 1)))
      (HDiv.hDiv (HMul.hMul r (CFDLean.Num.dot v v)) (OfNat.ofNat 2)))
CFDLean.JST1.primState.eq_3.type:
∀ {d : ℕ} (g : CFDLean.JST1.Gas) (r : ℝ) (v : CFDLean.Num.Vec d) (p : ℝ),
  CFDLean.JST1.primState g r v p CFDLean.JST1.Channel.energy = p / (g.γ - 1) + r * CFDLean.Num.dot v v / 2

CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.volume_parti.name: CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.volume_partition_raw
CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.volume_parti.raw_type:
∀ {n m : Nat} (M : CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData n m),

CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData.volume_parti.type: ∀ {n m : ℕ} (M : CFDLean.MedianDual.MeshData n m), ∑ a, M.dualVolume a = ∑ t, CFDLean.MedianDual.volume (M.points t)

CFDLean.MedianDual.RoeAggregation.averag.name: CFDLean.MedianDual.RoeAggregation.averages
CFDLean.MedianDual.RoeAggregation.averag.raw_type:
And
  (Eq (CFDLean.Roe.averageVelocity CFDLean.MedianDual.RoeAggregation.cold CFDLean.MedianDual.RoeAggregation.hot)
    (OfNat.ofNat 0))
  (And
    (Eq
      (CFDLean.Roe.averageEnthalpy (OfNat.ofNat 2) CFDLean.MedianDual.RoeAggregation.cold
        CFDLean.MedianDual.RoeAggregation.hot)
      (OfNat.ofNat 5))
    (Eq
      (CFDLean.Roe.soundSpeed (OfNat.ofNat 2) CFDLean.MedianDual.RoeAggregation.cold
        CFDLean.MedianDual.RoeAggregation.hot)
      (Real.sqrt (OfNat.ofNat 5))))
CFDLean.MedianDual.RoeAggregation.averag.type:
CFDLean.Roe.averageVelocity CFDLean.MedianDual.RoeAggregation.cold CFDLean.MedianDual.RoeAggregation.hot = 0 ∧
  CFDLean.Roe.averageEnthalpy 2 CFDLean.MedianDual.RoeAggregation.cold CFDLean.MedianDual.RoeAggregation.hot = 5 ∧
    CFDLean.Roe.soundSpeed 2 CFDLean.MedianDual.RoeAggregation.cold CFDLean.MedianDual.RoeAggregation.hot = √5

CFDLean.MedianDual.RoeAggregation.dissip.name: CFDLean.MedianDual.RoeAggregation.dissipation_mass
CFDLean.MedianDual.RoeAggregation.dissip.raw_type:
∀ (n : CFDLean.Vector (OfNat.ofNat 3)),
  Eq (CFDLean.dot n n) (OfNat.ofNat 1) →
    Eq
      (DFunLike.coe
        (CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.dissipation (OfNat.ofNat 2) CFDLean.MedianDual.RoeAggregation.cold
          CFDLean.MedianDual.RoeAggregation.hot n)
        CFDLean.MedianDual.RoeAggregation.jump ⟨0, Fin.instOfNat⟩)
      (HDiv.hDiv (HMul.hMul (OfNat.ofNat 3) (Real.sqrt (OfNat.ofNat 5))) (OfNat.ofNat 5))
CFDLean.MedianDual.RoeAggregation.dissip.type:
∀ (n : CFDLean.Vector 3),
  CFDLean.dot n n = 1 →
    (CFDLean.Roe.Spectral.dissipation 2 CFDLean.MedianDual.RoeAggregation.cold CFDLean.MedianDual.RoeAggregation.hot n)
        CFDLean.MedianDual.RoeAggregation.jump 0 =
      3 * √5 / 5

CFDLean.MedianDual.RoeAggregation.mass_f.name: CFDLean.MedianDual.RoeAggregation.mass_formula
CFDLean.MedianDual.RoeAggregation.mass_f.raw_type:
∀ (S : CFDLean.Vector (OfNat.ofNat 3)),
  Ne S (OfNat.ofNat 0) →
    Eq
      (CFDLean.Roe.roeFluxCoordinates (OfNat.ofNat 2) CFDLean.MedianDual.RoeAggregation.cold
        CFDLean.MedianDual.RoeAggregation.hot S ⟨0, Fin.instOfNat⟩)
      (HDiv.hDiv
        (HMul.hMul (HMul.hMul (Neg.neg (OfNat.ofNat 3)) (Real.sqrt (OfNat.ofNat 5))) (CFDLean.Coordinates.area S))
        (OfNat.ofNat 10))
CFDLean.MedianDual.RoeAggregation.mass_f.type:
∀ (S : CFDLean.Vector 3),
  S ≠ 0 →
    CFDLean.Roe.roeFluxCoordinates 2 CFDLean.MedianDual.RoeAggregation.cold CFDLean.MedianDual.RoeAggregation.hot S 0 =
      -3 * √5 * CFDLean.Coordinates.area S / 10

CFDLean.MedianDual.RoeAggregation.nonpar.name: CFDLean.MedianDual.RoeAggregation.nonparallel_not_additive
CFDLean.MedianDual.RoeAggregation.nonpar.raw_type:
Ne
  (CFDLean.Roe.roeFluxCoordinates (OfNat.ofNat 2) CFDLean.MedianDual.RoeAggregation.cold
    CFDLean.MedianDual.RoeAggregation.hot
    (Matrix.vecCons (OfNat.ofNat 1) (Matrix.vecCons (OfNat.ofNat 1) (Matrix.vecCons (OfNat.ofNat 0) Matrix.vecEmpty))))
  (HAdd.hAdd
    (CFDLean.Roe.roeFluxCoordinates (OfNat.ofNat 2) CFDLean.MedianDual.RoeAggregation.cold
      CFDLean.MedianDual.RoeAggregation.hot
      (Matrix.vecCons (OfNat.ofNat 1)
        (Matrix.vecCons (OfNat.ofNat 0) (Matrix.vecCons (OfNat.ofNat 0) Matrix.vecEmpty))))
    (CFDLean.Roe.roeFluxCoordinates (OfNat.ofNat 2) CFDLean.MedianDual.RoeAggregation.cold
      CFDLean.MedianDual.RoeAggregation.hot
      (Matrix.vecCons (OfNat.ofNat 0)
        (Matrix.vecCons (OfNat.ofNat 1) (Matrix.vecCons (OfNat.ofNat 0) Matrix.vecEmpty)))))
CFDLean.MedianDual.RoeAggregation.nonpar.type:
CFDLean.Roe.roeFluxCoordinates 2 CFDLean.MedianDual.RoeAggregation.cold CFDLean.MedianDual.RoeAggregation.hot
    ![1, 1, 0] ≠
  CFDLean.Roe.roeFluxCoordinates 2 CFDLean.MedianDual.RoeAggregation.cold CFDLean.MedianDual.RoeAggregation.hot
      ![1, 0, 0] +
    CFDLean.Roe.roeFluxCoordinates 2 CFDLean.MedianDual.RoeAggregation.cold CFDLean.MedianDual.RoeAggregation.hot
      ![0, 1, 0]

CFDLean.MedianDual.barycentric_determina.name: CFDLean.MedianDual.barycentric_determinant
CFDLean.MedianDual.barycentric_determina.raw_type:
∀ (a b c d : CFDLean.Vector (OfNat.ofNat 3)),
  Eq
    (CFDLean.MedianDual.determinant
      (HSub.hSub (HSMul.hSMul (HDiv.hDiv (OfNat.ofNat 1) (OfNat.ofNat 2)) (HAdd.hAdd a b)) a)
      (HSub.hSub (HSMul.hSMul (HDiv.hDiv (OfNat.ofNat 1) (OfNat.ofNat 3)) (HAdd.hAdd (HAdd.hAdd a b) c)) a)
      (HSub.hSub (HSMul.hSMul (HDiv.hDiv (OfNat.ofNat 1) (OfNat.ofNat 4)) (HAdd.hAdd (HAdd.hAdd (HAdd.hAdd a b) c) d))
        a))
    (HDiv.hDiv (CFDLean.MedianDual.determinant (HSub.hSub b a) (HSub.hSub c a) (HSub.hSub d a)) (OfNat.ofNat 24))
CFDLean.MedianDual.barycentric_determina.type:
∀ (a b c d : CFDLean.Vector 3),
  CFDLean.MedianDual.determinant ((1 / 2) • (a + b) - a) ((1 / 3) • (a + b + c) - a) ((1 / 4) • (a + b + c + d) - a) =
    CFDLean.MedianDual.determinant (b - a) (c - a) (d - a) / 24

CFDLean.MedianDual.barycentric_triangle_.name: CFDLean.MedianDual.barycentric_triangle_dot
CFDLean.MedianDual.barycentric_triangle_.raw_type:
∀ (a b c d : CFDLean.Vector (OfNat.ofNat 3)),
  Eq
    (CFDLean.dot
      (CFDLean.MedianDual.triangle (HSMul.hSMul (HDiv.hDiv (OfNat.ofNat 1) (OfNat.ofNat 2)) (HAdd.hAdd a b))
        (HSMul.hSMul (HDiv.hDiv (OfNat.ofNat 1) (OfNat.ofNat 3)) (HAdd.hAdd (HAdd.hAdd a b) c))
        (HSMul.hSMul (HDiv.hDiv (OfNat.ofNat 1) (OfNat.ofNat 4)) (HAdd.hAdd (HAdd.hAdd (HAdd.hAdd a b) c) d)))
      (HSub.hSub b a))
    (HDiv.hDiv (CFDLean.MedianDual.determinant (HSub.hSub b a) (HSub.hSub c a) (HSub.hSub d a)) (OfNat.ofNat 24))
CFDLean.MedianDual.barycentric_triangle_.type:
∀ (a b c d : CFDLean.Vector 3),
  CFDLean.dot (CFDLean.MedianDual.triangle ((1 / 2) • (a + b)) ((1 / 3) • (a + b + c)) ((1 / 4) • (a + b + c + d)))
      (b - a) =
    CFDLean.MedianDual.determinant (b - a) (c - a) (d - a) / 24

CFDLean.MedianDual.cellCenter.eq_1.name: CFDLean.MedianDual.cellCenter.eq_1
CFDLean.MedianDual.cellCenter.eq_1.raw_type:
∀ (p : CFDLean.MedianDual.Points),
  Eq (CFDLean.MedianDual.cellCenter p)
    (HSMul.hSMul (HDiv.hDiv (OfNat.ofNat 1) (OfNat.ofNat 4))
      (HAdd.hAdd (HAdd.hAdd (HAdd.hAdd (p ⟨0, Fin.instOfNat⟩) (p ⟨1, Fin.instOfNat⟩)) (p ⟨2, Fin.instOfNat⟩))
        (p ⟨3, Fin.instOfNat⟩)))
CFDLean.MedianDual.cellCenter.eq_1.type: ∀ (p : CFDLean.MedianDual.Points), CFDLean.MedianDual.cellCenter p = (1 / 4) • (p 0 + p 1 + p 2 + p 3)

CFDLean.MedianDual.cross.eq_1.name: CFDLean.MedianDual.cross.eq_1
CFDLean.MedianDual.cross.eq_1.raw_type:
∀ (a b : CFDLean.Vector (OfNat.ofNat 3)),
  Eq (CFDLean.MedianDual.cross a b)
    (Matrix.vecCons
      (HSub.hSub (HMul.hMul (a ⟨1, Fin.instOfNat⟩) (b ⟨2, Fin.instOfNat⟩))
        (HMul.hMul (a ⟨2, Fin.instOfNat⟩) (b ⟨1, Fin.instOfNat⟩)))
      (Matrix.vecCons
        (HSub.hSub (HMul.hMul (a ⟨2, Fin.instOfNat⟩) (b ⟨0, Fin.instOfNat⟩))
          (HMul.hMul (a ⟨0, Fin.instOfNat⟩) (b ⟨2, Fin.instOfNat⟩)))
        (Matrix.vecCons
          (HSub.hSub (HMul.hMul (a ⟨0, Fin.instOfNat⟩) (b ⟨1, Fin.instOfNat⟩))
            (HMul.hMul (a ⟨1, Fin.instOfNat⟩) (b ⟨0, Fin.instOfNat⟩)))
          Matrix.vecEmpty)))
CFDLean.MedianDual.cross.eq_1.type:
∀ (a b : CFDLean.Vector 3),
  CFDLean.MedianDual.cross a b = ![a 1 * b 2 - a 2 * b 1, a 2 * b 0 - a 0 * b 2, a 0 * b 1 - a 1 * b 0]

CFDLean.MedianDual.determinant.eq_1.name: CFDLean.MedianDual.determinant.eq_1
CFDLean.MedianDual.determinant.eq_1.raw_type:
∀ (a b c : CFDLean.Vector (OfNat.ofNat 3)),
  Eq (CFDLean.MedianDual.determinant a b c) (CFDLean.dot a (CFDLean.MedianDual.cross b c))
CFDLean.MedianDual.determinant.eq_1.type: ∀ (a b c : CFDLean.Vector 3), CFDLean.MedianDual.determinant a b c = CFDLean.dot a (CFDLean.MedianDual.cross b c)

CFDLean.MedianDual.dot_smul_left.name: CFDLean.MedianDual.dot_smul_left
CFDLean.MedianDual.dot_smul_left.raw_type:
∀ (a : Real) (v w : CFDLean.Vector (OfNat.ofNat 3)),
  Eq (CFDLean.dot (HSMul.hSMul a v) w) (HMul.hMul a (CFDLean.dot v w))
CFDLean.MedianDual.dot_smul_left.type: ∀ (a : ℝ) (v w : CFDLean.Vector 3), CFDLean.dot (a • v) w = a * CFDLean.dot v w

CFDLean.MedianDual.faceBase.eq_1.name: CFDLean.MedianDual.faceBase.eq_1
CFDLean.MedianDual.faceBase.eq_1.raw_type:
∀ (p : CFDLean.MedianDual.Points) (i : Fin (OfNat.ofNat 4)),
  Eq (CFDLean.MedianDual.faceBase p i)
    (Matrix.vecCons (p ⟨1, Fin.instOfNat⟩)
      (Matrix.vecCons (p ⟨0, Fin.instOfNat⟩)
        (Matrix.vecCons (p ⟨0, Fin.instOfNat⟩) (Matrix.vecCons (p ⟨0, Fin.instOfNat⟩) Matrix.vecEmpty)))
      i)
CFDLean.MedianDual.faceBase.eq_1.type: ∀ (p : CFDLean.MedianDual.Points) (i : Fin 4), CFDLean.MedianDual.faceBase p i = ![p 1, p 0, p 0, p 0] i

CFDLean.MedianDual.faceBase_succAbove.name: CFDLean.MedianDual.faceBase_succAbove
CFDLean.MedianDual.faceBase_succAbove.raw_type:
∀ (p : CFDLean.MedianDual.Points) (i : Fin (OfNat.ofNat 4)),
  Eq (CFDLean.MedianDual.faceBase p i) (p (i.succAbove ⟨0, Fin.instOfNat⟩))
CFDLean.MedianDual.faceBase_succAbove.type: ∀ (p : CFDLean.MedianDual.Points) (i : Fin 4), CFDLean.MedianDual.faceBase p i = p (i.succAbove 0)

CFDLean.MedianDual.faceCenter.eq_1.name: CFDLean.MedianDual.faceCenter.eq_1
CFDLean.MedianDual.faceCenter.eq_1.raw_type:
∀ (p : CFDLean.MedianDual.Points) (i j k : Fin (OfNat.ofNat 4)),
  Eq (CFDLean.MedianDual.faceCenter p i j k)
    (HSMul.hSMul (HDiv.hDiv (OfNat.ofNat 1) (OfNat.ofNat 3)) (HAdd.hAdd (HAdd.hAdd (p i) (p j)) (p k)))
CFDLean.MedianDual.faceCenter.eq_1.type: ∀ (p : CFDLean.MedianDual.Points) (i j k : Fin 4), CFDLean.MedianDual.faceCenter p i j k = (1 / 3) • (p i + p j + p k)

CFDLean.MedianDual.faceCenter_swap.name: CFDLean.MedianDual.faceCenter_swap
CFDLean.MedianDual.faceCenter_swap.raw_type:
∀ (p : CFDLean.MedianDual.Points) (i j k : Fin (OfNat.ofNat 4)),
  Eq (CFDLean.MedianDual.faceCenter p i k j) (CFDLean.MedianDual.faceCenter p i j k)
CFDLean.MedianDual.faceCenter_swap.type:
∀ (p : CFDLean.MedianDual.Points) (i j k : Fin 4),
  CFDLean.MedianDual.faceCenter p i k j = CFDLean.MedianDual.faceCenter p i j k

CFDLean.MedianDual.faceVector.eq_1.name: CFDLean.MedianDual.faceVector.eq_1
CFDLean.MedianDual.faceVector.eq_1.raw_type:
∀ (p : CFDLean.MedianDual.Points) (i : Fin (OfNat.ofNat 4)),
  Eq (CFDLean.MedianDual.faceVector p i)
    (Matrix.vecCons (CFDLean.MedianDual.triangle (p ⟨1, Fin.instOfNat⟩) (p ⟨2, Fin.instOfNat⟩) (p ⟨3, Fin.instOfNat⟩))
      (Matrix.vecCons
        (Neg.neg (CFDLean.MedianDual.triangle (p ⟨0, Fin.instOfNat⟩) (p ⟨2, Fin.instOfNat⟩) (p ⟨3, Fin.instOfNat⟩)))
        (Matrix.vecCons
          (CFDLean.MedianDual.triangle (p ⟨0, Fin.instOfNat⟩) (p ⟨1, Fin.instOfNat⟩) (p ⟨3, Fin.instOfNat⟩))
          (Matrix.vecCons
            (Neg.neg (CFDLean.MedianDual.triangle (p ⟨0, Fin.instOfNat⟩) (p ⟨1, Fin.instOfNat⟩) (p ⟨2, Fin.instOfNat⟩)))
            Matrix.vecEmpty)))
      i)
CFDLean.MedianDual.faceVector.eq_1.type:
∀ (p : CFDLean.MedianDual.Points) (i : Fin 4),
  CFDLean.MedianDual.faceVector p i =
    ![CFDLean.MedianDual.triangle (p 1) (p 2) (p 3), -CFDLean.MedianDual.triangle (p 0) (p 2) (p 3),
        CFDLean.MedianDual.triangle (p 0) (p 1) (p 3), -CFDLean.MedianDual.triangle (p 0) (p 1) (p 2)]
      i

CFDLean.MedianDual.faceVector_opposite_d.name: CFDLean.MedianDual.faceVector_opposite_dot
CFDLean.MedianDual.faceVector_opposite_d.raw_type:
∀ (p : CFDLean.MedianDual.Points) (i : Fin (OfNat.ofNat 4)),
  Eq (CFDLean.dot (CFDLean.MedianDual.faceVector p i) (HSub.hSub (p i) (CFDLean.MedianDual.faceBase p i)))
    (HDiv.hDiv (Neg.neg (CFDLean.MedianDual.sixVolume p)) (OfNat.ofNat 2))
CFDLean.MedianDual.faceVector_opposite_d.type:
∀ (p : CFDLean.MedianDual.Points) (i : Fin 4),
  CFDLean.dot (CFDLean.MedianDual.faceVector p i) (p i - CFDLean.MedianDual.faceBase p i) =
    -CFDLean.MedianDual.sixVolume p / 2

CFDLean.MedianDual.faceVector_sum.name: CFDLean.MedianDual.faceVector_sum
CFDLean.MedianDual.faceVector_sum.raw_type: ∀ (p : CFDLean.MedianDual.Points), Eq (Finset.univ.sum fun i => CFDLean.MedianDual.faceVector p i) (OfNat.ofNat 0)

CFDLean.MedianDual.faceVector_tangent.name: CFDLean.MedianDual.faceVector_tangent
CFDLean.MedianDual.faceVector_tangent.raw_type:
∀ (p : CFDLean.MedianDual.Points) (i j : Fin (OfNat.ofNat 4)),
  Ne i.val j.val →
    Eq (CFDLean.dot (CFDLean.MedianDual.faceVector p i) (HSub.hSub (p j) (CFDLean.MedianDual.faceBase p i)))
      (OfNat.ofNat 0)
CFDLean.MedianDual.faceVector_tangent.type:
∀ (p : CFDLean.MedianDual.Points) (i j : Fin 4),
  ↑i ≠ ↑j → CFDLean.dot (CFDLean.MedianDual.faceVector p i) (p j - CFDLean.MedianDual.faceBase p i) = 0

CFDLean.MedianDual.faceVector_triangle_o.name: CFDLean.MedianDual.faceVector_triangle_or_neg
CFDLean.MedianDual.faceVector_triangle_o.raw_type:
∀ (p : CFDLean.MedianDual.Points) (i : Fin (OfNat.ofNat 4)),
  Or
    (Eq (CFDLean.MedianDual.faceVector p i)
      (CFDLean.MedianDual.triangle (p (i.succAbove ⟨0, Fin.instOfNat⟩)) (p (i.succAbove ⟨1, Fin.instOfNat⟩))
        (p (i.succAbove ⟨2, Fin.instOfNat⟩))))
    (Eq (CFDLean.MedianDual.faceVector p i)
      (Neg.neg
        (CFDLean.MedianDual.triangle (p (i.succAbove ⟨0, Fin.instOfNat⟩)) (p (i.succAbove ⟨1, Fin.instOfNat⟩))
          (p (i.succAbove ⟨2, Fin.instOfNat⟩)))))
CFDLean.MedianDual.faceVector_triangle_o.type:
∀ (p : CFDLean.MedianDual.Points) (i : Fin 4),
  CFDLean.MedianDual.faceVector p i =
      CFDLean.MedianDual.triangle (p (i.succAbove 0)) (p (i.succAbove 1)) (p (i.succAbove 2)) ∨
    CFDLean.MedianDual.faceVector p i =
      -CFDLean.MedianDual.triangle (p (i.succAbove 0)) (p (i.succAbove 1)) (p (i.succAbove 2))

CFDLean.MedianDual.fin4_cases.name: CFDLean.MedianDual.fin4_cases
CFDLean.MedianDual.fin4_cases.raw_type:
∀ (i : Fin (OfNat.ofNat 4)),
  Or (Eq i ⟨0, Fin.instOfNat⟩) (Or (Eq i ⟨1, Fin.instOfNat⟩) (Or (Eq i ⟨2, Fin.instOfNat⟩) (Eq i ⟨3, Fin.instOfNat⟩)))

CFDLean.MedianDual.flagBoundary.name: CFDLean.MedianDual.flagBoundary
CFDLean.MedianDual.flagBoundary.type: CFDLean.MedianDual.Points → Fin 4 → Fin 4 → Fin 4 → Fin 4 → Fin 4 → CFDLean.Vector 3

CFDLean.MedianDual.flagBoundary.eq_1.name: CFDLean.MedianDual.flagBoundary.eq_1
CFDLean.MedianDual.flagBoundary.eq_1.raw_type:
∀ (p : CFDLean.MedianDual.Points) (i j k l r : Fin (OfNat.ofNat 4)),

    (HSMul.hSMul (CFDLean.MedianDual.frameSign i j k l)
      (CFDLean.MedianDual.faceVector (CFDLean.MedianDual.flagPoints p i j k l) r))
CFDLean.MedianDual.flagBoundary.eq_1.type:
∀ (p : CFDLean.MedianDual.Points) (i j k l r : Fin 4),
  CFDLean.MedianDual.flagBoundary p i j k l r =
    CFDLean.MedianDual.frameSign i j k l • CFDLean.MedianDual.faceVector (CFDLean.MedianDual.flagPoints p i j k l) r

CFDLean.MedianDual.flagBoundary_sum.name: CFDLean.MedianDual.flagBoundary_sum
CFDLean.MedianDual.flagBoundary_sum.raw_type:
∀ (p : CFDLean.MedianDual.Points) (i j k l : Fin (OfNat.ofNat 4)),
  Eq (Finset.univ.sum fun r => CFDLean.MedianDual.flagBoundary p i j k l r) (OfNat.ofNat 0)
CFDLean.MedianDual.flagBoundary_sum.type: ∀ (p : CFDLean.MedianDual.Points) (i j k l : Fin 4), ∑ r, CFDLean.MedianDual.flagBoundary p i j k l r = 0

CFDLean.MedianDual.flagBoundary_sum._sim.name: CFDLean.MedianDual.flagBoundary_sum._simp_1_2
CFDLean.MedianDual.flagBoundary_sum._sim.raw_type:
∀ {M : Type u_1} {N : Type u_2} {γ : Type u_3} [inst : AddCommMonoid N] [inst_1 : DistribSMul M N] {r : M} {f : γ → N}
  {s : Finset γ}, Eq (s.sum fun x => HSMul.hSMul r (f x)) (HSMul.hSMul r (s.sum fun x => f x))
CFDLean.MedianDual.flagBoundary_sum._sim.type:
∀ {M : Type u_1} {N : Type u_2} {γ : Type u_3} [inst : AddCommMonoid N] [inst_1 : DistribSMul M N] {r : M} {f : γ → N}
  {s : Finset γ}, ∑ x ∈ s, r • f x = r • ∑ x ∈ s, f x

CFDLean.MedianDual.flagBoundary_three.name: CFDLean.MedianDual.flagBoundary_three
CFDLean.MedianDual.flagBoundary_three.raw_type:
∀ (p : CFDLean.MedianDual.Points) (i j k l : Fin (OfNat.ofNat 4)),
  Eq (CFDLean.MedianDual.flagBoundary p i j k l ⟨3, Fin.instOfNat⟩)
    (HSMul.hSMul (CFDLean.MedianDual.frameSign i j k l)
      (Neg.neg
        (CFDLean.MedianDual.triangle (p i) (CFDLean.MedianDual.midpoint p i j)
          (CFDLean.MedianDual.faceCenter p i j k))))
CFDLean.MedianDual.flagBoundary_three.type:
∀ (p : CFDLean.MedianDual.Points) (i j k l : Fin 4),
  CFDLean.MedianDual.flagBoundary p i j k l 3 =
    CFDLean.MedianDual.frameSign i j k l •
      -CFDLean.MedianDual.triangle (p i) (CFDLean.MedianDual.midpoint p i j) (CFDLean.MedianDual.faceCenter p i j k)

CFDLean.MedianDual.flagPoints.name: CFDLean.MedianDual.flagPoints
CFDLean.MedianDual.flagPoints.type: CFDLean.MedianDual.Points → Fin 4 → Fin 4 → Fin 4 → Fin 4 → CFDLean.MedianDual.Points

CFDLean.MedianDual.flag_boundaries_ident.name: CFDLean.MedianDual.flag_boundaries_identify
CFDLean.MedianDual.flag_boundaries_ident.raw_type:

CFDLean.MedianDual.flag_determinant.name: CFDLean.MedianDual.flag_determinant
CFDLean.MedianDual.flag_determinant.raw_type:
∀ (p : CFDLean.MedianDual.Points) (i j k l : Fin (OfNat.ofNat 4)),
  CFDLean.MedianDual.valid i j k l →
    Eq (CFDLean.MedianDual.sixVolume (CFDLean.MedianDual.flagPoints p i j k l))
      (HDiv.hDiv (HMul.hMul (CFDLean.MedianDual.frameSign i j k l) (CFDLean.MedianDual.sixVolume p)) (OfNat.ofNat 24))
CFDLean.MedianDual.flag_determinant.type:
∀ (p : CFDLean.MedianDual.Points) (i j k l : Fin 4),

    CFDLean.MedianDual.sixVolume (CFDLean.MedianDual.flagPoints p i j k l) =
      CFDLean.MedianDual.frameSign i j k l * CFDLean.MedianDual.sixVolume p / 24

CFDLean.MedianDual.flag_volume.name: CFDLean.MedianDual.flag_volume
CFDLean.MedianDual.flag_volume.raw_type:
∀ (p : CFDLean.MedianDual.Points) (i j k l : Fin (OfNat.ofNat 4)),

CFDLean.MedianDual.flag_volume.type:
∀ (p : CFDLean.MedianDual.Points) (i j k l : Fin 4),

CFDLean.MedianDual.frameSign.eq_1.name: CFDLean.MedianDual.frameSign.eq_1
CFDLean.MedianDual.frameSign.eq_1.raw_type:
∀ (i j k l : Fin (OfNat.ofNat 4)),
  Eq (CFDLean.MedianDual.frameSign i j k l)
    (HPow.hPow (Neg.neg (OfNat.ofNat 1))
      (HAdd.hAdd
        (HAdd.hAdd
          (HAdd.hAdd
            (HAdd.hAdd
              (HAdd.hAdd (ite (GT.gt i.val j.val) (OfNat.ofNat 1) (OfNat.ofNat 0))
                (ite (GT.gt i.val k.val) (OfNat.ofNat 1) (OfNat.ofNat 0)))
              (ite (GT.gt i.val l.val) (OfNat.ofNat 1) (OfNat.ofNat 0)))
            (ite (GT.gt j.val k.val) (OfNat.ofNat 1) (OfNat.ofNat 0)))
          (ite (GT.gt j.val l.val) (OfNat.ofNat 1) (OfNat.ofNat 0)))
        (ite (GT.gt k.val l.val) (OfNat.ofNat 1) (OfNat.ofNat 0))))
CFDLean.MedianDual.frameSign.eq_1.type:
∀ (i j k l : Fin 4),
  CFDLean.MedianDual.frameSign i j k l =
    (-1) ^
      ((((((if ↑i > ↑j then 1 else 0) + if ↑i > ↑k then 1 else 0) + if ↑i > ↑l then 1 else 0) +
            if ↑j > ↑k then 1 else 0) +
          if ↑j > ↑l then 1 else 0) +
        if ↑k > ↑l then 1 else 0)

CFDLean.MedianDual.frameSign_abs.name: CFDLean.MedianDual.frameSign_abs
CFDLean.MedianDual.frameSign_abs.raw_type: ∀ (i j k l : Fin (OfNat.ofNat 4)), Eq (abs (CFDLean.MedianDual.frameSign i j k l)) (OfNat.ofNat 1)
CFDLean.MedianDual.frameSign_abs.type: ∀ (i j k l : Fin 4), |CFDLean.MedianDual.frameSign i j k l| = 1

CFDLean.MedianDual.frameSign_sq.name: CFDLean.MedianDual.frameSign_sq
CFDLean.MedianDual.frameSign_sq.raw_type: ∀ (i j k l : Fin (OfNat.ofNat 4)), Eq (HPow.hPow (CFDLean.MedianDual.frameSign i j k l) (OfNat.ofNat 2)) (OfNat.ofNat 1)
CFDLean.MedianDual.frameSign_sq.type: ∀ (i j k l : Fin 4), CFDLean.MedianDual.frameSign i j k l ^ 2 = 1

CFDLean.MedianDual.frameSign_swapJK.name: CFDLean.MedianDual.frameSign_swapJK
CFDLean.MedianDual.frameSign_swapJK.raw_type:
∀ (i j k l : Fin (OfNat.ofNat 4)),
  CFDLean.MedianDual.valid i j k l →
    Eq (CFDLean.MedianDual.frameSign i k j l) (Neg.neg (CFDLean.MedianDual.frameSign i j k l))
CFDLean.MedianDual.frameSign_swapJK.type:
∀ (i j k l : Fin 4),
  CFDLean.MedianDual.valid i j k l → CFDLean.MedianDual.frameSign i k j l = -CFDLean.MedianDual.frameSign i j k l

CFDLean.MedianDual.frameSign_swapKL.name: CFDLean.MedianDual.frameSign_swapKL
CFDLean.MedianDual.frameSign_swapKL.raw_type:
∀ (i j k l : Fin (OfNat.ofNat 4)),
  CFDLean.MedianDual.valid i j k l →

CFDLean.MedianDual.frameSign_swapKL.type:
∀ (i j k l : Fin 4),
  CFDLean.MedianDual.valid i j k l → CFDLean.MedianDual.frameSign i j l k = -CFDLean.MedianDual.frameSign i j k l

CFDLean.MedianDual.frame_sum.name: CFDLean.MedianDual.frame_sum
CFDLean.MedianDual.frame_sum.raw_type:
∀ (p : CFDLean.MedianDual.Points) (i j k l : Fin (OfNat.ofNat 4)),
  CFDLean.MedianDual.valid i j k l →
    Eq (HAdd.hAdd (HAdd.hAdd (HAdd.hAdd (p i) (p j)) (p k)) (p l))
      (HAdd.hAdd (HAdd.hAdd (HAdd.hAdd (p ⟨0, Fin.instOfNat⟩) (p ⟨1, Fin.instOfNat⟩)) (p ⟨2, Fin.instOfNat⟩))
        (p ⟨3, Fin.instOfNat⟩))
CFDLean.MedianDual.frame_sum.type:
∀ (p : CFDLean.MedianDual.Points) (i j k l : Fin 4),
  CFDLean.MedianDual.valid i j k l → p i + p j + p k + p l = p 0 + p 1 + p 2 + p 3

CFDLean.MedianDual.instDecidableValid.name: CFDLean.MedianDual.instDecidableValid
CFDLean.MedianDual.instDecidableValid.type: (i j k l : Fin 4) → Decidable (CFDLean.MedianDual.valid i j k l)

CFDLean.MedianDual.instDecidableValid._p.name: CFDLean.MedianDual.instDecidableValid._proof_1
CFDLean.MedianDual.instDecidableValid._p.raw_type:
∀ (i j k l : Fin (OfNat.ofNat 4)),
  ((decide (Ne i.val j.val)).and
        (decide
          (And (Ne i.val k.val)
            (And (Ne i.val l.val) (And (Ne j.val k.val) (And (Ne j.val l.val) (Ne k.val l.val))))))).Reflects
    (CFDLean.MedianDual.valid i j k l)
CFDLean.MedianDual.instDecidableValid._p.type:
∀ (i j k l : Fin 4),
  (decide (↑i ≠ ↑j) && decide (↑i ≠ ↑k ∧ ↑i ≠ ↑l ∧ ↑j ≠ ↑k ∧ ↑j ≠ ↑l ∧ ↑k ≠ ↑l)).Reflects
    (CFDLean.MedianDual.valid i j k l)

CFDLean.MedianDual.internal_face_one_pai.name: CFDLean.MedianDual.internal_face_one_pair
CFDLean.MedianDual.internal_face_one_pai.raw_type:
∀ (p : CFDLean.MedianDual.Points) (i j k l : Fin (OfNat.ofNat 4)),

CFDLean.MedianDual.internal_face_one_pai.type:
∀ (p : CFDLean.MedianDual.Points) (i j k l : Fin 4),

    CFDLean.MedianDual.flagBoundary p i j k l 1 + CFDLean.MedianDual.flagBoundary p i k j l 1 = 0

CFDLean.MedianDual.internal_face_two_pai.name: CFDLean.MedianDual.internal_face_two_pair
CFDLean.MedianDual.internal_face_two_pai.raw_type:
∀ (p : CFDLean.MedianDual.Points) (i j k l : Fin (OfNat.ofNat 4)),
  CFDLean.MedianDual.valid i j k l →

      (HAdd.hAdd (CFDLean.MedianDual.flagBoundary p i j k l ⟨2, Fin.instOfNat⟩)
        (CFDLean.MedianDual.flagBoundary p i j l k ⟨2, Fin.instOfNat⟩))
      (OfNat.ofNat 0)
CFDLean.MedianDual.internal_face_two_pai.type:
∀ (p : CFDLean.MedianDual.Points) (i j k l : Fin 4),
  CFDLean.MedianDual.valid i j k l →
    CFDLean.MedianDual.flagBoundary p i j k l 2 + CFDLean.MedianDual.flagBoundary p i j l k 2 = 0

CFDLean.MedianDual.localDualVolume_eq.name: CFDLean.MedianDual.localDualVolume_eq
CFDLean.MedianDual.localDualVolume_eq.raw_type:
∀ (p : CFDLean.MedianDual.Points) (i : Fin (OfNat.ofNat 4)),

CFDLean.MedianDual.localDualVolume_eq.type: ∀ (p : CFDLean.MedianDual.Points) (i : Fin 4), CFDLean.MedianDual.localDualVolume p i = CFDLean.MedianDual.volume p / 4

CFDLean.MedianDual.localHullVector.eq_1.name: CFDLean.MedianDual.localHullVector.eq_1
CFDLean.MedianDual.localHullVector.eq_1.raw_type:
∀ (p : CFDLean.MedianDual.Points) (i : Fin (OfNat.ofNat 4)),
  Eq (CFDLean.MedianDual.localHullVector p i)
    (Finset.univ.sum fun f =>
      HAdd.hAdd (CFDLean.MedianDual.flagBoundary p i f.val.1 f.val.2.1 f.val.2.2 ⟨0, Fin.instOfNat⟩)
        (CFDLean.MedianDual.flagBoundary p i f.val.1 f.val.2.1 f.val.2.2 ⟨3, Fin.instOfNat⟩))
CFDLean.MedianDual.localHullVector.eq_1.type:
∀ (p : CFDLean.MedianDual.Points) (i : Fin 4),
  CFDLean.MedianDual.localHullVector p i =
    ∑ f,
      (CFDLean.MedianDual.flagBoundary p i (↑f).1 (↑f).2.1 (↑f).2.2 0 +
        CFDLean.MedianDual.flagBoundary p i (↑f).1 (↑f).2.1 (↑f).2.2 3)

CFDLean.MedianDual.localHull_identificat.name: CFDLean.MedianDual.localHull_identification
CFDLean.MedianDual.localHull_identificat.raw_type:
∀ (p : CFDLean.MedianDual.Points) (i : Fin (OfNat.ofNat 4)),
  Eq (CFDLean.MedianDual.localHullVector p i)
    (HAdd.hAdd (Finset.univ.sum fun j => CFDLean.MedianDual.localInterface p i j)
      (Finset.univ.sum fun j => CFDLean.MedianDual.localPatch p j i))
CFDLean.MedianDual.localHull_identificat.type:
∀ (p : CFDLean.MedianDual.Points) (i : Fin 4),
  CFDLean.MedianDual.localHullVector p i =
    ∑ j, CFDLean.MedianDual.localInterface p i j + ∑ j, CFDLean.MedianDual.localPatch p j i

CFDLean.MedianDual.localInterface.eq_1.name: CFDLean.MedianDual.localInterface.eq_1
CFDLean.MedianDual.localInterface.eq_1.raw_type:
∀ (p : CFDLean.MedianDual.Points) (i j : Fin (OfNat.ofNat 4)),
  Eq (CFDLean.MedianDual.localInterface p i j)
    (Finset.univ.sum fun k =>
      Finset.univ.sum fun l =>
        ite (CFDLean.MedianDual.valid i j k l) (CFDLean.MedianDual.outwardTriangle p i j k l) (OfNat.ofNat 0))
CFDLean.MedianDual.localInterface.eq_1.type:
∀ (p : CFDLean.MedianDual.Points) (i j : Fin 4),
  CFDLean.MedianDual.localInterface p i j =
    ∑ k, ∑ l, if CFDLean.MedianDual.valid i j k l then CFDLean.MedianDual.outwardTriangle p i j k l else 0

CFDLean.MedianDual.localInterface_eq.name: CFDLean.MedianDual.localInterface_eq
CFDLean.MedianDual.localInterface_eq.raw_type:
∀ (p : CFDLean.MedianDual.Points) (i j : Fin (OfNat.ofNat 4)),
  Eq (CFDLean.MedianDual.localInterface p i j)
    (HSMul.hSMul (HDiv.hDiv (OfNat.ofNat 1) (OfNat.ofNat 12))
      (HSub.hSub (CFDLean.MedianDual.faceVector p i) (CFDLean.MedianDual.faceVector p j)))
CFDLean.MedianDual.localInterface_eq.type:
∀ (p : CFDLean.MedianDual.Points) (i j : Fin 4),
  CFDLean.MedianDual.localInterface p i j =
    (1 / 12) • (CFDLean.MedianDual.faceVector p i - CFDLean.MedianDual.faceVector p j)

CFDLean.MedianDual.localInterface_revers.name: CFDLean.MedianDual.localInterface_reverse
CFDLean.MedianDual.localInterface_revers.raw_type:
∀ (p : CFDLean.MedianDual.Points) (i j : Fin (OfNat.ofNat 4)),
  Eq (CFDLean.MedianDual.localInterface p j i) (Neg.neg (CFDLean.MedianDual.localInterface p i j))
CFDLean.MedianDual.localInterface_revers.type:
∀ (p : CFDLean.MedianDual.Points) (i j : Fin 4),
  CFDLean.MedianDual.localInterface p j i = -CFDLean.MedianDual.localInterface p i j

CFDLean.MedianDual.localInterface_self.name: CFDLean.MedianDual.localInterface_self
CFDLean.MedianDual.localInterface_self.raw_type:
∀ (p : CFDLean.MedianDual.Points) (i : Fin (OfNat.ofNat 4)),
  Eq (CFDLean.MedianDual.localInterface p i i) (OfNat.ofNat 0)
CFDLean.MedianDual.localInterface_self.type: ∀ (p : CFDLean.MedianDual.Points) (i : Fin 4), CFDLean.MedianDual.localInterface p i i = 0

CFDLean.MedianDual.localPatch.eq_1.name: CFDLean.MedianDual.localPatch.eq_1
CFDLean.MedianDual.localPatch.eq_1.raw_type:
∀ (p : CFDLean.MedianDual.Points) (opp owner : Fin (OfNat.ofNat 4)),
  Eq (CFDLean.MedianDual.localPatch p opp owner)
    (Finset.univ.sum fun j =>
      Finset.univ.sum fun k =>
        ite (CFDLean.MedianDual.valid owner j k opp)
          (CFDLean.MedianDual.flagBoundary p owner j k opp ⟨3, Fin.instOfNat⟩) (OfNat.ofNat 0))
CFDLean.MedianDual.localPatch.eq_1.type:
∀ (p : CFDLean.MedianDual.Points) (opp owner : Fin 4),
  CFDLean.MedianDual.localPatch p opp owner =
    ∑ j, ∑ k, if CFDLean.MedianDual.valid owner j k opp then CFDLean.MedianDual.flagBoundary p owner j k opp 3 else 0

CFDLean.MedianDual.localPatch_eq.name: CFDLean.MedianDual.localPatch_eq
CFDLean.MedianDual.localPatch_eq.raw_type:
∀ (p : CFDLean.MedianDual.Points) (opp owner : Fin (OfNat.ofNat 4)),
  Eq (CFDLean.MedianDual.localPatch p opp owner)
    (ite (Eq owner.val opp.val) (OfNat.ofNat 0)
      (HSMul.hSMul (HDiv.hDiv (OfNat.ofNat 1) (OfNat.ofNat 3)) (CFDLean.MedianDual.faceVector p opp)))
CFDLean.MedianDual.localPatch_eq.type:
∀ (p : CFDLean.MedianDual.Points) (opp owner : Fin 4),
  CFDLean.MedianDual.localPatch p opp owner = if ↑owner = ↑opp then 0 else (1 / 3) • CFDLean.MedianDual.faceVector p opp

CFDLean.MedianDual.local_closure.name: CFDLean.MedianDual.local_closure
CFDLean.MedianDual.local_closure.raw_type:
∀ (p : CFDLean.MedianDual.Points) (i : Fin (OfNat.ofNat 4)),
  Eq
    (HAdd.hAdd (Finset.univ.sum fun j => CFDLean.MedianDual.localInterface p i j)
      (Finset.univ.sum fun j => CFDLean.MedianDual.localPatch p j i))
    (OfNat.ofNat 0)
CFDLean.MedianDual.local_closure.type:
∀ (p : CFDLean.MedianDual.Points) (i : Fin 4),
  ∑ j, CFDLean.MedianDual.localInterface p i j + ∑ j, CFDLean.MedianDual.localPatch p j i = 0

CFDLean.MedianDual.midpoint.eq_1.name: CFDLean.MedianDual.midpoint.eq_1
CFDLean.MedianDual.midpoint.eq_1.raw_type:
∀ (p : CFDLean.MedianDual.Points) (i j : Fin (OfNat.ofNat 4)),
  Eq (CFDLean.MedianDual.midpoint p i j)
    (HSMul.hSMul (HDiv.hDiv (OfNat.ofNat 1) (OfNat.ofNat 2)) (HAdd.hAdd (p i) (p j)))
CFDLean.MedianDual.midpoint.eq_1.type: ∀ (p : CFDLean.MedianDual.Points) (i j : Fin 4), CFDLean.MedianDual.midpoint p i j = (1 / 2) • (p i + p j)

CFDLean.MedianDual.nonzero_has_positive_.name: CFDLean.MedianDual.nonzero_has_positive_order
CFDLean.MedianDual.nonzero_has_positive_.raw_type:
∀ (p : CFDLean.MedianDual.Points),
  Ne (CFDLean.MedianDual.sixVolume p) (OfNat.ofNat 0) →
    Or (LT.lt (OfNat.ofNat 0) (CFDLean.MedianDual.sixVolume p))
      (LT.lt (OfNat.ofNat 0)
        (CFDLean.MedianDual.sixVolume
          (Matrix.vecCons (p ⟨0, Fin.instOfNat⟩)
            (Matrix.vecCons (p ⟨2, Fin.instOfNat⟩)
              (Matrix.vecCons (p ⟨1, Fin.instOfNat⟩) (Matrix.vecCons (p ⟨3, Fin.instOfNat⟩) Matrix.vecEmpty))))))
CFDLean.MedianDual.nonzero_has_positive_.type:
∀ (p : CFDLean.MedianDual.Points),
  CFDLean.MedianDual.sixVolume p ≠ 0 →
    0 < CFDLean.MedianDual.sixVolume p ∨ 0 < CFDLean.MedianDual.sixVolume ![p 0, p 2, p 1, p 3]

CFDLean.MedianDual.ordered_determinant.name: CFDLean.MedianDual.ordered_determinant
CFDLean.MedianDual.ordered_determinant.raw_type:
∀ (p : CFDLean.MedianDual.Points) (i j k l : Fin (OfNat.ofNat 4)),
  CFDLean.MedianDual.valid i j k l →
    Eq (CFDLean.MedianDual.determinant (HSub.hSub (p j) (p i)) (HSub.hSub (p k) (p i)) (HSub.hSub (p l) (p i)))
      (HMul.hMul (CFDLean.MedianDual.frameSign i j k l) (CFDLean.MedianDual.sixVolume p))
CFDLean.MedianDual.ordered_determinant.type:
∀ (p : CFDLean.MedianDual.Points) (i j k l : Fin 4),
  CFDLean.MedianDual.valid i j k l →
    CFDLean.MedianDual.determinant (p j - p i) (p k - p i) (p l - p i) =
      CFDLean.MedianDual.frameSign i j k l * CFDLean.MedianDual.sixVolume p

CFDLean.MedianDual.outwardTriangle.name: CFDLean.MedianDual.outwardTriangle
CFDLean.MedianDual.outwardTriangle.type: CFDLean.MedianDual.Points → Fin 4 → Fin 4 → Fin 4 → Fin 4 → CFDLean.Vector 3

CFDLean.MedianDual.outwardTriangle.eq_1.name: CFDLean.MedianDual.outwardTriangle.eq_1
CFDLean.MedianDual.outwardTriangle.eq_1.raw_type:
∀ (p : CFDLean.MedianDual.Points) (i j k l : Fin (OfNat.ofNat 4)),
  Eq (CFDLean.MedianDual.outwardTriangle p i j k l)
    (HSMul.hSMul (CFDLean.MedianDual.frameSign i j k l)
      (CFDLean.MedianDual.triangle (CFDLean.MedianDual.midpoint p i j) (CFDLean.MedianDual.faceCenter p i j k)
        (CFDLean.MedianDual.cellCenter p)))
CFDLean.MedianDual.outwardTriangle.eq_1.type:
∀ (p : CFDLean.MedianDual.Points) (i j k l : Fin 4),
  CFDLean.MedianDual.outwardTriangle p i j k l =
    CFDLean.MedianDual.frameSign i j k l •
      CFDLean.MedianDual.triangle (CFDLean.MedianDual.midpoint p i j) (CFDLean.MedianDual.faceCenter p i j k)
        (CFDLean.MedianDual.cellCenter p)

CFDLean.MedianDual.outwardTriangle_dot.name: CFDLean.MedianDual.outwardTriangle_dot
CFDLean.MedianDual.outwardTriangle_dot.raw_type:
∀ (p : CFDLean.MedianDual.Points) (i j k l : Fin (OfNat.ofNat 4)),
  CFDLean.MedianDual.valid i j k l →
    Eq (CFDLean.dot (CFDLean.MedianDual.outwardTriangle p i j k l) (HSub.hSub (p j) (p i)))
      (HDiv.hDiv (CFDLean.MedianDual.sixVolume p) (OfNat.ofNat 24))
CFDLean.MedianDual.outwardTriangle_dot.type:
∀ (p : CFDLean.MedianDual.Points) (i j k l : Fin 4),
  CFDLean.MedianDual.valid i j k l →
    CFDLean.dot (CFDLean.MedianDual.outwardTriangle p i j k l) (p j - p i) = CFDLean.MedianDual.sixVolume p / 24

CFDLean.MedianDual.sixVolume.eq_1.name: CFDLean.MedianDual.sixVolume.eq_1
CFDLean.MedianDual.sixVolume.eq_1.raw_type:
∀ (p : CFDLean.MedianDual.Points),
  Eq (CFDLean.MedianDual.sixVolume p)
    (CFDLean.MedianDual.determinant (HSub.hSub (p ⟨1, Fin.instOfNat⟩) (p ⟨0, Fin.instOfNat⟩))
      (HSub.hSub (p ⟨2, Fin.instOfNat⟩) (p ⟨0, Fin.instOfNat⟩))
      (HSub.hSub (p ⟨3, Fin.instOfNat⟩) (p ⟨0, Fin.instOfNat⟩)))
CFDLean.MedianDual.sixVolume.eq_1.type:
∀ (p : CFDLean.MedianDual.Points),
  CFDLean.MedianDual.sixVolume p = CFDLean.MedianDual.determinant (p 1 - p 0) (p 2 - p 0) (p 3 - p 0)

CFDLean.MedianDual.sixVolume_swap12.name: CFDLean.MedianDual.sixVolume_swap12
CFDLean.MedianDual.sixVolume_swap12.raw_type:
∀ (p : CFDLean.MedianDual.Points),
  Eq
    (CFDLean.MedianDual.sixVolume

          (Finset.univ.sum fun p =>
            ite (And (Eq (bd p) true) (And (Membership.mem (M.facetNodes p) i) (Membership.mem (M.facetNodes p) k)))
              (HSMul.hSMul
                (HDiv.hDiv (HAdd.hAdd (OfNat.ofNat 1) (ite (Eq i k) (OfNat.ofNat 1) (OfNat.ofNat 0)))
                  (HMul.hMul d.cast (HAdd.hAdd d.cast (OfNat.ofNat 1))))
                (M.areaVec p))

  (bd : C × Fin (d + 1) → Bool),
  M.FacetBalanced bd →
    1 ≤ d →
      ∀ (i k : ι),
        M.B i k =
          ∑ p,
            if bd p = true ∧ i ∈ M.facetNodes p ∧ k ∈ M.facetNodes p then
              ((1 + if i = k then 1 else 0) / (↑d * (↑d + 1))) • M.areaVec p
            else 0

CFDLean.Num.Internal.Closure.cell_identi.name: CFDLean.Num.Internal.Closure.cell_identity
CFDLean.Num.Internal.Closure.cell_identi.raw_type:
∀ {ι C : Type} [Fintype ι] [inst : DecidableEq ι] [Fintype C] {d : Nat} (M : CFDLean.Num.WMesh ι C d) (T : C) (i k : ι),
  Eq
    (HSMul.hSMul (HMul.hMul d.cast (HAdd.hAdd d.cast (OfNat.ofNat 1)))
      (Finset.univ.sum fun a =>
        Finset.univ.sum fun b =>
          ite (And (Eq (DFunLike.coe (M.vert T) a) i) (Eq (DFunLike.coe (M.vert T) b) k))
            (HSMul.hSMul (M.m T) (HAdd.hAdd (M.g T a) (M.g T b))) (OfNat.ofNat 0)))
    (HSMul.hSMul (ite (Eq i k) (OfNat.ofNat 2) (OfNat.ofNat 1))
      (Finset.univ.sum fun o =>
        ite (And (Membership.mem (M.facetNodes (Prod.mk T o)) i) (Membership.mem (M.facetNodes (Prod.mk T o)) k))
          (M.facetVec (Prod.mk T o)) (OfNat.ofNat 0)))
CFDLean.Num.Internal.Closure.cell_identi.type:
∀ {ι C : Type} [Fintype ι] [inst : DecidableEq ι] [Fintype C] {d : ℕ} (M : CFDLean.Num.WMesh ι C d) (T : C) (i k : ι),
  ((↑d * (↑d + 1)) • ∑ a, ∑ b, if (M.vert T) a = i ∧ (M.vert T) b = k then M.m T • (M.g T a + M.g T b) else 0) =
    (if i = k then 2 else 1) • ∑ o, if i ∈ M.facetNodes (T, o) ∧ k ∈ M.facetNodes (T, o) then M.facetVec (T, o) else 0

CFDLean.Num.Internal.DissGeom.cs.name: CFDLean.Num.Internal.DissGeom.cs
CFDLean.Num.Internal.DissGeom.cs.raw_type:
∀ {d : Nat} (y e : CFDLean.Num.Vec d),
  Ne (CFDLean.Num.dot e e) (OfNat.ofNat 0) →
    And
      (LE.le (HPow.hPow (CFDLean.Num.dot y e) (OfNat.ofNat 2)) (HMul.hMul (CFDLean.Num.dot y y) (CFDLean.Num.dot e e)))
      (Eq (HPow.hPow (CFDLean.Num.dot y e) (OfNat.ofNat 2)) (HMul.hMul (CFDLean.Num.dot y y) (CFDLean.Num.dot e e)) →
        Eq y (HSMul.hSMul (HDiv.hDiv (CFDLean.Num.dot y e) (CFDLean.Num.dot e e)) e))
CFDLean.Num.Internal.DissGeom.cs.type:
∀ {d : ℕ} (y e : CFDLean.Num.Vec d),
  CFDLean.Num.dot e e ≠ 0 →
    CFDLean.Num.dot y e ^ 2 ≤ CFDLean.Num.dot y y * CFDLean.Num.dot e e ∧
      (CFDLean.Num.dot y e ^ 2 = CFDLean.Num.dot y y * CFDLean.Num.dot e e →
        y = (CFDLean.Num.dot y e / CFDLean.Num.dot e e) • e)

CFDLean.Num.Internal.DissGeom.dot_c.name: CFDLean.Num.Internal.DissGeom.dot_c
CFDLean.Num.Internal.DissGeom.dot_c.raw_type:
∀ {ι C : Type} [Fintype ι] [inst : DecidableEq ι] [inst_1 : Fintype C] {d : Nat} (M : CFDLean.Num.WMesh ι C d) (i k : ι)
  (v : CFDLean.Num.Vec d),
  Eq (CFDLean.Num.dot (M.c i k) v)
    (Finset.univ.sum fun T =>
      Finset.univ.sum fun a =>
        Finset.univ.sum fun b =>
          ite (And (Eq (DFunLike.coe (M.vert T) a) i) (Eq (DFunLike.coe (M.vert T) b) k))
            (HMul.hMul (HMul.hMul (M.ω T) (M.m T)) (CFDLean.Num.dot (M.g T b) v)) (OfNat.ofNat 0))
CFDLean.Num.Internal.DissGeom.dot_c.type:
∀ {ι C : Type} [Fintype ι] [inst : DecidableEq ι] [inst_1 : Fintype C] {d : ℕ} (M : CFDLean.Num.WMesh ι C d) (i k : ι)
  (v : CFDLean.Num.Vec d),
  CFDLean.Num.dot (M.c i k) v =
    ∑ T, ∑ a, ∑ b, if (M.vert T) a = i ∧ (M.vert T) b = k then M.ω T * M.m T * CFDLean.Num.dot (M.g T b) v else 0

CFDLean.Num.Internal.DissGeom.dot_c_e.raw_type:

      Eq (CFDLean.Num.dot (M.g T a) (HSub.hSub (M.pos (DFunLike.coe (M.vert T) b)) (M.pos (DFunLike.coe (M.vert T) c))))
        (HSub.hSub (ite (Eq a b) (OfNat.ofNat 1) (OfNat.ofNat 0)) (ite (Eq a c) (OfNat.ofNat 1) (OfNat.ofNat 0)))
CFDLean.Num.Internal.DissGeom.gdot.type:

  (Eq e (OfNat.ofNat 0) → Eq y (OfNat.ofNat 0)) →
    Iff
      (Eq
        (HMul.hMul (HMul.hMul (CFDLean.Num.len y) (CFDLean.Num.len e))
          (CFDLean.Num.dot (CFDLean.Num.WMesh.unit e) (CFDLean.Num.WMesh.unit e)))
        (CFDLean.Num.dot y e))
      (Exists fun t => And (LE.le (OfNat.ofNat 0) t) (Eq y (HSMul.hSMul t e)))
CFDLean.Num.Internal.DissGeom.term_eq_if.type:
∀ {d : ℕ} (y e : CFDLean.Num.Vec d),
  (e = 0 → y = 0) →
    (CFDLean.Num.len y * CFDLean.Num.len e * CFDLean.Num.dot (CFDLean.Num.WMesh.unit e) (CFDLean.Num.WMesh.unit e) =
        CFDLean.Num.dot y e ↔
      ∃ t, 0 ≤ t ∧ y = t • e)

CFDLean.Num.Internal.DissGeom.term_ge.name: CFDLean.Num.Internal.DissGeom.term_ge
CFDLean.Num.Internal.DissGeom.term_ge.raw_type:
∀ {d : Nat} (y e : CFDLean.Num.Vec d),
  LE.le (CFDLean.Num.dot y e)
    (HMul.hMul (HMul.hMul (CFDLean.Num.len y) (CFDLean.Num.len e))
      (CFDLean.Num.dot (CFDLean.Num.WMesh.unit e) (CFDLean.Num.WMesh.unit e)))
CFDLean.Num.Internal.DissGeom.term_ge.type:
∀ {d : ℕ} (y e : CFDLean.Num.Vec d),
  CFDLean.Num.dot y e ≤
    CFDLean.Num.len y * CFDLean.Num.len e * CFDLean.Num.dot (CFDLean.Num.WMesh.unit e) (CFDLean.Num.WMesh.unit e)

CFDLean.Num.Internal.DissGeom.trace_G.name: CFDLean.Num.Internal.DissGeom.trace_G
CFDLean.Num.Internal.DissGeom.trace_G.raw_type:
∀ {ι C : Type} [inst : Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] [Fintype C] {d : Nat} (M : CFDLean.Num.WMesh ι C d)
  (y : ι → ι → CFDLean.Num.Vec d) (i : ι),
  Eq (M.Gtensor y i).trace
    (Finset.univ.sum fun k =>
      HMul.hMul (HMul.hMul (CFDLean.Num.len (y i k)) (CFDLean.Num.len (M.e i k)))
        (CFDLean.Num.dot (CFDLean.Num.WMesh.unit (M.e i k)) (CFDLean.Num.WMesh.unit (M.e i k))))
CFDLean.Num.Internal.DissGeom.trace_G.type:
∀ {ι C : Type} [inst : Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] [Fintype C] {d : ℕ} (M : CFDLean.Num.WMesh ι C d)
  (y : ι → ι → CFDLean.Num.Vec d) (i : ι),
  (M.Gtensor y i).trace =
    ∑ k,
      CFDLean.Num.len (y i k) * CFDLean.Num.len (M.e i k) *
        CFDLean.Num.dot (CFDLean.Num.WMesh.unit (M.e i k)) (CFDLean.Num.WMesh.unit (M.e i k))

CFDLean.Num.Internal.DissGeom.trace_oute.name: CFDLean.Num.Internal.DissGeom.trace_outer
CFDLean.Num.Internal.DissGeom.trace_oute.raw_type: ∀ {d : Nat} (u v : CFDLean.Num.Vec d), Eq (CFDLean.Num.outer u v).trace (CFDLean.Num.dot u v)
CFDLean.Num.Internal.DissGeom.trace_oute.type: ∀ {d : ℕ} (u v : CFDLean.Num.Vec d), (CFDLean.Num.outer u v).trace = CFDLean.Num.dot u v

CFDLean.Num.Internal.DissGeom.wm_nonneg.name: CFDLean.Num.Internal.DissGeom.wm_nonneg
CFDLean.Num.Internal.DissGeom.wm_nonneg.raw_type:
∀ {ι C : Type} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] [Fintype C] {d : Nat} (M : CFDLean.Num.WMesh ι C d),
  M.Valid → ∀ (T : C), LE.le (OfNat.ofNat 0) (HMul.hMul (M.ω T) (M.m T))
CFDLean.Num.Internal.DissGeom.wm_nonneg.type:
∀ {ι C : Type} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] [Fintype C] {d : ℕ} (M : CFDLean.Num.WMesh ι C d),
  M.Valid → ∀ (T : C), 0 ≤ M.ω T * M.m T

CFDLean.Num.Internal.Geo3.cross_dot_left.raw_type: ∀ (u v : CFDLean.Num.Vec (OfNat.ofNat 3)), Eq (CFDLean.Num.dot (CFDLean.Num.cross3 u v) u) (OfNat.ofNat 0)
CFDLean.Num.Internal.Geo3.cross_dot_left.type: ∀ (u v : CFDLean.Num.Vec 3), CFDLean.Num.dot (CFDLean.Num.cross3 u v) u = 0

CFDLean.Num.Internal.Geo3.cross_dot_righ.name: CFDLean.Num.Internal.Geo3.cross_dot_right
CFDLean.Num.Internal.Geo3.cross_dot_righ.raw_type: ∀ (u v : CFDLean.Num.Vec (OfNat.ofNat 3)), Eq (CFDLean.Num.dot (CFDLean.Num.cross3 u v) v) (OfNat.ofNat 0)
CFDLean.Num.Internal.Geo3.cross_dot_righ.type: ∀ (u v : CFDLean.Num.Vec 3), CFDLean.Num.dot (CFDLean.Num.cross3 u v) v = 0

CFDLean.Num.Internal.Geo3.det_edge3.name: CFDLean.Num.Internal.Geo3.det_edge3
CFDLean.Num.Internal.Geo3.det_edge3.raw_type:
∀ (T : CFDLean.Num.Simplex (OfNat.ofNat 3)),
  Eq T.edgeMat.det
    (CFDLean.Num.dot
      (CFDLean.Num.cross3 (HSub.hSub (T.x ⟨1, Fin.instOfNat⟩) (T.x ⟨0, Fin.instOfNat⟩))
        (HSub.hSub (T.x ⟨2, Fin.instOfNat⟩) (T.x ⟨0, Fin.instOfNat⟩)))
      (HSub.hSub (T.x ⟨3, Fin.instOfNat⟩) (T.x ⟨0, Fin.instOfNat⟩)))
CFDLean.Num.Internal.Geo3.det_edge3.type:
∀ (T : CFDLean.Num.Simplex 3),
  T.edgeMat.det = CFDLean.Num.dot (CFDLean.Num.cross3 (T.x 1 - T.x 0) (T.x 2 - T.x 0)) (T.x 3 - T.x 0)

CFDLean.Num.Internal.Geo3.dot_comm'.name: CFDLean.Num.Internal.Geo3.dot_comm'
CFDLean.Num.Internal.Geo3.dot_comm'.raw_type: ∀ {d : Nat} (u v : CFDLean.Num.Vec d), Eq (CFDLean.Num.dot u v) (CFDLean.Num.dot v u)
CFDLean.Num.Internal.Geo3.dot_comm'.type: ∀ {d : ℕ} (u v : CFDLean.Num.Vec d), CFDLean.Num.dot u v = CFDLean.Num.dot v u

CFDLean.Num.Internal.Geo3.dot_neg_left.name: CFDLean.Num.Internal.Geo3.dot_neg_left
CFDLean.Num.Internal.Geo3.dot_neg_left.raw_type: ∀ {d : Nat} (u w : CFDLean.Num.Vec d), Eq (CFDLean.Num.dot (Neg.neg u) w) (Neg.neg (CFDLean.Num.dot u w))
CFDLean.Num.Internal.Geo3.dot_neg_left.type: ∀ {d : ℕ} (u w : CFDLean.Num.Vec d), CFDLean.Num.dot (-u) w = -CFDLean.Num.dot u w

CFDLean.Num.Internal.Geo3.dot_neg_right.name: CFDLean.Num.Internal.Geo3.dot_neg_right
CFDLean.Num.Internal.Geo3.dot_neg_right.raw_type: ∀ {d : Nat} (u w : CFDLean.Num.Vec d), Eq (CFDLean.Num.dot u (Neg.neg w)) (Neg.neg (CFDLean.Num.dot u w))
CFDLean.Num.Internal.Geo3.dot_neg_right.type: ∀ {d : ℕ} (u w : CFDLean.Num.Vec d), CFDLean.Num.dot u (-w) = -CFDLean.Num.dot u w

CFDLean.Num.Internal.Geo3.dot_single_lef.name: CFDLean.Num.Internal.Geo3.dot_single_left
CFDLean.Num.Internal.Geo3.dot_single_lef.raw_type: ∀ {d : Nat} (p : Fin d) (c : Real) (v : CFDLean.Num.Vec d), Eq (CFDLean.Num.dot (Pi.single p c) v) (HMul.hMul c (v p))
CFDLean.Num.Internal.Geo3.dot_single_lef.type: ∀ {d : ℕ} (p : Fin d) (c : ℝ) (v : CFDLean.Num.Vec d), CFDLean.Num.dot (Pi.single p c) v = c * v p

CFDLean.Num.Internal.Geo3.dot_single_lef.name: CFDLean.Num.Internal.Geo3.dot_single_left._simp_1_2
CFDLean.Num.Internal.Geo3.dot_single_lef.raw_type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype α] (x : α), Eq (Membership.mem Finset.univ x) True
CFDLean.Num.Internal.Geo3.dot_single_lef.type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype α] (x : α), (x ∈ Finset.univ) = True

CFDLean.Num.Internal.Geo3.dot_sub_left.name: CFDLean.Num.Internal.Geo3.dot_sub_left
CFDLean.Num.Internal.Geo3.dot_sub_left.raw_type:
∀ {d : Nat} (u v w : CFDLean.Num.Vec d),

CFDLean.Num.Internal.Geo3.dot_sub_left.type: ∀ {d : ℕ} (u v w : CFDLean.Num.Vec d), CFDLean.Num.dot (u - v) w = CFDLean.Num.dot u w - CFDLean.Num.dot v w

CFDLean.Num.Internal.Geo3.dot_sub_right.name: CFDLean.Num.Internal.Geo3.dot_sub_right
CFDLean.Num.Internal.Geo3.dot_sub_right.raw_type:
∀ {d : Nat} (u v w : CFDLean.Num.Vec d),
  Eq (CFDLean.Num.dot u (HSub.hSub v w)) (HSub.hSub (CFDLean.Num.dot u v) (CFDLean.Num.dot u w))
CFDLean.Num.Internal.Geo3.dot_sub_right.type: ∀ {d : ℕ} (u v w : CFDLean.Num.Vec d), CFDLean.Num.dot u (v - w) = CFDLean.Num.dot u v - CFDLean.Num.dot u w

CFDLean.Num.Internal.Geo3.facet_cross.name: CFDLean.Num.Internal.Geo3.facet_cross
CFDLean.Num.Internal.Geo3.facet_cross.raw_type:
∀ (T : CFDLean.Num.Simplex (OfNat.ofNat 3)) (o a b c : Fin (OfNat.ofNat 4)),
  T.Nondeg →
    (List.cons o (List.cons a (List.cons b (List.cons c List.nil)))).Nodup →
      Eq (T.facet o)
        (HSMul.hSMul
          (ite
            (LT.lt (OfNat.ofNat 0)
              (CFDLean.Num.dot (CFDLean.Num.cross3 (HSub.hSub (T.x b) (T.x a)) (HSub.hSub (T.x c) (T.x a)))
                (HSub.hSub (T.x o) (T.x a))))
            (Neg.neg (HDiv.hDiv (OfNat.ofNat 1) (OfNat.ofNat 2))) (HDiv.hDiv (OfNat.ofNat 1) (OfNat.ofNat 2)))
          (CFDLean.Num.cross3 (HSub.hSub (T.x b) (T.x a)) (HSub.hSub (T.x c) (T.x a))))
CFDLean.Num.Internal.Geo3.facet_cross.type:
∀ (T : CFDLean.Num.Simplex 3) (o a b c : Fin 4),
  T.Nondeg →
    [o, a, b, c].Nodup →
      T.facet o =
        (if 0 < CFDLean.Num.dot (CFDLean.Num.cross3 (T.x b - T.x a) (T.x c - T.x a)) (T.x o - T.x a) then -(1 / 2)
          else 1 / 2) •
          CFDLean.Num.cross3 (T.x b - T.x a) (T.x c - T.x a)

CFDLean.Num.Internal.Geo3.facet_cross._s.name: CFDLean.Num.Internal.Geo3.facet_cross._simp_1_1
CFDLean.Num.Internal.Geo3.facet_cross._s.raw_type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} {a : α} {l : List α}, Eq (List.cons a l).Nodup (And (Not (Membership.mem l a)) l.Nodup)
CFDLean.Num.Internal.Geo3.facet_cross._s.type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} {a : α} {l : List α}, (a :: l).Nodup = (a ∉ l ∧ l.Nodup)

CFDLean.Num.Internal.Geo3.facet_cross._s.name: CFDLean.Num.Internal.Geo3.facet_cross._simp_1_2
CFDLean.Num.Internal.Geo3.facet_cross._s.raw_type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} {b : α} {l : List α} {a : α}, Eq (Membership.mem (List.cons b l) a) (Or (Eq a b) (Membership.mem l a))
CFDLean.Num.Internal.Geo3.facet_cross._s.type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} {b : α} {l : List α} {a : α}, (a ∈ b :: l) = (a = b ∨ a ∈ l)

CFDLean.Num.Internal.Geo3.facet_cross._s.name: CFDLean.Num.Internal.Geo3.facet_cross._simp_1_3
CFDLean.Num.Internal.Geo3.facet_cross._s.raw_type: ∀ {p q : Prop}, Eq (Not (Or p q)) (And (Not p) (Not q))

CFDLean.Num.Internal.Geo3.facet_cross._s.name: CFDLean.Num.Internal.Geo3.facet_cross._simp_1_4
CFDLean.Num.Internal.Geo3.facet_cross._s.raw_type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} {a : α}, Eq (Membership.mem List.nil a) False

CFDLean.Num.Internal.Geo3.grads_of_dual.name: CFDLean.Num.Internal.Geo3.grads_of_dual
CFDLean.Num.Internal.Geo3.grads_of_dual.raw_type:
∀ {d : Nat} (T : CFDLean.Num.Simplex d) (G : Fin (HAdd.hAdd d (OfNat.ofNat 1)) → CFDLean.Num.Vec d),
  (∀ (a j : Fin (HAdd.hAdd d (OfNat.ofNat 1))),
      Eq (CFDLean.Num.dot (G a) (HSub.hSub (T.x j) (T.x (OfNat.ofNat 0))))
        (HSub.hSub (ite (Eq a j) (OfNat.ofNat 1) (OfNat.ofNat 0))
          (ite (Eq a (OfNat.ofNat 0)) (OfNat.ofNat 1) (OfNat.ofNat 0)))) →
    And T.Nondeg (∀ (a : Fin (HAdd.hAdd d (OfNat.ofNat 1))), Eq (T.grad a) (G a))
CFDLean.Num.Internal.Geo3.grads_of_dual.type:
∀ {d : ℕ} (T : CFDLean.Num.Simplex d) (G : Fin (d + 1) → CFDLean.Num.Vec d),
  (∀ (a j : Fin (d + 1)), CFDLean.Num.dot (G a) (T.x j - T.x 0) = (if a = j then 1 else 0) - if a = 0 then 1 else 0) →
    T.Nondeg ∧ ∀ (a : Fin (d + 1)), T.grad a = G a

CFDLean.Num.Internal.Geo3.grads_of_dual..name: CFDLean.Num.Internal.Geo3.grads_of_dual._simp_1_1
CFDLean.Num.Internal.Geo3.grads_of_dual..raw_type: ∀ {n : Nat} {a b : Fin n}, Eq (Eq a.succ b.succ) (Eq a b)
CFDLean.Num.Internal.Geo3.grads_of_dual..type: ∀ {n : ℕ} {a b : Fin n}, (a.succ = b.succ) = (a = b)

CFDLean.Num.Internal.Geo3.grads_of_dual..name: CFDLean.Num.Internal.Geo3.grads_of_dual._simp_1_2
CFDLean.Num.Internal.Geo3.grads_of_dual..raw_type: ∀ {n : Nat} (k : Fin n), Eq (Eq k.succ (OfNat.ofNat 0)) False

CFDLean.Num.Internal.Geo3.lagrange.name: CFDLean.Num.Internal.Geo3.lagrange
CFDLean.Num.Internal.Geo3.lagrange.raw_type:
∀ (u v w g : CFDLean.Num.Vec (OfNat.ofNat 3)),
  Eq
    (HAdd.hAdd
      (HAdd.hAdd (HSMul.hSMul (CFDLean.Num.dot g w) (CFDLean.Num.cross3 u v))
        (HSMul.hSMul (CFDLean.Num.dot g u) (CFDLean.Num.cross3 v w)))
      (HSMul.hSMul (CFDLean.Num.dot g v) (CFDLean.Num.cross3 w u)))
    (HSMul.hSMul (CFDLean.Num.dot (CFDLean.Num.cross3 u v) w) g)
CFDLean.Num.Internal.Geo3.lagrange.type:
∀ (u v w g : CFDLean.Num.Vec 3),
  CFDLean.Num.dot g w • CFDLean.Num.cross3 u v + CFDLean.Num.dot g u • CFDLean.Num.cross3 v w +
      CFDLean.Num.dot g v • CFDLean.Num.cross3 w u =
    CFDLean.Num.dot (CFDLean.Num.cross3 u v) w • g

CFDLean.Num.Internal.Geo3.pathG.eq_1.name: CFDLean.Num.Internal.Geo3.pathG.eq_1
CFDLean.Num.Internal.Geo3.pathG.eq_1.raw_type:
∀ (π : Equiv.Perm (Fin (OfNat.ofNat 3))) (h : Fin (OfNat.ofNat 3) → Real),
  Eq (CFDLean.Num.Internal.Geo3.pathG π h)
    (Matrix.vecCons (Neg.neg (CFDLean.Num.Internal.Geo3.sv π h ⟨0, Fin.instOfNat⟩))
      (Matrix.vecCons
        (HSub.hSub (CFDLean.Num.Internal.Geo3.sv π h ⟨0, Fin.instOfNat⟩)
          (CFDLean.Num.Internal.Geo3.sv π h ⟨1, Fin.instOfNat⟩))
        (Matrix.vecCons
          (HSub.hSub (CFDLean.Num.Internal.Geo3.sv π h ⟨1, Fin.instOfNat⟩)
            (CFDLean.Num.Internal.Geo3.sv π h ⟨2, Fin.instOfNat⟩))
          (Matrix.vecCons (CFDLean.Num.Internal.Geo3.sv π h ⟨2, Fin.instOfNat⟩) Matrix.vecEmpty))))
CFDLean.Num.Internal.Geo3.pathG.eq_1.type:
∀ (π : Equiv.Perm (Fin 3)) (h : Fin 3 → ℝ),
  CFDLean.Num.Internal.Geo3.pathG π h =
    ![-CFDLean.Num.Internal.Geo3.sv π h 0, CFDLean.Num.Internal.Geo3.sv π h 0 - CFDLean.Num.Internal.Geo3.sv π h 1,
      CFDLean.Num.Internal.Geo3.sv π h 1 - CFDLean.Num.Internal.Geo3.sv π h 2, CFDLean.Num.Internal.Geo3.sv π h 2]

CFDLean.Num.Internal.Geo3.path_coord.name: CFDLean.Num.Internal.Geo3.path_coord
CFDLean.Num.Internal.Geo3.path_coord.raw_type:
∀ (π : Equiv.Perm (Fin (OfNat.ofNat 3))) (h : Fin (OfNat.ofNat 3) → Real) (j : Fin (OfNat.ofNat 4))
  (k : Fin (OfNat.ofNat 3)),
  Eq ((CFDLean.Num.pathSimplex π h).x j (DFunLike.coe π k))
    (ite (LT.lt k.val j.val) (h (DFunLike.coe π k)) (OfNat.ofNat 0))
CFDLean.Num.Internal.Geo3.path_coord.type:
∀ (π : Equiv.Perm (Fin 3)) (h : Fin 3 → ℝ) (j : Fin 4) (k : Fin 3),
  (CFDLean.Num.pathSimplex π h).x j (π k) = if ↑k < ↑j then h (π k) else 0

CFDLean.Num.Internal.Geo3.path_grads.name: CFDLean.Num.Internal.Geo3.path_grads
CFDLean.Num.Internal.Geo3.path_grads.raw_type:
∀ (π : Equiv.Perm (Fin (OfNat.ofNat 3))) (h : Fin (OfNat.ofNat 3) → Real),
  (∀ (i : Fin (OfNat.ofNat 3)), LT.lt (OfNat.ofNat 0) (h i)) →
    And (CFDLean.Num.pathSimplex π h).Nondeg
      (∀ (a : Fin (HAdd.hAdd (OfNat.ofNat 3) (OfNat.ofNat 1))),
        Eq ((CFDLean.Num.pathSimplex π h).grad a) (CFDLean.Num.Internal.Geo3.pathG π h a))
CFDLean.Num.Internal.Geo3.path_grads.type:
∀ (π : Equiv.Perm (Fin 3)) (h : Fin 3 → ℝ),
  (∀ (i : Fin 3), 0 < h i) →
    (CFDLean.Num.pathSimplex π h).Nondeg ∧
      ∀ (a : Fin (3 + 1)), (CFDLean.Num.pathSimplex π h).grad a = CFDLean.Num.Internal.Geo3.pathG π h a

CFDLean.Num.Internal.Geo3.path_x0.name: CFDLean.Num.Internal.Geo3.path_x0
CFDLean.Num.Internal.Geo3.path_x0.raw_type:
∀ (π : Equiv.Perm (Fin (OfNat.ofNat 3))) (h : Fin (OfNat.ofNat 3) → Real),
  Eq ((CFDLean.Num.pathSimplex π h).x ⟨0, Fin.instOfNat⟩) (OfNat.ofNat 0)

CFDLean.Num.Internal.Geo3.sv.eq_1.name: CFDLean.Num.Internal.Geo3.sv.eq_1
CFDLean.Num.Internal.Geo3.sv.eq_1.raw_type:
∀ (π : Equiv.Perm (Fin (OfNat.ofNat 3))) (h : Fin (OfNat.ofNat 3) → Real) (i : Fin (OfNat.ofNat 3)),
  Eq (CFDLean.Num.Internal.Geo3.sv π h i) (Pi.single (DFunLike.coe π i) (Inv.inv (h (DFunLike.coe π i))))
CFDLean.Num.Internal.Geo3.sv.eq_1.type: ∀ (π : Equiv.Perm (Fin 3)) (h : Fin 3 → ℝ) (i : Fin 3), CFDLean.Num.Internal.Geo3.sv π h i = Pi.single (π i) (h (π i))⁻¹

CFDLean.Num.Internal.Geo3.sv_dot_sv.name: CFDLean.Num.Internal.Geo3.sv_dot_sv
CFDLean.Num.Internal.Geo3.sv_dot_sv.raw_type:
∀ (π : Equiv.Perm (Fin (OfNat.ofNat 3))) (h : Fin (OfNat.ofNat 3) → Real) (i k : Fin (OfNat.ofNat 3)),
  Eq (CFDLean.Num.dot (CFDLean.Num.Internal.Geo3.sv π h i) (CFDLean.Num.Internal.Geo3.sv π h k))
    (ite (Eq i k) (HMul.hMul (Inv.inv (h (DFunLike.coe π i))) (Inv.inv (h (DFunLike.coe π i)))) (OfNat.ofNat 0))
CFDLean.Num.Internal.Geo3.sv_dot_sv.type:
∀ (π : Equiv.Perm (Fin 3)) (h : Fin 3 → ℝ) (i k : Fin 3),
  CFDLean.Num.dot (CFDLean.Num.Internal.Geo3.sv π h i) (CFDLean.Num.Internal.Geo3.sv π h k) =
    if i = k then (h (π i))⁻¹ * (h (π i))⁻¹ else 0

CFDLean.Num.Internal.Geo3.sv_dot_x.name: CFDLean.Num.Internal.Geo3.sv_dot_x
CFDLean.Num.Internal.Geo3.sv_dot_x.raw_type:
∀ (π : Equiv.Perm (Fin (OfNat.ofNat 3))) (h : Fin (OfNat.ofNat 3) → Real),
  (∀ (i : Fin (OfNat.ofNat 3)), LT.lt (OfNat.ofNat 0) (h i)) →
    ∀ (i : Fin (OfNat.ofNat 3)) (j : Fin (OfNat.ofNat 4)),
      Eq
        (CFDLean.Num.dot (CFDLean.Num.Internal.Geo3.sv π h i)
          (HSub.hSub ((CFDLean.Num.pathSimplex π h).x j) ((CFDLean.Num.pathSimplex π h).x ⟨0, Fin.instOfNat⟩)))
        (ite (LT.lt i.val j.val) (OfNat.ofNat 1) (OfNat.ofNat 0))
CFDLean.Num.Internal.Geo3.sv_dot_x.type:
∀ (π : Equiv.Perm (Fin 3)) (h : Fin 3 → ℝ),
  (∀ (i : Fin 3), 0 < h i) →
    ∀ (i : Fin 3) (j : Fin 4),
      CFDLean.Num.dot (CFDLean.Num.Internal.Geo3.sv π h i)
          ((CFDLean.Num.pathSimplex π h).x j - (CFDLean.Num.pathSimplex π h).x 0) =
        if ↑i < ↑j then 1 else 0

CFDLean.Num.Internal.Geo3.triple_perm.name: CFDLean.Num.Internal.Geo3.triple_perm
CFDLean.Num.Internal.Geo3.triple_perm.raw_type:
∀ (p : Fin (OfNat.ofNat 4) → CFDLean.Num.Vec (OfNat.ofNat 3)) (o a b c : Fin (OfNat.ofNat 4)),

CFDLean.Num.Internal.Sbp6.B_bd.name: CFDLean.Num.Internal.Sbp6.B_bd
CFDLean.Num.Internal.Sbp6.B_bd.raw_type:
∀ {ι C : Type} [Fintype ι] [inst : DecidableEq ι] [inst_1 : Fintype C] {d : Nat} (M : CFDLean.Num.WMesh ι C d)
  (bd : Prod C (Fin (HAdd.hAdd d (OfNat.ofNat 1))) → Bool),
  M.Conforming bd →
    LE.le (OfNat.ofNat 1) d →
      ∀ (i k : ι),
        Eq (M.B i k)
          (Finset.univ.sum fun p =>
            ite (And (Eq (bd p) true) (And (Membership.mem (M.facetNodes p) i) (Membership.mem (M.facetNodes p) k)))
              (HSMul.hSMul
                (HDiv.hDiv (HAdd.hAdd (OfNat.ofNat 1) (ite (Eq i k) (OfNat.ofNat 1) (OfNat.ofNat 0)))
                  (HMul.hMul d.cast (HAdd.hAdd d.cast (OfNat.ofNat 1))))
                (M.areaVec p))
              (OfNat.ofNat 0))
CFDLean.Num.Internal.Sbp6.B_bd.type:
∀ {ι C : Type} [Fintype ι] [inst : DecidableEq ι] [inst_1 : Fintype C] {d : ℕ} (M : CFDLean.Num.WMesh ι C d)
  (bd : C × Fin (d + 1) → Bool),
  M.Conforming bd →
    1 ≤ d →
      ∀ (i k : ι),
        M.B i k =
          ∑ p,
            if bd p = true ∧ i ∈ M.facetNodes p ∧ k ∈ M.facetNodes p then
              ((1 + if i = k then 1 else 0) / (↑d * (↑d + 1))) • M.areaVec p
            else 0

    (HSMul.hSMul (ite (Eq i k) (OfNat.ofNat 2) (OfNat.ofNat 1))
      (Finset.univ.sum fun p =>
        ite (And (Membership.mem (M.facetNodes p) i) (Membership.mem (M.facetNodes p) k)) (M.areaVec p)
          (OfNat.ofNat 0)))
CFDLean.Num.Internal.Sbp6.B_facets.type:
∀ {ι C : Type} [Fintype ι] [inst : DecidableEq ι] [inst_1 : Fintype C] {d : ℕ} (M : CFDLean.Num.WMesh ι C d) (i k : ι),
  (↑d * (↑d + 1)) • M.B i k =
    (if i = k then 2 else 1) • ∑ p, if i ∈ M.facetNodes p ∧ k ∈ M.facetNodes p then M.areaVec p else 0

  (W : C → Fin (HAdd.hAdd d (OfNat.ofNat 1)) → Real) (i k : ι),
  Eq (M.cW W k i)
    (Finset.univ.sum fun T =>
      Finset.univ.sum fun a =>
        Finset.univ.sum fun b =>
          ite (And (Eq (DFunLike.coe (M.vert T) a) i) (Eq (DFunLike.coe (M.vert T) b) k))
            (HSMul.hSMul (HMul.hMul (M.ω T) (W T b)) (M.g T a)) (OfNat.ofNat 0))
CFDLean.Num.Internal.Sbp6.cW_swap.type:
∀ {ι C : Type} [Fintype ι] [inst : DecidableEq ι] [inst_1 : Fintype C] {d : ℕ} (M : CFDLean.Num.WMesh ι C d)
  (W : C → Fin (d + 1) → ℝ) (i k : ι),
  M.cW W k i = ∑ T, ∑ a, ∑ b, if (M.vert T) a = i ∧ (M.vert T) b = k then (M.ω T * W T b) • M.g T a else 0

CFDLean.Num.Internal.Sbp6.face_identity.raw_type:
∀ {ι κ : Type} [inst : DecidableEq ι] [inst_1 : Fintype κ] (d : Nat),
  LE.le (OfNat.ofNat 1) d →
    ∀ (s : Finset ι),
      Eq s.card d →
        ∀ (w F : ι → κ → Real),
          Eq (s.sum fun i => s.sum fun j => HMul.hMul (CFDLean.Num.stdWeight d i j) (CFDLean.Num.pairF (w i) (F j)))
            (HSub.hSub (HMul.hMul (HDiv.hDiv (OfNat.ofNat 1) d.cast) (s.sum fun i => CFDLean.Num.pairF (w i) (F i)))
              (HMul.hMul
                (HDiv.hDiv (OfNat.ofNat 1)
                  (HMul.hMul (HMul.hMul (OfNat.ofNat 4) d.cast) (HAdd.hAdd d.cast (OfNat.ofNat 1))))
                (s.sum fun i => s.sum fun j => CFDLean.Num.pairF (HSub.hSub (w j) (w i)) (HSub.hSub (F j) (F i)))))
CFDLean.Num.Internal.Sbp6.face_identity.type:
∀ {ι κ : Type} [inst : DecidableEq ι] [inst_1 : Fintype κ] (d : ℕ),
  1 ≤ d →
    ∀ (s : Finset ι),
      s.card = d →
        ∀ (w F : ι → κ → ℝ),
          ∑ i ∈ s, ∑ j ∈ s, CFDLean.Num.stdWeight d i j * CFDLean.Num.pairF (w i) (F j) =
            1 / ↑d * ∑ i ∈ s, CFDLean.Num.pairF (w i) (F i) -
              1 / (4 * ↑d * (↑d + 1)) * ∑ i ∈ s, ∑ j ∈ s, CFDLean.Num.pairF (w j - w i) (F j - F i)

  (∑ p, if Q p then f p else 0) =
    (∑ p, if bd p = true ∧ Q p then f p else 0) + ∑ p, if bd p = false ∧ Q p then f p else 0

CFDLean.Num.Internal.rot_eq.name: CFDLean.Num.Internal.rot_eq
CFDLean.Num.Internal.rot_eq.raw_type:
∀ (T : CFDLean.Num.Simplex (OfNat.ofNat 2)),
  T.Nondeg →
    ∀ (i k : Fin (OfNat.ofNat 3)),
      Ne i k →
        Exists fun σ =>
          And (Or (Eq σ (OfNat.ofNat 1)) (Eq σ (Neg.neg (OfNat.ofNat 1))))
            (Eq
              (CFDLean.Num.rot90
                (HSub.hSub T.centroid
                  (HSMul.hSMul (HDiv.hDiv (OfNat.ofNat 1) (OfNat.ofNat 2)) (HAdd.hAdd (T.x i) (T.x k)))))
              (HSMul.hSMul (HMul.hMul σ (HDiv.hDiv T.edgeMat.det (OfNat.ofNat 6))) (HSub.hSub (T.grad k) (T.grad i))))
CFDLean.Num.Internal.rot_eq.type:
∀ (T : CFDLean.Num.Simplex 2),
  T.Nondeg →
    ∀ (i k : Fin 3),
      i ≠ k →
        ∃ σ,
          (σ = 1 ∨ σ = -1) ∧
            CFDLean.Num.rot90 (T.centroid - (1 / 2) • (T.x i + T.x k)) =
              (σ * (T.edgeMat.det / 6)) • (T.grad k - T.grad i)

            ite (And (Eq (DFunLike.coe (M.vert T) a) i) (Eq (DFunLike.coe (M.vert T) b) k)) (f T a b) (OfNat.ofNat 0))
    (Finset.univ.sum fun T =>
      Finset.univ.sum fun a =>
        Finset.univ.sum fun b => ite (Eq (DFunLike.coe (M.vert T) b) k) (f T a b) (OfNat.ofNat 0))

CFDLean.Num.Simplex.calculus.name: CFDLean.Num.Simplex.calculus
CFDLean.Num.Simplex.calculus.raw_type:
∀ (d : Nat) (T : CFDLean.Num.Simplex d),
  T.Nondeg →
    And (Eq (Finset.univ.sum fun a => T.grad a) (OfNat.ofNat 0))
      (And
        (∀ (a b c : Fin (HAdd.hAdd d (OfNat.ofNat 1))),
          Eq (CFDLean.Num.dot (T.grad a) (HSub.hSub (T.x b) (T.x c)))
            (HSub.hSub (ite (Eq a b) (OfNat.ofNat 1) (OfNat.ofNat 0)) (ite (Eq a c) (OfNat.ofNat 1) (OfNat.ofNat 0))))
        (And (Eq (Finset.univ.sum fun a => CFDLean.Num.outer (T.grad a) (T.x a)) (OfNat.ofNat 1))
          (And (LT.lt (OfNat.ofNat 0) T.vol) (Eq (Finset.univ.sum fun o => T.facet o) (OfNat.ofNat 0)))))
CFDLean.Num.Simplex.calculus.type:
∀ (d : ℕ) (T : CFDLean.Num.Simplex d),
  T.Nondeg →
    ∑ a, T.grad a = 0 ∧
      (∀ (a b c : Fin (d + 1)),
          CFDLean.Num.dot (T.grad a) (T.x b - T.x c) = (if a = b then 1 else 0) - if a = c then 1 else 0) ∧
        ∑ a, CFDLean.Num.outer (T.grad a) (T.x a) = 1 ∧ 0 < T.vol ∧ ∑ o, T.facet o = 0

CFDLean.Num.Simplex.facet_cross3.name: CFDLean.Num.Simplex.facet_cross3
CFDLean.Num.Simplex.facet_cross3.raw_type:
And
  (∀ (T : CFDLean.Num.Simplex (OfNat.ofNat 3)) (o a b c : Fin (OfNat.ofNat 4)),
    T.Nondeg →
      (List.cons o (List.cons a (List.cons b (List.cons c List.nil)))).Nodup →
        let nv := CFDLean.Num.cross3 (HSub.hSub (T.x b) (T.x a)) (HSub.hSub (T.x c) (T.x a));
        Eq (T.facet o)
          (HSMul.hSMul
            (ite (LT.lt (OfNat.ofNat 0) (CFDLean.Num.dot nv (HSub.hSub (T.x o) (T.x a))))
              (Neg.neg (HDiv.hDiv (OfNat.ofNat 1) (OfNat.ofNat 2))) (HDiv.hDiv (OfNat.ofNat 1) (OfNat.ofNat 2)))
            nv))
  (∀ (T T' : CFDLean.Num.Simplex (OfNat.ofNat 3)) (o a b c o' a' b' c' : Fin (OfNat.ofNat 4)),
    T.Nondeg →
      T'.Nondeg →
        (List.cons o (List.cons a (List.cons b (List.cons c List.nil)))).Nodup →
          (List.cons o' (List.cons a' (List.cons b' (List.cons c' List.nil)))).Nodup →
            Eq (T'.x a') (T.x a) →
              Eq (T'.x b') (T.x b) →
                Eq (T'.x c') (T.x c) →
                  let nv := CFDLean.Num.cross3 (HSub.hSub (T.x b) (T.x a)) (HSub.hSub (T.x c) (T.x a));
                  LT.lt
                      (HMul.hMul (CFDLean.Num.dot nv (HSub.hSub (T.x o) (T.x a)))
                        (CFDLean.Num.dot nv (HSub.hSub (T'.x o') (T.x a))))
                      (OfNat.ofNat 0) →
                    Eq (T'.facet o') (Neg.neg (T.facet o)))
CFDLean.Num.Simplex.facet_cross3.type:
(∀ (T : CFDLean.Num.Simplex 3) (o a b c : Fin 4),
    T.Nondeg →
      [o, a, b, c].Nodup →
        let nv := CFDLean.Num.cross3 (T.x b - T.x a) (T.x c - T.x a);
        T.facet o = (if 0 < CFDLean.Num.dot nv (T.x o - T.x a) then -(1 / 2) else 1 / 2) • nv) ∧
  ∀ (T T' : CFDLean.Num.Simplex 3) (o a b c o' a' b' c' : Fin 4),
    T.Nondeg →
      T'.Nondeg →
        [o, a, b, c].Nodup →
          [o', a', b', c'].Nodup →
            T'.x a' = T.x a →
              T'.x b' = T.x b →
                T'.x c' = T.x c →
                  let nv := CFDLean.Num.cross3 (T.x b - T.x a) (T.x c - T.x a);
                  CFDLean.Num.dot nv (T.x o - T.x a) * CFDLean.Num.dot nv (T'.x o' - T.x a) < 0 →
                    T'.facet o' = -T.facet o

CFDLean.Num.Simplex.facet_perp2.name: CFDLean.Num.Simplex.facet_perp2
CFDLean.Num.Simplex.facet_perp2.raw_type:
∀ (T : CFDLean.Num.Simplex (OfNat.ofNat 2)) (o a b : Fin (OfNat.ofNat 3)),
  T.Nondeg →
    (List.cons o (List.cons a (List.cons b List.nil))).Nodup →

        (HSMul.hSMul
          (ite
            (LT.lt (OfNat.ofNat 0)
              (CFDLean.Num.dot (CFDLean.Num.perp2 (HSub.hSub (T.x b) (T.x a))) (HSub.hSub (T.x o) (T.x a))))
            (Neg.neg (OfNat.ofNat 1)) (OfNat.ofNat 1))
          (CFDLean.Num.perp2 (HSub.hSub (T.x b) (T.x a))))
CFDLean.Num.Simplex.facet_perp2.type:
∀ (T : CFDLean.Num.Simplex 2) (o a b : Fin 3),
  T.Nondeg →
    [o, a, b].Nodup →
      T.facet o =
        (if 0 < CFDLean.Num.dot (CFDLean.Num.perp2 (T.x b - T.x a)) (T.x o - T.x a) then -1 else 1) •
          CFDLean.Num.perp2 (T.x b - T.x a)

CFDLean.Num.WMesh.closed_mean_galerkin.name: CFDLean.Num.WMesh.closed_mean_galerkin
CFDLean.Num.WMesh.closed_mean_galerkin.raw_type:
∀ (ι C κ : Type) [inst : Fintype ι] [inst_1 : DecidableEq ι] [inst_2 : Fintype C] [Fintype κ] (d : Nat)
  (M : CFDLean.Num.WMesh ι C d) (F : ι → Matrix κ (Fin d) Real) (i : ι),
  M.Valid →
    M.Closed i →
      And
        (Eq
          (Finset.univ.sum fun k =>
            (HSMul.hSMul (HDiv.hDiv (OfNat.ofNat 1) (OfNat.ofNat 2)) (HAdd.hAdd (F i) (F k))).mulVec (M.n i k))
          (Finset.univ.sum fun k => (F k).mulVec (M.c i k)))
        (Eq (Finset.univ.sum fun k => (F k).mulVec (M.c i k))
          (Finset.univ.sum fun T =>
            Finset.univ.sum fun a =>
              ite (Eq (DFunLike.coe (M.vert T) a) i)
                (HSMul.hSMul (HMul.hMul (M.ω T) (M.m T))
                  (Finset.univ.sum fun b => (F (DFunLike.coe (M.vert T) b)).mulVec (M.g T b)))
                (OfNat.ofNat 0)))
CFDLean.Num.WMesh.closed_mean_galerkin.type:
∀ (ι C κ : Type) [inst : Fintype ι] [inst_1 : DecidableEq ι] [inst_2 : Fintype C] [Fintype κ] (d : ℕ)
  (M : CFDLean.Num.WMesh ι C d) (F : ι → Matrix κ (Fin d) ℝ) (i : ι),
  M.Valid →
    M.Closed i →
      ∑ k, ((1 / 2) • (F i + F k)).mulVec (M.n i k) = ∑ k, (F k).mulVec (M.c i k) ∧
        ∑ k, (F k).mulVec (M.c i k) =
          ∑ T, ∑ a, if (M.vert T) a = i then (M.ω T * M.m T) • ∑ b, (F ((M.vert T) b)).mulVec (M.g T b) else 0

CFDLean.Num.WMesh.conforming_boundary.name: CFDLean.Num.WMesh.conforming_boundary
CFDLean.Num.WMesh.conforming_boundary.raw_type:
∀ (ι C : Type) [Fintype ι] [inst : DecidableEq ι] [inst_1 : Fintype C] (d : Nat) (M : CFDLean.Num.WMesh ι C d)
  (bd : Prod C (Fin (HAdd.hAdd d (OfNat.ofNat 1))) → Bool),
  M.Valid →
    LE.le (OfNat.ofNat 1) d →
      M.Conforming bd →
        And
          (∀ (i : ι),
            Eq (M.beta i)
              (Finset.univ.sum fun p =>
                ite (And (Eq (bd p) true) (Membership.mem (M.facetNodes p) i))
                  (HSMul.hSMul (HDiv.hDiv (OfNat.ofNat 1) d.cast) (M.areaVec p)) (OfNat.ofNat 0)))
          (And
            (∀ (i k : ι),
              Eq (M.B i k)
                (Finset.univ.sum fun p =>
                  ite
                    (And (Eq (bd p) true) (And (Membership.mem (M.facetNodes p) i) (Membership.mem (M.facetNodes p) k)))
                    (HSMul.hSMul
                      (HDiv.hDiv (HAdd.hAdd (OfNat.ofNat 1) (ite (Eq i k) (OfNat.ofNat 1) (OfNat.ofNat 0)))
                        (HMul.hMul d.cast (HAdd.hAdd d.cast (OfNat.ofNat 1))))
                      (M.areaVec p))
                    (OfNat.ofNat 0)))
            (∀ (i : ι),
              (∀ (p : Prod C (Fin (HAdd.hAdd d (OfNat.ofNat 1)))),
                  Eq (bd p) true → Not (Membership.mem (M.facetNodes p) i)) →
                M.Closed i))
CFDLean.Num.WMesh.conforming_boundary.type:
∀ (ι C : Type) [Fintype ι] [inst : DecidableEq ι] [inst_1 : Fintype C] (d : ℕ) (M : CFDLean.Num.WMesh ι C d)
  (bd : C × Fin (d + 1) → Bool),
  M.Valid →
    1 ≤ d →
      M.Conforming bd →
        (∀ (i : ι), M.beta i = ∑ p, if bd p = true ∧ i ∈ M.facetNodes p then (1 / ↑d) • M.areaVec p else 0) ∧
          (∀ (i k : ι),
              M.B i k =
                ∑ p,
                  if bd p = true ∧ i ∈ M.facetNodes p ∧ k ∈ M.facetNodes p then
                    ((1 + if i = k then 1 else 0) / (↑d * (↑d + 1))) • M.areaVec p
                  else 0) ∧
            ∀ (i : ι), (∀ (p : C × Fin (d + 1)), bd p = true → i ∉ M.facetNodes p) → M.Closed i

CFDLean.Num.WMesh.dissGeom_calibration.name: CFDLean.Num.WMesh.dissGeom_calibration
CFDLean.Num.WMesh.dissGeom_calibration.raw_type:
∀ (ι C : Type) [inst : Fintype ι] [inst_1 : DecidableEq ι] [inst_2 : Fintype C] (d : Nat) (M : CFDLean.Num.WMesh ι C d),
  M.Valid →
    And (∀ (i : ι), M.Closed i → Eq (M.Gtensor M.nu i).trace (HMul.hMul (HMul.hMul (OfNat.ofNat 2) d.cast) (M.V i)))
      (And
        (Eq
          (Finset.univ.sum fun i =>
            Finset.univ.sum fun k => HMul.hMul (CFDLean.Num.len (M.nu i k)) (CFDLean.Num.len (M.e i k)))
          (HMul.hMul (HMul.hMul (OfNat.ofNat 2) d.cast) M.volΩ))
        (And
          (∀ (i : ι), M.Closed i → LE.le (HMul.hMul (HMul.hMul (OfNat.ofNat 2) d.cast) (M.V i)) (M.Gtensor M.n i).trace)
          (∀ (i : ι),
            M.Closed i →
              Iff (Eq (M.Gtensor M.n i).trace (HMul.hMul (HMul.hMul (OfNat.ofNat 2) d.cast) (M.V i)))
                (∀ (k : ι), Exists fun t => And (LE.le (OfNat.ofNat 0) t) (Eq (M.n i k) (HSMul.hSMul t (M.e i k)))))))
CFDLean.Num.WMesh.dissGeom_calibration.type:
∀ (ι C : Type) [inst : Fintype ι] [inst_1 : DecidableEq ι] [inst_2 : Fintype C] (d : ℕ) (M : CFDLean.Num.WMesh ι C d),
  M.Valid →
    (∀ (i : ι), M.Closed i → (M.Gtensor M.nu i).trace = 2 * ↑d * M.V i) ∧
      ∑ i, ∑ k, CFDLean.Num.len (M.nu i k) * CFDLean.Num.len (M.e i k) = 2 * ↑d * M.volΩ ∧
        (∀ (i : ι), M.Closed i → 2 * ↑d * M.V i ≤ (M.Gtensor M.n i).trace) ∧
          ∀ (i : ι),
            M.Closed i → ((M.Gtensor M.n i).trace = 2 * ↑d * M.V i ↔ ∀ (k : ι), ∃ t, 0 ≤ t ∧ M.n i k = t • M.e i k)

CFDLean.Num.WMesh.dissGeom_edge.name: CFDLean.Num.WMesh.dissGeom_edge
CFDLean.Num.WMesh.dissGeom_edge.raw_type:
∀ (ι C : Type) [Fintype ι] [inst : DecidableEq ι] [inst_1 : Fintype C] (d : Nat) (M : CFDLean.Num.WMesh ι C d),
  M.Valid →
    And (∀ (i k : ι), Ne i k → Eq (CFDLean.Num.dot (M.n i k) (M.e i k)) (HMul.hMul (OfNat.ofNat 2) (M.mu i k)))
      (∀ (i k : ι),
        Ne i k →
          (Exists fun T =>
              Exists fun a =>
                Exists fun b =>
                  And (Eq (DFunLike.coe (M.vert T) a) i)
                    (And (Eq (DFunLike.coe (M.vert T) b) k) (LT.lt (OfNat.ofNat 0) (M.ω T)))) →
            And (LT.lt (OfNat.ofNat 0) (M.mu i k))
              (And (Exists fun t => And (LT.lt (OfNat.ofNat 0) t) (Eq (M.nu i k) (HSMul.hSMul t (M.e i k))))
                (Eq (CFDLean.Num.len (M.nu i k))
                  (HDiv.hDiv (CFDLean.Num.dot (M.n i k) (M.e i k)) (CFDLean.Num.len (M.e i k))))))
CFDLean.Num.WMesh.dissGeom_edge.type:
∀ (ι C : Type) [Fintype ι] [inst : DecidableEq ι] [inst_1 : Fintype C] (d : ℕ) (M : CFDLean.Num.WMesh ι C d),
  M.Valid →
    (∀ (i k : ι), i ≠ k → CFDLean.Num.dot (M.n i k) (M.e i k) = 2 * M.mu i k) ∧
      ∀ (i k : ι),
        i ≠ k →
          (∃ T a b, (M.vert T) a = i ∧ (M.vert T) b = k ∧ 0 < M.ω T) →
            0 < M.mu i k ∧
              (∃ t, 0 < t ∧ M.nu i k = t • M.e i k) ∧
                CFDLean.Num.len (M.nu i k) = CFDLean.Num.dot (M.n i k) (M.e i k) / CFDLean.Num.len (M.e i k)

∀ (ι C : Type) [inst : Fintype ι] [inst_1 : DecidableEq ι] [inst_2 : Fintype C] (d : Nat) (M : CFDLean.Num.WMesh ι C d)
  (σ : ι → ι → Real) (s σmax h : Real) (y : ι → ι → CFDLean.Num.Vec d) (i : ι),
  M.Valid →
    LT.lt (OfNat.ofNat 0) (M.V i) →
      let K := fun z =>
        HSMul.hSMul (HDiv.hDiv (OfNat.ofNat 1) (HMul.hMul (OfNat.ofNat 4) (M.V i)))
          (Finset.univ.sum fun k =>
            HSMul.hSMul (HMul.hMul (σ i k) (CFDLean.Num.len (z i k))) (CFDLean.Num.outer (M.e i k) (M.e i k)));
      And
        ((∀ (k : ι), Ne k i → Eq (HMul.hMul (σ i k) (CFDLean.Num.len (M.e i k))) s) →
          Eq (K y) (HSMul.hSMul (HDiv.hDiv s (HMul.hMul (OfNat.ofNat 4) (M.V i))) (M.Gtensor y i)))
        (And
          ((∀ (k : ι), Ne k i → Eq (HMul.hMul (σ i k) (CFDLean.Num.len (M.e i k))) s) →
            Eq (K M.nu).trace (HDiv.hDiv (HMul.hMul d.cast s) (OfNat.ofNat 2)))
          ((∀ (k : ι), And (LE.le (OfNat.ofNat 0) (σ i k)) (LE.le (σ i k) σmax)) →
            (∀ (k : ι), Ne (M.n i k) (OfNat.ofNat 0) → LE.le (CFDLean.Num.len (M.e i k)) h) →
              LE.le (K M.nu).trace (HMul.hMul (HMul.hMul (HDiv.hDiv d.cast (OfNat.ofNat 2)) σmax) h)))
CFDLean.Num.WMesh.dissTensor_trace.type:
∀ (ι C : Type) [inst : Fintype ι] [inst_1 : DecidableEq ι] [inst_2 : Fintype C] (d : ℕ) (M : CFDLean.Num.WMesh ι C d)
  (σ : ι → ι → ℝ) (s σmax h : ℝ) (y : ι → ι → CFDLean.Num.Vec d) (i : ι),
  M.Valid →
    0 < M.V i →
      let K := fun z =>
        (1 / (4 * M.V i)) • ∑ k, (σ i k * CFDLean.Num.len (z i k)) • CFDLean.Num.outer (M.e i k) (M.e i k);
      ((∀ (k : ι), k ≠ i → σ i k * CFDLean.Num.len (M.e i k) = s) → K y = (s / (4 * M.V i)) • M.Gtensor y i) ∧
        ((∀ (k : ι), k ≠ i → σ i k * CFDLean.Num.len (M.e i k) = s) → (K M.nu).trace = ↑d * s / 2) ∧
          ((∀ (k : ι), 0 ≤ σ i k ∧ σ i k ≤ σmax) →
            (∀ (k : ι), M.n i k ≠ 0 → CFDLean.Num.len (M.e i k) ≤ h) → (K M.nu).trace ≤ ↑d / 2 * σmax * h)
